codex.chapter.aero_basics.intro.0: Aeronautics and Simulated turn assembled blocks into physical constructs with mass, inertia and interaction with air. Flight requires controllable lift, propulsion, stability and landing capability; one unusual material does not replace the other parts.
codex.chapter.aero_basics.intro.1: Begin with a small craft near the ground. Learn assembly, test each change without valuable cargo and retain a way back to the pad before attempting a long journey.
codex.chapter.aero_basics.subtitle: Real physics, airships and levitite
codex.chapter.aero_basics.title: Create Aeronautics: Flight
codex.chapter.ca_electric.intro.0: Create Addition connects rotation with FE electricity. An alternator consumes mechanical capacity, a motor receives electricity, and wires and accumulators transfer and store it. There is no free infinite cycle between these energy forms.
codex.chapter.ca_electric.intro.1: Build a short line with one consumer and read its actual values first. Add energy storage, liquid fuel and moving-contraption interfaces afterward.
codex.chapter.ca_electric.subtitle: Turning rotation into energy and back
codex.chapter.ca_electric.title: Create Addition: Electricity
codex.chapter.cbc_advanced.intro.0: Later guns require new materials, layered processing and an understanding of breeches. A stronger barrel expands possibilities without removing limits imposed by ammunition, length, joints and breech closure. Keep records of verified loads.
codex.chapter.cbc_advanced.intro.1: Manufacture and inspect components first, then test the empty mechanism. Test fuzes, autocannons and mortar shells separately on the prepared range.
codex.chapter.cbc_advanced.subtitle: Steel, autocannons and special shells
codex.chapter.cbc_advanced.title: Big Cannons: Heavy Ordnance
codex.chapter.cbc_foundry.intro.0: Big Cannons adds large guns manufactured through melting, casting and boring. The workshop needs Create heat, water supply and rotation; testing needs a separate range with a safe firing direction. Do not begin firing beside storage.
codex.chapter.cbc_foundry.intro.1: Manufactured parts, an assembled gun and a correctly loaded gun are different stages. Check connections and permitted propellant against the installed material properties. An insufficient charge is dangerous too: a projectile can jam in a long bore.
codex.chapter.cbc_foundry.subtitle: Metals, molds and the first gun
codex.chapter.cbc_foundry.title: Big Cannons: Foundry
codex.chapter.create_andesite.intro.0: Andesite machines turn rotation into useful operations: pressing metal, milling grain, cutting wood and processing items with air. Complete each operation with a small batch before connecting machines with belts.
codex.chapter.create_andesite.intro.1: Plan the input and output alongside the machine itself. A full chest, a reversed funnel or an insufficient processing section can halt production despite a working drive. The bread and sheet lines in this chapter teach you to check the material’s entire route.
codex.chapter.create_andesite.subtitle: First machines: press, millstone, saw, fan
codex.chapter.create_andesite.title: Andesite Age
codex.chapter.create_basics.intro.0: Begin with a small workspace near water and a chest for components. Create machines receive rotation through shafts: a source provides stress capacity, and working machines consume it according to their speed. These first quests help you assemble a source, transmission and instruments before connecting an entire workshop.
codex.chapter.create_basics.intro.1: Use the wrench for installation, goggles for diagnosis, and Ponder to see block placement. Item objectives confirm that you have prepared components; watch the actual machine in the world to verify that it works. Item objectives remember the largest quantity of one type seen at once: different types can be registered in sequence, and previously registered machines need not be dismantled for another quest.
codex.chapter.create_basics.subtitle: Andesite alloy, shafts and sources of power
codex.chapter.create_basics.title: First Rotation
codex.chapter.create_brass.intro.0: Brass unlocks precise item feeding, mechanical arms and sequenced assembly. The first batch comes from copper and zinc in a heated basin; afterward you can progressively automate the workshop itself.
codex.chapter.create_brass.intro.1: Begin by separating raw materials, intermediate items and finished products into clear routes. Filters and ingredient reserves matter more than high speed: unfinished mechanisms must return to the correct operation, while completed products go to storage.
codex.chapter.create_brass.subtitle: Brass, crushing wheels and smart automation
codex.chapter.create_brass.title: Brass Age
A contraption is a group of blocks that moves as one structure after assembly. Glue and chassis determine membership, a bearing or another drive provides motion, and tools and storage perform work. Begin with a small platform carrying nothing valuable.

Before startup, inspect the movement area, container attachments and a way to stop the drive from outside. Owning components confirms preparation; correct assembly and a safe route require an in-world trial.
codex.chapter.create_contraptions.title: Contraptions
codex.chapter.create_copper.intro.0: The copper branch connects water service, steam generation and compressed-air equipment. A boiler needs size, heat and incoming water simultaneously; diving equipment needs a precharged backtank. Possessing individual items does not replace these conditions.
codex.chapter.create_copper.intro.1: Test equipment somewhere calm before expanding it or going underwater. Lava protection has additional requirements for the entire armor set, explained separately.
codex.chapter.create_copper.subtitle: Steam, pressure and diving
codex.chapter.create_copper.title: Copper Age
codex.chapter.create_fluids.intro.0: Create fluids move through pipes under the action of pumps. Plan the source, pumping direction, buffer tank and consumer separately. Start with water, which makes connections and valves easy to test safely.
codex.chapter.create_fluids.intro.1: The same arrangement will later serve a mixer, spout and steam boiler. Avoid unnecessarily sharing a main pipe between different fluids, and test dangerous spills away from wooden structures.
codex.chapter.create_fluids.subtitle: Pipes, pumps, valves and industrial pouring
codex.chapter.create_fluids.title: Fluids
codex.chapter.create_kinetics.intro.0: Once several machines share a workshop, convenient transmissions and predictable stops become important. This chapter teaches you to turn axes, disconnect branches, set speed and connect machinery to redstone. Start with a small test rig beside an existing source.
codex.chapter.create_kinetics.intro.1: Control signals and rotation have different roles: a signal issues a command, while a source supplies movement. Sensors and displays make results visible, but they must be connected to the line being observed.
codex.chapter.create_kinetics.subtitle: Gearboxes, clutches, speed and its price
codex.chapter.create_kinetics.title: Controlling Rotation
codex.chapter.create_packages.intro.0: Package logistics separates requesting from transportation. The stock network reports available items, a packager creates a box, and belts, chains or trains carry it to a receiver. Wireless stock communication does not teleport contents.
codex.chapter.create_packages.intro.1: Send one inexpensive package between two points first and verify its address, reception and unpacking. Then connect a stock ticker and automatic requests: complex orders are easier to diagnose on an already working route.
codex.chapter.create_packages.subtitle: Create 6 logistics: boxes, stock and orders
codex.chapter.create_packages.title: Packages and Factory
codex.chapter.create_tools.intro.0: Create tools help build, carry supplies and reproduce tested structures. Learn extended reach and schematic saving before using the schematicannon for automatic construction. Copying requires understanding the selected boundaries and material list beforehand.
codex.chapter.create_tools.intro.1: Some features are intended only for Creative mode. The guide identifies these separately so you do not search for nonexistent Survival recipes or mistake a reading objective for receiving an item.
codex.chapter.create_tools.subtitle: Create tools and building from blueprints
codex.chapter.create_tools.title: Gear and Schematics
codex.chapter.create_trains.intro.0: A train connects distant workshops and stores without a continuous belt line. Begin with sturdy sheets, railway casings, track and an assembly station. Schedules, freight interfaces and shared traffic control come afterward.
codex.chapter.create_trains.intro.1: Start with a short line and one light train. An onboard boiler is not required for a Create train to move; correct assembly, controls and a reachable route matter more. Check loading and return travel separately from locomotive decoration.
codex.chapter.create_trains.subtitle: Tracks, stations, schedules and Steam 'n' Rails
codex.chapter.create_trains.title: Trains
codex.chapter.create_world.intro.0: Create add-ons place structures and decorative components in the world that are worth examining during ordinary travel. Inspect found structures from outside first: appearance does not guarantee working automation, a safe entrance or particular loot.
codex.chapter.create_world.intro.1: Record interesting coordinates and observe actual design choices such as shaft routes, tank placement and maintenance access. These observations can inform your base whether you leave the discovered building intact or later rebuild it.
codex.chapter.create_world.subtitle: Structures, decor and small add-ons
codex.chapter.create_world.title: Create in the World
codex.chapter.dim_aether.intro.0: Aether consists of sky islands where local tools and fall protection matter. Secure a platform around the portal, learn Skyroot, Holystone, and Ambrosium, then progress to Zanite and Gravitite.
codex.chapter.dim_aether.intro.1: The three dungeon types have different combat rules. Attack the Slider with a pickaxe, present medals to the Valkyrie Queen, and freeze the Sun Spirit with a reflected Ice Crystal. Rewards come from different dungeon chests, so a card title does not necessarily locate every requested item.
codex.chapter.dim_aether.subtitle: The sky dimension: dungeons, gravitite and valkyries
codex.chapter.dim_aether.title: Aether
codex.chapter.dim_end.intro.0: An End expedition starts with locating a stronghold and develops into a reliable outer-island route. Prepare extra Eyes of Ender, and leave a respawn point and spare equipment in the Overworld before jumping in.
codex.chapter.dim_end.intro.1: Collect Dragon’s Breath during combat, find Elytra on End Ships, and obtain shells from Shulkers. These are distinct expedition results. Eden frames belong to Eternal Tales and need a crafted crystal; defeating the dragon does not automatically open them.
codex.chapter.dim_end.subtitle: The dragon, ender pearls and the way beyond
codex.chapter.dim_end.title: The End
codex.chapter.dim_nether.intro.0: The Nether supplies Blaze Rods, quartz, nether wart, and Ancient Debris. Secure your return first: a protected portal, recorded coordinates, and spare ignition matter more than an inventory full of ore.
codex.chapter.dim_nether.intro.1: Fortresses, bastions, and Eternal Tales structures are distinct destinations. Netherite is unnecessary for starting wart farming or brewing protection; some cards can be pursued in parallel. The side branches turn an initial dangerous visit into a sustained supply route.
codex.chapter.dim_nether.subtitle: What the pack's mods take from the Nether
codex.chapter.dim_nether.title: The Nether
codex.chapter.dim_twilight.intro.0: The Twilight Forest starts with a small water portal, but further travel is gated by the mod’s advancements. After the Naga and Lich, progression branches into swamp, dark forest, and snow. All three converge before the Highlands.
codex.chapter.dim_twilight.intro.1: Distinguish trophies, special loot, and the action removing regional protection. Eat Minoshroom’s meal for the Fire Swamp and place a trophy on the pedestal for the stronghold. A Magic Map helps choose an accessible route instead of running through an active curse.
codex.chapter.dim_twilight.subtitle: A strict boss chain from the Naga to the Yeti
codex.chapter.dim_twilight.title: Twilight Forest
codex.chapter.end_apotheosis.intro.0: The final trials bring together three independent paths: Eternal Darkness battles, Arkemer technology and milestones from several major mods. This is a late chapter whose requirements build on the detailed guides in earlier maps.
codex.chapter.end_apotheosis.intro.1: Finishing Apotheosis completes this final chain but does not automatically mark other chapters or side projects. The book's overall counter still shows how many quests remain for full completion.
codex.chapter.end_apotheosis.subtitle: The book's last quests
codex.chapter.end_apotheosis.title: Apotheosis
codex.chapter.end_marathon.intro.0: The marathon tests reliable production with a large order. Begin with a small batch, find the slowest stage and ensure the line can stop when its output fills. Only then increase the order.
codex.chapter.end_marathon.intro.1: Every main quest in this chapter consumes its turn-in items. Gather the entire batch in your regular inventory before claiming; items inside a network or backpack do not replace it. Steel is accepted in blocks so the full amount actually fits.
codex.chapter.end_marathon.subtitle: Numbers you can't catch without an autocraft chain
codex.chapter.end_marathon.title: Marathon
codex.chapter.end_monuments.intro.0: Monuments begin with a production reserve: girders, tracks, casings and rare building materials. The main cards accept the specified batch in exchange for a reward; they do not recognize the shape of a finished tower, fortress or town.
codex.chapter.end_monuments.intro.1: Turn-in resources disappear when you claim the reward. Keep this batch separate from the building stock. Side quests put the resulting production to use in the world and use manual confirmation against a specific result.
codex.chapter.end_monuments.subtitle: Builds that justify the whole factory
codex.chapter.end_monuments.title: Monuments
codex.chapter.et_amber.intro.0: Amber requires Sorcery level thirteen and materials from several systems: fishing, sorcery and metallurgy. Prepare them in advance so your first journey can focus on exploration rather than missing ingredients.
codex.chapter.et_amber.intro.1: The story leads from Nightingale to the maze and then Xaxxas’s castle. Location hints use your first portal in this world as their reference, so preserve its coordinates.
codex.chapter.et_amber.subtitle: A bright dimension with a dark secret
codex.chapter.et_amber.title: Kingdom of Amber
codex.chapter.et_archaeology.intro.0: Archaeology turns suspicious blocks into materials, pottery sherds and blueprints. Use a brush, preserve rare originals and only then decide what to recycle for experience.
codex.chapter.et_archaeology.intro.1: The Jewelry Table uses a separate chain of rough gems, sandpaper and magnifiers. Its output quality is linked to Archery, so developing both branches in parallel is useful.
codex.chapter.et_archaeology.subtitle: Brushes, blueprints, vases and totems
codex.chapter.et_archaeology.title: Archaeology
codex.chapter.et_comets.intro.0: Comets is an early extraterrestrial stage with islands, local metals and the Terrible Tree. Its crystal requires Sorcery level two; building blocks for bridges and a tested return method are particularly valuable on your first visit.
codex.chapter.et_comets.intro.1: Save Aerolite, Skylite and summoning materials. Defeating the Tree is checked when summoning Rock-Blaze, so simply buying Hell Fire cannot replace that milestone.
codex.chapter.et_comets.subtitle: First dimension: floating islands and the Terrible Tree
codex.chapter.et_comets.title: Comets
codex.chapter.et_darkness.intro.0: Eternal Darkness strengthens the world and enables Humanity and Fear. A Totem of Eternal Darkness activates it, and a Totem of Eternity reverses it; prepare both before experimenting.
codex.chapter.et_darkness.intro.1: Super Duper Darkness is a separate mode in which any damage kills immediately. It is not automatically required for every special victory: check each advancement’s exact conditions.
codex.chapter.et_darkness.subtitle: Hard mode and humanity
codex.chapter.et_darkness.title: Eternal Darkness
codex.chapter.et_eden.intro.0: Sunstones connect the Nyetet victory with Eden. Preserve individual stones: the crystal uses two alongside a Silver Block, Dragon’s Breath and Monster Blindness, requiring Sorcery level six.
codex.chapter.et_eden.intro.1: Eden’s story begins by speaking with D’Kudja and freeing the Altar of the Sun. Some collection cards in this chapter concern much later opponents.
codex.chapter.et_eden.subtitle: The sunny world of the Sunfurry
codex.chapter.et_eden.title: Gardens of Eden
codex.chapter.et_farming.intro.0: Plants and fish supply food, crafting and dimension crystals. First obtain one confirmed harvest or catch, then expand production and add machine support.
codex.chapter.et_farming.intro.1: Pots need water and fertilizer reserves; nets need the correct surroundings and bait. An item mark in the book does not verify these operating conditions for you.
codex.chapter.et_farming.subtitle: Pots, machines, nets and bug nets
codex.chapter.et_farming.title: Garden, Fishing and Catching
codex.chapter.et_gear.intro.0: This chapter collects equipment from different stages rather than asking you to craft everything on day one. Choose the nearest useful branch based on resources already unlocked, leaving late collections for their corresponding dimensions.
codex.chapter.et_gear.intro.1: Armor often requires wearing the full set; weapons and accessories are generally checked on acquisition. Preserve an item’s progress before an upgrade recipe consumes it.
codex.chapter.et_gear.subtitle: Armors, weapons and artifacts
codex.chapter.et_gear.title: Eternal Tales Gear
codex.chapter.et_intro.intro.0: Begin with the Journal and Eternal Town: accept story quests, read about skills and meet Miguel here. The Journal records NPC assignments, while this map connects them with crafting and exploration.
codex.chapter.et_intro.intro.1: Defeating a boss, finishing a dialogue and obtaining an item are separate conditions. Read each card’s objectives: the conversation after your return can matter as much as the battle.
codex.chapter.et_intro.subtitle: Journal, Eternal Town and notice boards
codex.chapter.et_intro.title: Eternal Tales
codex.chapter.et_karvat.intro.0: Karvat is accessible at Sorcery level eight and follows the restoration of Gulibeg’s power. Speak to him first: the power pieces he provides become summoning items for four lesser gods.
codex.chapter.et_karvat.intro.1: After the four temples, combine their powers for Enicrih and return to the quest giver. Khogachi and the Arkemer opponents in side cards belong to other routes, not this ritual.
codex.chapter.et_karvat.subtitle: Divine forest and deities
codex.chapter.et_karvat.title: Lands of Karvat
codex.chapter.et_nether_end.intro.0: The Nether supplies early travel materials and its own Clocktower storyline. The End contains an Ancient Enderman, the restoration of a chorus plant and objectives beyond defeating the dragon.
codex.chapter.et_nether_end.intro.1: Plan trips from a checklist: keys, Nether Fish and Fire Moss serve different recipes, while Ancient Chorus helps a traveler after dimension changes.
codex.chapter.et_nether_end.subtitle: The Piglin Clocktower and the Ancient Chorus
codex.chapter.et_nether_end.title: Nether and End
codex.chapter.et_overworld.intro.0: The Overworld introduces ores, events and the first major opponents. A Cobalt Pickaxe matters for Vivid, while the Interdimensional Creator connects this preparation with later travel.
codex.chapter.et_overworld.intro.1: Some collection cards include late objectives from other dimensions. Their map placement does not promise that every listed boss lives near your first base.
codex.chapter.et_overworld.subtitle: Ores, lunar events and first bosses
codex.chapter.et_overworld.title: The Overworld
codex.chapter.et_purgatorium.intro.0: The road to Purgatorium begins in Comets and the Nether. Defeat the Terrible Tree first, then summon Rock-Blaze with Hell Fire and obtain Hellrock by interacting with the living boss.
codex.chapter.et_purgatorium.intro.1: The crystal needs a block made from nine Hellrock and Sorcery level four. Within Purgatorium, assemble the Fallen Rune, find the correct altar and prepare for Nyetet.
codex.chapter.et_purgatorium.subtitle: Darkness, the Rock Blaze and the Fallen Rune
codex.chapter.et_purgatorium.title: Purgatorium
codex.chapter.et_rayana.intro.0: Rayana opens with a Sorcery level eight crystal and leads into the Bloody Cult story. Speak with the Daredians first, then prepare a Bloody Eye and search for the Aede temple.
codex.chapter.et_rayana.intro.1: The Infected Kraken listed here belongs to another side route: summon it during rain on an Overworld Mucunfectio Beach.
codex.chapter.et_rayana.subtitle: Tropics, vampirism and Pterion
codex.chapter.et_rayana.title: Rayana
codex.chapter.et_skills.intro.0: Eternal Tales skills improve through their corresponding activities: mining, fighting, growing, trading and others. They are separate from vanilla experience and affect the mod’s own items and recipes.
codex.chapter.et_skills.intro.1: Some cards here check skill development; others check related equipment. Read the actual objectives: making a chest or armor does not prove that a skill has reached a high level.
codex.chapter.et_skills.subtitle: Nine skills and level points
codex.chapter.et_skills.title: Skills
codex.chapter.et_sorcery.intro.0: Sorcery connects rune mining, essence storage and equipment improvement. Begin with one clear cycle: mine runes, process them in the cauldron and obtain an essence container.
codex.chapter.et_sorcery.intro.1: Runic Matrix is an armor enchantment. Blueprints, the printer and altars are separate systems; their shared magical theme does not make them interchangeable.
codex.chapter.et_sorcery.subtitle: Runes, essences, matrix and astral enchanting
codex.chapter.et_sorcery.title: Sorcery
codex.chapter.et_ultimate.intro.0: Ultimate World continues after the main victory. Its crystal combines four earlier crystals with The Ultimate Bricks; Arkemer crafting separately depends on the Aetherium Forge and Aftermath storyline.
codex.chapter.et_ultimate.intro.1: This chapter collects long-term goals. Open material sources and the forge first, then make equipment for a purpose; some late items consume tools you have already crafted.
codex.chapter.et_ultimate.subtitle: Arkemers, aetherium and the real endgame
codex.chapter.et_ultimate.title: Ultimate World
codex.chapter.et_unahzaal.intro.0: Unahzaal’s dimension requires Sorcery level sixteen and crystals from several previously opened worlds. Preparing the Damaged Astral consumes a weapon collection, so separate your fighting gear from recipe ingredients beforehand.
codex.chapter.et_unahzaal.intro.1: The main Unahzaal victory opens later events and the Arkemer line. Gifts, special Darkness conditions and Tetragrammaton are distinct objectives rather than one shared completion mark.
codex.chapter.et_unahzaal.subtitle: The multiverse and the end of the road
codex.chapter.et_unahzaal.title: Unahzaal
codex.chapter.et_volcanech.intro.0: Volcanech requires Sorcery level ten and materials from earlier worlds. Fire Resistance, repaired armor and attention to enemies with floating weapons and sulfur clouds are useful here.
codex.chapter.et_volcanech.intro.1: Prepare a Flame Sphere and Pyro Volcanite for the golem, and a Spawner Cracker for the scout’s assignment. Arahulum’s side encounter takes place in the End.
codex.chapter.et_volcanech.subtitle: Volcanoes, aggression and betrayal
codex.chapter.et_volcanech.title: Volcanech
codex.chapter.fd_kitchen.intro.0: A kitchen turns separate ingredients into supplies for work and travel. Farmer’s Delight adds knife processing, cooking-pot meals, new crops and large dishes for serving. Begin with one understandable portion before expanding the menu.
codex.chapter.fd_kitchen.intro.1: Place preparation surfaces, a heat source and storage nearby with safe access. Reliable supplies require more than recipes: replant seeds, replenish ingredients and move finished meals into a separate reserve.
codex.chapter.fd_kitchen.intro.2: Optional quests connect cultivation, preparation and kitchen operation. Item objectives check inventory supplies, while manual goals ask you to verify the described process yourself.
codex.chapter.fd_kitchen.subtitle: Farmer's Delight: knives, board, pot and skillet
codex.chapter.fd_kitchen.title: Kitchen
codex.chapter.final_bridges.intro.0: This map connects paths you already know: rotation with electricity, processing with storage, transport with supplies. Start with a small pair of devices and one trial order to see where items or energy travel.
codex.chapter.final_bridges.intro.1: The main cards gather equipment and results. Owning items does not prove an integrated installation works; separate practical branches use manual confirmation for that. Check compatibility at specific inputs and outputs instead of relying on a familiar mod name.
codex.chapter.final_bridges.subtitle: How three tech lines join into one
codex.chapter.final_bridges.title: Bridges Between Mods
codex.chapter.final_goals.intro.0: Ten summits gather late results from the pack's major paths. They are milestones for finishing chosen routes, not a claim that one rare item automatically proves a complete factory or fully explored world.
codex.chapter.final_goals.intro.1: Each node lists exact requirements: items, personal advancements or a manual check. The final card combines all ten summits; side projects and unfinished chapters still count toward the book's overall progress.
codex.chapter.final_goals.subtitle: How the pack ends
codex.chapter.final_goals.title: Final Goals
codex.chapter.hunt_apotheosis.intro.0: Apotheosis connects affix loot, gems, and personal World Tiers. Compare found equipment with your current set before salvaging unwanted pieces into upgrade materials. Affix rarity and ordinary enchantments are separate properties.
codex.chapter.hunt_apotheosis.intro.1: Apothic Enchanting uses Eterna, Quanta, and Arcana, while the active World Tier also limits available Eterna. Unlocking a tier does not activate it: use the tier selection screen before configuring a stronger enchanting table.
codex.chapter.hunt_apotheosis.subtitle: Affixes, gems and gear that never repeats
codex.chapter.hunt_apotheosis.title: Apotheosis
codex.chapter.hunt_beasts.intro.0: Hunting here includes observation, taming, trials, and mutant battles. Read the creature’s Animal Dictionary entry before travelling: food, habitat, and useful interactions often matter more than weapon strength.
codex.chapter.hunt_beasts.intro.1: Mowzie’s Mobs encounters depend on enemy behaviour. Some rewards come from trade or a challenge, and attacking too early can remove the peaceful option at that settlement.
codex.chapter.hunt_beasts.subtitle: Alex's Mobs, Mowzie's Mobs and Mutant Monsters
codex.chapter.hunt_beasts.title: Beasts and Mutants
codex.chapter.hunt_cataclysm.intro.0: Cataclysm leads through eight major bosses and additional encounters in their structures. Use the special locating eyes, each associated with a structure and dimension. Discovering an arena is not the same as being ready to fight.
codex.chapter.hunt_cataclysm.intro.1: Some enemies awaken through consumed offerings. Prepare the offering, armour, healing, and return route before starting. The final advancement requires personal victories against specific bosses; obtaining another player’s weapons is insufficient.
codex.chapter.hunt_cataclysm.subtitle: Eight dungeons, eight bosses and weapons found nowhere else
codex.chapter.hunt_cataclysm.title: Cataclysm
codex.chapter.ie_chemistry.intro.0: IE’s chemical workshop turns crops into oil, ethanol, fuel and plastic. Begin with reliable plant supply, independent startup power and labelled fluid lines: similar tanks do not make fluids interchangeable.
codex.chapter.ie_chemistry.intro.1: In this version the refinery needs saltpeter dust as the biodiesel catalyst. Acetaldehyde uses a silver plate. Catalysts are not consumed, but reactions do not start without the correct item; inspect each specific recipe.
codex.chapter.ie_chemistry.subtitle: Plant oil, ethanol, biodiesel and polymers
codex.chapter.ie_chemistry.title: Chemistry and Fuel
codex.chapter.ie_gear.intro.0: Engineering equipment uses replaceable parts, fluid fuel, ammunition or stored energy. Before leaving, check not only the tool itself but also the drill head, sawblade, magazine contents and accumulator charge.
codex.chapter.ie_gear.intro.1: The workbench and maintenance kit allow supported components to be changed. Prepare a safe test area for weapons and turrets, and clear boarding and dismounting points for cable travel. Crafting a device does not mean it is ready to operate.
codex.chapter.ie_gear.subtitle: Weapons, tools and armor
codex.chapter.ie_gear.title: Engineer's Gear
codex.chapter.ie_machines.intro.0: Large IE machines are built from ordinary materials in the world and then formed with the engineer’s hammer. Energy, item, fluid and redstone ports occupy specific positions; a connector on an arbitrary wall will not start the installation.
codex.chapter.ie_machines.intro.1: This chapter checks construction materials and the operation of assembled machines, rather than requiring an unavailable survival inventory item for a finished multiblock. Use a small batch for each first run and leave room for secondary outputs.
codex.chapter.ie_machines.subtitle: Crusher, press, arc furnace and excavator
codex.chapter.ie_machines.title: Multiblock Machines
codex.chapter.ie_power.intro.0: Immersive Engineering transfers energy through wires between fittings. A connector links the grid to a machine, a relay joins wire spans, and a transformer links voltage tiers. These three blocks serve different jobs.
codex.chapter.ie_power.intro.1: Rotational generation uses IE’s own water wheels and windmills with a kinetic dynamo; an arbitrary shaft from another mod is not a source for that dynamo. Give wires dedicated routes and check load in IF/FE per tick for safe operation.
codex.chapter.ie_power.subtitle: Wires, voltages, generators and transformers
codex.chapter.ie_power.title: Power Grid
codex.chapter.ie_start.intro.0: Immersive Engineering revolves around materials, wires and machines assembled in the world from multiple blocks. The Engineer’s Manual shows structure layers and the hammer activation point; those layouts match the installed version and are more reliable than old pictures online.
codex.chapter.ie_start.intro.1: Begin with coke, creosote, treated wood and steel. The early blast furnace needs manual service, so provide space for fuel and slag. The next workshop will need electricity, but initial metallurgy works without FE.
codex.chapter.ie_start.subtitle: Where Immersive Engineering begins
codex.chapter.ie_start.title: Hammer and Coke
codex.chapter.life_furniture.intro.0: A comfortable base remains practical: resting, storing supplies and finding work areas should all be easy. Furniture mods provide different forms and materials, while decorative blocks give a workshop a coherent character.
codex.chapter.life_furniture.intro.1: Test unfamiliar pieces in a small area. Inspect neighbouring connections, opening doors and clear passages. Check power and operating requirements separately for functional furniture.
codex.chapter.life_furniture.intro.2: This chapter does not prescribe one correct style. Its quests teach the tools and help create spaces you enjoy using every day.
codex.chapter.life_furniture.subtitle: Handcrafted, Refurbished Furniture and architectural decor
codex.chapter.life_furniture.title: Furniture and Comfort
codex.chapter.life_world.intro.0: Beyond the workshop lies a world worth exploring deliberately. A new biome provides materials, a discovered structure becomes a landmark, and a planned route brings both you and your supplies home.
codex.chapter.life_world.intro.1: This chapter introduces maps, search compasses and waystones. Learn navigation first, then prepare a short expedition. Distant terrain rendering helps you choose a direction, but it does not make faraway land safe or interactive.
codex.chapter.life_world.intro.2: Optional branches offer field assignments: scout a route, survey a biome and establish a staging post. Manual ticks record checks you have actually performed, rather than merely asking you to read a page.
codex.chapter.life_world.subtitle: Terralith, compasses and distant rendering
codex.chapter.life_world.title: The Pack's World
codex.chapter.magic_agriculture.intro.0: Mystical Agriculture grows resources through seeds and essences. Begin with Inferium and Prosperity Shards, then prepare an altar for resource crops. Harvested essence usually needs a separate recipe to become iron or another useful material.
codex.chapter.magic_agriculture.intro.1: Improve yields through farmland and accelerators, and collection through serviced machines. Stored supplies do not prove a working farm: the final quests require repeated harvests and processing. Higher tiers need a substantial farm and separate resources from dangerous expeditions.
codex.chapter.magic_agriculture.subtitle: Six essence tiers and a field instead of a mine
codex.chapter.magic_agriculture.title: Mystical Agriculture
codex.chapter.magic_ars.intro.0: Ars Nouveau separates personal spell mana from Source used by devices. Your book stores composed spells, while Source Jars supply the workshop and helpers. Sourceberries support a beginner but do not merge these two reserves.
codex.chapter.magic_ars.intro.1: Start with an Imbuement Chamber and Novice’s Spell Book, then learn glyph inscription, Source transport, and the Enchanting Apparatus. Portals and rituals use different activation methods. The final supply test requires observing Source consumption and recovery beside a working consumer.
codex.chapter.magic_ars.subtitle: Source, glyphs and spells you write yourself
codex.chapter.magic_ars.title: Ars Nouveau
codex.chapter.magic_botania.intro.0: Petals make your first flowers, the Pure Daisy supplies construction materials, and the Endoflame turns fuel into mana. Build this chain near your base with room to expand.
codex.chapter.magic_botania.intro.1: Separate generation, transport, and storage: a generating flower binds to a spreader, which fires into a pool. The pool produces nothing by itself. The final quests check that reserves recover after actual consumption.
codex.chapter.magic_botania.subtitle: Botania: where flower magic begins
codex.chapter.magic_botania.title: Petals and Mana
codex.chapter.magic_botania_end.intro.0: Alfheim unlocks item trading, improved materials, and Corporea. This is a trading portal, and players cannot walk into the elven world. Activation and trading require mana reserves in two pools.
codex.chapter.magic_botania_end.intro.1: Gaia trials need a prepared arena and a consumed summoning item. Establish supplies and equipment before challenging the ordinary Guardian. Relics and rank SS are long-term goals after reliable production.
codex.chapter.magic_botania_end.subtitle: Elves, relics and the end of the flower road
codex.chapter.magic_botania_end.title: Alfheim and the Gaia Guardian
The Runic Altar connects basic mana materials with functional flowers, accessories, and Terrasteel. Prepare a dedicated supply line and spare Livingrock: completed rune recipes require a manual finishing step.

Terrasteel costs half a normal pool per ingot. Expand production before an expensive attempt, rather than after losing an unfinished batch. This equipment supports safer exploration and prepares you for elven trading.
codex.chapter.magic_botania_runes.subtit: The second circle: altar, runes, harder flowers
codex.chapter.magic_botania_runes.title: Runes and Terrasteel
codex.chapter.magic_irons.intro.0: Iron’s Spells uses found and crafted scrolls, inscribed into a book for repeated casting. Begin with an accessible Copper Spell Book and Inscription Table. The Ruined Book in the first card belongs to a later Ancient City expedition and is unnecessary for your first spell.
codex.chapter.magic_irons.intro.1: The Inscription Table, Scroll Forge, and Arcane Anvil perform different operations. Magical clothing expands your capabilities, while rare runes and orbs improve specialisation. The Dead King’s staff requires a separate serious battle in the catacombs.
codex.chapter.magic_irons.subtitle: Eight schools of magic and the battle mage's road
codex.chapter.magic_irons.title: Iron's Spellbooks
codex.chapter.mc_build.intro.0: Structurize selects, measures and saves building blueprints; Domum Ornamentum creates decorative shapes from selected materials. These tools prepare projects without removing construction costs or citizen work.
codex.chapter.mc_build.intro.1: First test a small detail on a clear site. Block shape, infill material and orientation are separate parameters: an attractive distant resemblance does not guarantee fulfillment of a builder request.
codex.chapter.mc_build.subtitle: Structurize, Domum Ornamentum and Multi-Piston
codex.chapter.mc_build.title: Construction and Styles
codex.chapter.mc_found.intro.0: A colony develops through citizens, construction orders and resource deliveries. A hut block identifies an institution’s location, while an assigned builder constructs its building after an interface command. Begin with an accessible site, supplies and housing.
codex.chapter.mc_found.intro.1: The Codex remembers different item objectives sequentially. A registered hut can be placed immediately; dismantling an operational building for another scan is unnecessary. Verify citizens through their requests and actual results rather than possession of a listed block.
codex.chapter.mc_found.subtitle: Town hall, builder and first citizens
codex.chapter.mc_found.title: Founding a Colony
codex.chapter.mc_military.intro.0: Colony defence begins with accessible routes, lighting and supplied guards. A tower without an assigned fighter does not protect citizens; barracks cannot replace weapons, food and training.
codex.chapter.mc_military.intro.1: Plan defences before a raid while preserving civilian routes to shelter and assistance. Rare trophies are possible combat outcomes, not guaranteed rewards for every repelled attack.
codex.chapter.mc_military.subtitle: Guards, barracks and repelling raids
codex.chapter.mc_military.title: Defense
codex.chapter.mc_production.intro.0: Production professions depend on colony resources, tools and requests. Gathering logs is different from crafting planks, and a warehouse cannot teach a blacksmith an unknown recipe. Distinguish gatherer, crafter and courier to locate a stoppage.
codex.chapter.mc_production.intro.1: Begin with a short chain for one construction material. Add professions and research after a successful delivery; several empty institutions increase responsibilities without yet creating a self-sufficient economy.
codex.chapter.mc_production.subtitle: From forest and mine to smithy and glassblower
codex.chapter.mc_production.title: Colony Production
codex.chapter.mc_research.intro.0: Citizen education and university research solve different problems. The library develops adults, the school prepares children and the university unlocks colony technology. Operation requires assignments, suitable buildings and selected activities.
codex.chapter.mc_research.intro.1: Read research restrictions before paying: university level, previous discoveries and required institutions matter. The quest log adds citizen dialogues to progression; its history does not replace the research tree.
codex.chapter.mc_research.subtitle: University, school, library and research
codex.chapter.mc_research.title: Science and Growth
codex.chapter.mek_gear.intro.0: Mekanism equipment needs more than crafting: it may require energy, chemical fuel or installed modules. Test each new tool in a safe area before an expedition; an empty charge or wrong mode can look like a fault.
codex.chapter.mek_gear.intro.1: MekaSuit and the Meka-Tool are configured for specific tasks through the modification station. Modules fit particular compatible items, and radiation shielding and flight need separate verification even when every component is already in your inventory.
codex.chapter.mek_gear.subtitle: Power armor, modules and the Meka-Tool
codex.chapter.mek_gear.title: MekaSuit
codex.chapter.mek_nuclear.intro.0: The nuclear branch begins with chemical fuel and cooling prepared in advance. Before admitting fissile fuel, provide steam removal, waste handling, temperature monitoring and a tested emergency stop. Reactor casings in an inventory confirm none of these conditions.
codex.chapter.mek_nuclear.intro.1: Radioactive chemicals cannot be serviced like an ordinary water tank. Locate the site away from living areas, use a complete protective set and do not dismantle filled tubes. Fusion uses a different fuel chain and needs its own startup preparation.
codex.chapter.mek_nuclear.subtitle: Uranium, fission reactor, waste and radiation
codex.chapter.mek_nuclear.title: Nuclear Power
codex.chapter.mek_ore.intro.0: Ore processing increases metal yield at the cost of energy, machinery and chemicals. The ×2–×5 labels apply to ore blocks; raw iron uses different ratios. Choose a chain that fits your mining method and verify it with a small known batch.
codex.chapter.mek_ore.intro.1: Each new stage goes before machines you have already learned. Keep the simple line working while establishing oxygen, brine and acids; chemical production needs space for byproducts and separate transport lines.
codex.chapter.mek_ore.subtitle: From doubling to fivefold yield
codex.chapter.mek_ore.title: Ore Processing
codex.chapter.mek_power.intro.0: A reliable power system needs a source, transmission and storage. Start with generation for a few machines, then measure demand during real operation: an empty battery does not always mean weak generation, since energy may simply be blocked at an output side.
codex.chapter.mek_power.intro.1: Steam systems need particular attention to water supply and steam removal. Crafted casings confirm available materials; actual output and reliability depend on the complete installation, its settings and the world’s configuration.
codex.chapter.mek_power.subtitle: From heat generator to steam turbine
codex.chapter.mek_power.title: Power Generation
codex.chapter.mek_qio.intro.0: Quantum devices remove long transport runs but retain frequency, access and world-loading requirements. Test a pair nearby first so configuration errors become visible before building a remote site.
codex.chapter.mek_qio.intro.1: QIO stores items on drives and exposes them through a selected frequency. Teleporters move players, while quantum entangloporters transfer supported resources; these are different subsystems with separate rules.
codex.chapter.mek_qio.subtitle: Quantum storage and instant travel
codex.chapter.mek_qio.title: QIO and Teleportation
codex.chapter.mek_start.intro.0: Mekanism starts with power and a few recurring materials: osmium, steel, circuits and alloys. Begin with a small workshop where every machine input and output is visible; expanding a clear arrangement into factories is easier than hunting a fault among pipes.
codex.chapter.mek_start.intro.1: Energy, items, fluids and chemicals use different networks. This chapter teaches you to distinguish them and configure machine sides. Obtaining a casing or cable confirms that you have parts; a separate experiment checks whether the production line actually works.
codex.chapter.mek_start.subtitle: Metallurgic infuser, steel and steel casing
codex.chapter.mek_start.title: Osmium and First Machines
codex.chapter.missiles.intro.0: The missile add-on builds a guided physical vehicle from a motor, fins, computer and mount. Components must belong to the correct construct and be linked; a single block recipe is not a complete missile design.
codex.chapter.missiles.intro.1: Verify links and attachment without explosive payloads first. Test thrust and proximity fuzes on a separate range after learning Aeronautics physical assembly.
codex.chapter.missiles.subtitle: CBC Aeronautics Missiles: guided rocket weapons
codex.chapter.missiles.title: Missiles
codex.chapter.more_et_side.intro.0: Eternal Tales side objectives include collections, transformations, events and unusual trials. Advancement names do not always precisely describe their checks: an item, equipped set or event ending may be required.
codex.chapter.more_et_side.intro.1: Read the specific action beside each objective and prepare a safe place for game effects. Track rare collections with a checklist and keep explosive or hazardous-food experiments separate from the colony and valuable luggage.
codex.chapter.more_et_side.subtitle: What in Eternal Tales doesn't lead to Unahzaal but is worth the time
codex.chapter.more_et_side.title: Side Paths
codex.chapter.more_explore.intro.0: The atlas follows specific biomes rather than approximately similar scenery. Most destinations are Terralith areas in the Overworld; the final three belong to Eternal Tales. Nature’s Compass searches the selected biome in the current dimension.
codex.chapter.more_explore.intro.1: Record safe approach coordinates and check location names through the interface or F3. Flying high above attractive terrain does not always count as visiting its biome: boundaries use the character’s actual position.
codex.chapter.more_explore.subtitle: Biomes of Terralith and other worlds
codex.chapter.more_explore.title: Atlas
codex.chapter.more_home.intro.0: A home combines a functional workshop, convenient kitchen and resting space. Choose furniture from actually installed mods and preserve access to storage and devices so decoration supports everyday play.
codex.chapter.more_home.intro.1: A Furnicraft archive in the mods folder does not itself mean its datapack is loaded. These quests use available Handcrafted, Refurbished Furniture, Domum Ornamentum and other pack items; no separate pack activation is required.
codex.chapter.more_home.subtitle: Comfort as a discipline of its own
codex.chapter.more_home.title: Home
codex.chapter.more_kitchen.intro.0: This chapter collects actual dishes from different kitchens rather than listing edible names. Farmer’s Delight uses heated cooking pots, ordinary crafting and cutting; specialized MineColonies dishes require the appropriate citizens.
codex.chapter.more_kitchen.intro.1: Consume objectives accept contributions and remove food. Prepare separate submission batches while retaining meals for yourself and the colony; a plated feast or already eaten portion is not currently in inventory for delivery.
codex.chapter.more_kitchen.subtitle: Farmer's Delight, the MineColonies kitchen and Eternal Tales food
codex.chapter.more_kitchen.title: Cookbook
codex.chapter.more_munitions.intro.0: The arsenal accepts separate batches of Create Big Cannons game ammunition. Most objectives Consume submissions, so operational battery stock must be prepared separately.
codex.chapter.more_munitions.intro.1: Do not test shells in residential districts. A trial shot needs a prepared range, compatible cannon, suitable propellant and understood projectile effects; similar-looking diameter alone does not establish compatibility.
codex.chapter.more_munitions.subtitle: Munitions, fuzes and battery supply
codex.chapter.more_munitions.title: Arsenal
codex.chapter.more_qol2.intro.0: Pack conveniences help with navigation, building, loot storage and item understanding. Each tool has its own role: a structure compass does not search biomes, and a trash can deletes stock rather than expanding storage.
codex.chapter.more_qol2.intro.1: Test unfamiliar tools on small clear examples. Inspect energy, materials, filters and undo behaviour before using valuable buildings; visible menu names do not establish a safe configuration.
codex.chapter.more_qol2.subtitle: Gadgets, hammers, bins and everything else that saves hours
codex.chapter.more_qol2.title: New Conveniences
codex.chapter.more_rails.intro.0: The depot services actual Create trains and Steam ’n’ Rails additions. A decorative boiler shapes a locomotive’s appearance, while movement requires an assembled train with bogeys, controls and a route.
codex.chapter.more_rails.intro.1: Test coupling, signalling and supplies on a short section before joining the main line. Accessories submitted with Consume disappear; keep operational depot equipment as a separate reserve.
codex.chapter.more_rails.subtitle: Steam 'n' Rails in all its glory
codex.chapter.more_rails.title: Depot
codex.chapter.more_vanilla.intro.0: Ordinary Minecraft systems remain useful alongside mods: enchanting, trading, beacons and elytra provide independent capabilities. This chapter develops practical applications beyond your first resources.
codex.chapter.more_vanilla.intro.1: Numerical item objectives require the stated stock of one item, while different item types are remembered sequentially. Before expensive crafting, distinguish the finished item, its operational setup and required consumables.
codex.chapter.more_vanilla.subtitle: Vanilla progression the pack won't let you forget
codex.chapter.more_vanilla.title: Old Roads
codex.chapter.offroad.intro.0: Offroad adds wheels and drilling components for physical ground vehicles. Mounts hold tires, rotation drives them, and redstone controls steering and braking. Simulated tools assemble the hull.
codex.chapter.offroad.intro.1: Test a small vehicle on level ground before slopes or tunnels. Excavation needs storage and convenient unloading as well as cutting wheels.
codex.chapter.offroad.subtitle: Wheels, suspension and all-terrain
codex.chapter.offroad.title: Create Offroad: Ground Vehicles
codex.chapter.radar.intro.0: A radar network combines detection, data transfer, target selection and weapon control. Begin with a monitor and an unloaded mount: verify tracks and aiming directions before connecting fire control.
codex.chapter.radar.intro.1: Identification works through configured codes and filters. A transponder or warning receiver alone does not automatically protect a vehicle from every battery.
codex.chapter.radar.subtitle: Detection, air defense and automatic aiming
codex.chapter.radar.title: Create Radar: Targeting
codex.chapter.rs_autocraft.intro.0: Autocrafting executes encoded patterns, while external processing requires explicit output return. The network can send ingredients but does not consider a task complete until expected items come back. Begin with one ordinary recipe and one furnace.
codex.chapter.rs_autocraft.intro.1: Separate raw-item patterns, processing patterns and physical logistics. A monitor reveals waiting, while a small trial batch identifies exactly where processing stopped.
codex.chapter.rs_autocraft.subtitle: Patterns, autocrafters and production chains
codex.chapter.rs_autocraft.title: Refined Storage: Autocrafting
codex.chapter.rs_network.intro.0: Refined Storage combines connected storage into one searchable list. Controllers supply network energy, disks and external containers provide capacity, and a grid accesses contents. Build the first rig with a few inexpensive items while keeping the main warehouse accessible.
codex.chapter.rs_network.intro.1: Owning devices does not establish a working network. Check power, connectivity, item retention and free space before moving valuable supplies. Some Refined Storage 2 rules differ from older guides.
codex.chapter.rs_network.subtitle: Controller, cables, disks and grids
codex.chapter.rs_network.title: Refined Storage: Network
codex.chapter.space_glacio.intro.0: Glacio is in the Proxima Centauri system and requires the fourth rocket tier. Its atmosphere contains oxygen, unlike the Moon and Mars. Cold, terrain and distance from home still require a prepared expedition.
codex.chapter.space_glacio.intro.1: The final map node consumes equipment as a colony contribution. Do not submit the base’s last working devices: separate the donated batch from equipment supporting actual survival and return.
codex.chapter.space_glacio.subtitle: Glacio — the end of the road and the start of a colony
codex.chapter.space_glacio.title: Proxima Centauri
codex.chapter.space_ground.intro.0: The first Ad Astra flight begins with metallurgy, fuel and breathing reserves. Establish electricity, a compressor, steel production and an oxygen loader before crafting the rocket. A rocket carries a prepared expedition rather than replacing preparation.
codex.chapter.space_ground.intro.1: Returning requires a launch pad and separate fuel. Many equipment advancements trigger on obtaining items; launch readiness is checked manually after filling the suit and packing the return kit.
codex.chapter.space_ground.subtitle: Steel, oxygen, fuel and the first rocket
codex.chapter.space_ground.title: Launch Table
codex.chapter.space_hot.intro.0: Venus and Mercury require protection against high temperature and missing oxygen. Wear a complete suitable suit and prepare the return before departure; a tier-three rocket provides transport, not surface protection.
codex.chapter.space_hot.intro.1: Calorite opens this branch’s final transport and flight equipment. Mine it through short prepared outings while preserving breathing reserves and a safe landing site rather than moving the entire base into unfamiliar conditions in one trip.
codex.chapter.space_hot.subtitle: Venus, Mercury and calorite
codex.chapter.space_hot.title: The Hot Planets
codex.chapter.space_mars.intro.0: Mars opens ostrum and more convenient expedition supplies. Arrive with oxygen and a return kit already prepared; new ore supports progression but should not be required to get home.
codex.chapter.space_mars.intro.1: Cryo fuel reduces carried fuel volume, while the energizer services electric equipment. Hot planets require a complete netherite spacesuit and tier-three rocket, so reserve part of the Martian yield for both.
codex.chapter.space_mars.subtitle: Ostrum, cryo fuel and a real colony
codex.chapter.space_mars.title: Mars
codex.chapter.space_moon.intro.0: On the Moon, first secure the return kit and search for desh. Stay near the lander until rocket, pad and fuel are recovered. Lower gravity helps movement but does not replace oxygen reserves.
codex.chapter.space_moon.intro.1: A permanent outpost needs electricity and a sealed room. The oxygen distributor, ventilation and solid cable passages work together; a crafted distributor does not make an open lunar site safe.
codex.chapter.space_moon.subtitle: First step, desh and life under a dome
codex.chapter.space_moon.title: The Moon
codex.chapter.start_first_day.intro.0: Your first day establishes a reliable place to live. Gather wood, make tools and light, then choose a site you can easily return to. A large factory can wait until you have food, shelter and an orderly place for supplies.
codex.chapter.start_first_day.intro.1: This chapter introduces the pack’s carrying tools, backpack, tooltips and map. Learn them with inexpensive items and inspect the result immediately. These conveniences change familiar controls without removing the dangers of night or distant journeys.
codex.chapter.start_first_day.intro.2: Optional quests help prepare a workshop, organise reserves and choose a direction. Item goals use your inventory; confirm manual objectives after carrying out the described check.
codex.chapter.start_first_day.subtitle: Where the pack begins and what not to rush into
codex.chapter.start_first_day.title: First Day
codex.chapter.start_qol.intro.0: The pack’s conveniences save time once you understand their rules. Recipe search helps plan production, sorting clears storage and tooltips explain an unfamiliar block before you dismantle it.
codex.chapter.start_qol.intro.1: Start with JEI and your key bindings. Try other tools when a real need appears: building gadgets suit repetitive construction, while chunk loaders keep equipment active away from the player. Neither needs to be crafted on your first evening.
codex.chapter.start_qol.intro.2: Reference pages are marked manually. Read their limits and run the suggested small check; that is more useful than immediately enabling every available feature.
codex.chapter.start_qol.subtitle: Mods that add nothing to progression but change everything
codex.chapter.start_qol.title: Pack Conveniences
codex.chapter.storage_local.intro.0: Local storage is useful before a digital network and remains convenient afterward. A backpack carries tools, bins hold large stocks of one resource, and Create vaults serve production flows. Choose storage for the actual job.
codex.chapter.storage_local.intro.1: Test automatic upgrades with inexpensive items. Configure deletion particularly carefully: resources removed by a void upgrade do not return when its filter is disabled.
codex.chapter.storage_local.subtitle: Backpacks, chests and everything that needs no network
codex.chapter.storage_local.title: Local Storage
codex.chapter.story_colony.intro.0: Colony development leads from the first constructed workplaces to supply, education, production and a garrison. A hut item is only the beginning: a builder must construct it, and an assigned, supplied citizen performs the work.
codex.chapter.story_colony.intro.1: The book remembers shown blocks, so place them after registration. Inspect citizen requests and actual delivery routes: dozens of prepared huts do not turn themselves into an operating town.
codex.chapter.story_colony.subtitle: The colony from four citizens to a technopolis
codex.chapter.story_colony.title: A City That Grows Itself
codex.chapter.story_current.intro.0: The electrical story links fuel, steelmaking, generation and consumers from different mods. Begin with a clear source and one load, then expand: a large generator cannot fix wrong connectors or blocked outputs.
codex.chapter.story_current.intro.1: Objective titles do not measure performance. Test operating installations in the world, paying particular attention to power isolation, cooling and waste handling before entering nuclear energy.
codex.chapter.story_current.subtitle: Three factories — one power grid
codex.chapter.story_current.title: Current
codex.chapter.story_expedition.intro.0: The expedition line combines several independent adventures into a route through worlds. Cards connect book stages without removing local portals, story conditions, area protection or each mod’s personal advancements.
codex.chapter.story_expedition.intro.1: Before crossing, prepare a return route and space for trophies. Where an advancement depends on an item, acquire it in your own inventory first; where it requires an event, merely visiting the dimension does not finish the story.
codex.chapter.story_expedition.subtitle: Through every world, in the order they open
codex.chapter.story_expedition.title: Expedition
codex.chapter.story_forge.intro.0: The mechanic’s path connects familiar Create machines into one freight route: rotation, material processing, steam power and a train between the base and mining site. Build small working sections and connect them after testing.
codex.chapter.story_forge.intro.1: Wind and water are genuine alternative entrances, as are milling and crushing. Registered ordinary items can immediately be installed; consumable batches must be entirely in inventory now and disappear when submitted.
codex.chapter.story_forge.subtitle: From the first alloy to a train that hauls ore by itself
codex.chapter.story_forge.title: The Engineer's Road
codex.chapter.story_sky.intro.0: The aerial project combines a physical structure, observation, weapon control and supply. Test lift and handling on a small moored platform first, then add equipment and repeat with the increased mass.
codex.chapter.story_sky.intro.1: A radar contact does not mean permission to fire, and a collection of parts is not a completed ship. Configure identification and a safe test sector before loading ammunition; check motion without firing after every modification.
codex.chapter.story_sky.subtitle: Air fleet, artillery and radar — one defense
codex.chapter.story_sky.title: Sky and Powder
codex.chapter.tech2_foregoing.intro.0: Industrial Foregoing automates resource production and farming through machines with configurable working areas. Display that area before each startup and check facing: simply placing a machine beside a field does not establish correct coverage.
codex.chapter.tech2_foregoing.intro.1: Plastic unlocks initial frames, while later tiers require the dissolution chamber and special fluids. Farming and meat-processing byproducts need separate outputs or otherwise sound machines can stop with full internal tanks.
codex.chapter.tech2_foregoing.subtitle: Latex, lasers and farms that run themselves
codex.chapter.tech2_foregoing.title: Industrial Foregoing
codex.chapter.tech2_mektools.intro.0: Mekanism Tools adds ordinary tools and armour made from alternative materials. They wear down as equipment rather than requiring charging like the atomic disassembler. Choose materials that fit available resources and the intended job.
codex.chapter.tech2_mektools.intro.1: A paxel combines several tools, shields provide separate protection, and refined materials require Mekanism machinery. This chapter’s advancements mostly detect obtained items rather than requiring dangerous combat trials.
codex.chapter.tech2_mektools.subtitle: Six materials that beat netherite
codex.chapter.tech2_mektools.title: Mekanism Tools
codex.chapter.tech2_newage.intro.0: Create: New Age connects mechanical rotation, electricity and heat. A coil turns supplied rotation into energy, a motor performs the reverse task, and a heat engine produces rotation from heat. Each conversion has its own costs and limits.
codex.chapter.tech2_newage.intro.1: Begin with a small generator and a tested load. The reactor branch needs a complete enclosure and continuous heat removal; its mechanics differ from Mekanism, so another reactor’s cooling design cannot be copied merely because both share a name.
codex.chapter.tech2_newage.subtitle: Electricity, heat and a nuclear reactor for Create
codex.chapter.tech2_newage.title: Create: New Age
codex.chapter.tech2_petroleum.intro.0: Immersive Petroleum adds underground fluid reservoirs and a separate drilling system. Seismic surveys locate deposits, a derrick opens the well, and a pumpjack uses the completed wellhead after reservoir pressure falls. Placing a pump above an arbitrary chunk is insufficient.
codex.chapter.tech2_petroleum.intro.1: Distillation produces several fluids and bitumen that need separate receivers. In this version the tower’s direct diesel product contains sulfur; clean diesel requires further processing, so inspect exact fluid names.
codex.chapter.tech2_petroleum.subtitle: Oil, wells and what's distilled from them
codex.chapter.tech2_petroleum.title: Immersive Petroleum
codex.chapter.tech2_pneumatic.intro.0: PneumaticCraft uses compressed air rather than an ordinary electrical grid. Compressors fill system volume, machines consume air, and pressure equalises between connected blocks. Open pipe ends leak; exceeding permitted pressure causes destruction.
codex.chapter.tech2_pneumatic.intro.1: Keep the first line short, with a manometer and controlled shutdown. Some chemical processes require heat separately from pressure; plastics, circuit boards and drones gradually add new production methods.
codex.chapter.tech2_pneumatic.subtitle: Pressure, plastic and drones you program yourself
codex.chapter.tech2_pneumatic.title: PneumaticCraft
codex.chapter.tech2_powah.intro.0: Powah provides FE generators, storage and wireless transfer through successive material tiers. Begin with one generator and a clear load; a higher-tier cable does not create energy, and a larger cell only stores existing production.
codex.chapter.tech2_powah.intro.1: Special material processing takes place in an energizing orb through separate rods. The reactor is assembled from a sizeable set of same-tier blocks and uses uraninite; one reactor block is not an operating power station.
codex.chapter.tech2_powah.subtitle: Energy without complications: generators, cells, reactor
codex.chapter.tech2_powah.title: Powah
codex.chapter.trials_bosses.intro.0: Here the book reads player advancements rather than removing loot. Conditions vary: some record combat, others trophy acquisition, while the garrison trial counts colony soldiers.
codex.chapter.trials_bosses.intro.1: Follow each objective’s action description. Claiming a reward does not replace local progression, preparation for a dangerous dimension or checking your own advancement in multiplayer.
codex.chapter.trials_bosses.subtitle: Boss victories the book can notice
codex.chapter.trials_bosses.title: Trials: Trophies
codex.chapter.trials_early.intro.0: Early deliveries teach you to separate operating reserves from goods for exchange. Every consumable objective requires its entire listed batch in your inventory now; turning it in removes the items. A nearby chest does not count.
codex.chapter.trials_early.intro.1: Secure tools, food and planting stock first, then prepare a surplus. Rewards pay for the delivery, not a particular production method: inspect their contents and leave inventory space.
codex.chapter.trials_early.subtitle: Turn in resources — get what speeds the start
codex.chapter.trials_early.title: Trials: First Days
codex.chapter.trials_late.intro.0: Late deliveries use products from long production chains. Fund them from a stable surplus: reactor operation, storage construction and transport maintenance take priority over an immediate reward.
codex.chapter.trials_late.intro.1: The book removes all marked resources. The archive trial accepts storage components that cannot contain your belongings; active network disks are excluded from the delivery.
codex.chapter.trials_late.subtitle: Turning in rare materials at the pack's peak
codex.chapter.trials_late.title: Trials: High Technology
codex.chapter.trials_mid.intro.0: Industrial trials ask whether you can spare finished goods without stopping your own factory. Exact mod items matter here, beyond similar names or recipe compatibility.
codex.chapter.trials_mid.intro.1: Multiple consumable objectives are submitted together: bring every listed type and quantity at once. Owning components does not prove automation; side tasks separately examine supply, output and recovery after a stop.
codex.chapter.trials_mid.subtitle: Machine output in exchange for machines
codex.chapter.trials_mid.title: Trials: Factory Hum
codex.msg.not_enough: Codex: not enough items to turn in
codex.quest.aero_basics.airship.text.0: A Steam Vent supplies steam to a balloon for lift; it is not simply a release valve. Like a steam engine, it needs sufficient heat, water and boiler size. Prepare the requested item and a small airship with an airtight envelope.
codex.quest.aero_basics.airship.text.1: For steam lift, position the vent on its boiler to fill the balloon above. Configure maximum output and redstone input. A first aircraft can initially use the hot-air burner already learned, with steam treated as a separate lifting option.
codex.quest.aero_basics.airship.text.2: Check balance and the ability to reduce lift at low altitude. A Steam Vent in inventory does not establish a flight-ready craft. Do not expect disabling thrust to stop inertia instantly. Prepare a return pad, accessible controls and necessary supply reserves before flying.
codex.quest.aero_basics.airship.title: First Airship
codex.quest.aero_basics.assembler.text.0: A physics assembler creates a construct governed by mass and motion while its blocks remain interactable. Prepare it and a few inexpensive blocks on level ground. Test without an engine or balloon first to separate assembly from flight.
codex.quest.aero_basics.assembler.text.1: Select the intended group with super glue or honey glue, then hold interaction and pull the assembler lever as shown in Ponder. Inspect boundaries, since blocks along diagonal edges may be included. Keep ground, neighboring storage and the platform’s supports outside the selection.
codex.quest.aero_basics.assembler.text.2: Check membership and stability after assembly. Any suitable physics assembler can disassemble it; the original need not remain inside every vehicle. Disconnected sections can split into separate objects, so confirm hull continuity before expanding. This skill supports airships, wheeled vehicles and missile rigs.
codex.quest.aero_basics.assembler.title: Physics Assembler
codex.quest.aero_basics.burner_aero.text: An adjustable burner fills a balloon with hot air and produces lift. It is a specialized aviation block with its own configuration, not an ordinary blaze burner under a basin. Prepare it and a verified airtight envelope above a light construct.

Position the source to serve the balloon above it. Select maximum output on the panel, then scale the output with redstone strength. Begin with a low setting and observe gradual filling instead of expecting immediate takeoff.

Lift is limited by envelope volume and weakens with altitude as air pressure falls. If the craft will not rise, inspect mass, airtightness and settings rather than endlessly adding signal. Test reducing lift near the ground before flying. Combine multiple sources only after understanding one.
codex.quest.aero_basics.docking.text.0: Docking connectors work in pairs to make a rigid link while keeping both sides independent constructs. The single requested connector does not create a dock. Prepare its counterpart, and use compatible connectors or a winch with the required coupling for rope connections.
codex.quest.aero_basics.docking.text.1: Extend docking nodes and align them carefully. They lock once sufficiently aligned, and a comparator can read progress. Item or fluid transfer needs insertion and extraction on both sides rather than merely the lock.
codex.quest.aero_basics.docking.text.2: Retracting either connector undocks. First check that the vehicle can hold position independently. Ropes use a separate connection method, and two winches do not form a valid pair. Test mooring without cargo or abrupt thrust, then add supplies and a landing platform around the verified connection.
codex.quest.aero_basics.docking.title: Docking and Mooring
codex.quest.aero_basics.engine.text.0: A portable engine generates onboard rotation by burning fuel. Its engine assembly comes from sequenced iron-sheet processing: cutting and pressing repeat eight times, with a probabilistic final result. Prepare spare workpieces and a separate byproduct output.
codex.quest.aero_basics.engine.text.1: Craft the black engine and test it on the ground with one machine first. Insert suitable fuel, choose rotational direction and inspect output. A blaze cake permits enhanced operation but is unnecessary for the initial trial.
codex.quest.aero_basics.engine.text.2: Once installed aboard, confirm that source, transmission and fuel supply belong to the intended physical construct. An onboard engine does not remove fuel use or mechanical stress. Check stopping and restarting before takeoff; running out far from the pad may disable the propellers used for control.
codex.quest.aero_basics.engine.title: Portable Engine
codex.quest.aero_basics.envelope.text.0: Envelope blocks enclose a volume that creates lift when filled with hot air or steam. The sixteen white blocks requested are starting supplies, not a guaranteed balloon for any payload. Prepare a light gondola and mark a closed envelope above it.
codex.quest.aero_basics.envelope.text.1: Build airtight walls while preserving useful interior space. Sources fill balloons from the top downward; a hole or unsuitable shaft passage prevents retention. Shafts can be encased with envelope blocks through the supported method.
codex.quest.aero_basics.envelope.text.2: Solid blocks inside reduce available volume, so a timber-filled balloon is not equivalent to an empty one. Check airtightness before increasing heating or cargo. Dye changes color rather than balloon capacity. Once assembled, the envelope becomes part of a lift system with a hot-air burner or steam source.
codex.quest.aero_basics.envelope.title: Airship Envelope
codex.quest.aero_basics.flight_service_b: A compass aids orientation, but an ordinary one points toward world spawn rather than automatically toward your new airfield. Prepare the requested item and separately record pad coordinates. Use a suitable binding for the desired destination if that option is already available.

Mark a visible landmark beside the landing area and choose a short route from which the pad remains recognizable. Check the compass direction on the ground instead of discovering its actual meaning only after takeoff.

The objective neither consumes the compass nor proves travel. Its batch wording concerns a navigation item, not airship manufacturing. Before flying, inspect fuel, lift control and return route. The next quest requires takeoff, turning, landing and checking changed behavior with cargo.
codex.quest.aero_basics.flight_service_r: Manually take off, turn, return to the original pad, and check loaded behavior and thrust shutdown

The final trial checks a complete short flight-control cycle. Choose a clear pad, remove valuable cargo and prepare a small known load for the second part. Inspect attachments and fuel before startup.
Take off, turn and return to the original pad. Check behavior with cargo and disabling thrust before a longer journey. Watch inertia: removing a movement command does not stop the hull instantly.

Confirm manually only after the in-world trial; the Codex does not automatically measure flight. If cargo causes roll or lowers reachable height, correct its placement and lift, then repeat briefly. Avoid increasing distance and mass simultaneously before a successful return. A verified result supports longer routes, but retain resources for the trip back.
codex.quest.aero_basics.flight_service_s: A test pad is needed before lifting valuable cargo. The two leads requested are preparatory supplies, but ordinary leads are not universal physical-ship mooring devices. Use compatible rope or docking systems for that purpose.

Choose a clear site near the base, mark the starting position and prepare a broad landing area. Check the light hull, control access and ability to reduce lift. Retain a safe alternative approach if the craft lands nearby.

Enable systems separately at first: lift, horizontal thrust, then directional correction. The item objective does not observe these actions. Check tree and wire clearance before continuing. Add cargo after control is verified rather than using it as improvised ballast for an unexplained unstable craft.
codex.quest.aero_basics.goggles_aero.tex: Aviator’s goggles help read flight information that is difficult to estimate from the horizon alone. Craft and equip them in a supported slot. Test on a familiar craft beside the pad rather than during a dangerous long journey.

Inspect available readings while parked and during a small movement. Compare height and position changes with world landmarks. Exactly which information appears depends on the supported construct and installed interface.

Goggles are neither an autopilot nor fall protection; they support observation. If an expected value is absent, check equipment and physical assembly state. Learn the information layout before the first loaded flight. Also retain ordinary return coordinates, since instruments do not replace a planned landing site.
codex.quest.aero_basics.guide_loaded_doc: Manually complete a short freight flight, dock, and transfer the full batch into stationary storage without disassembly or hand-carrying

An air-freight journey ends with reliable docking and unloading, not merely flying over the base. Prepare a small known load, a tested dock and free stationary storage. Distribute mass evenly while retaining control access.

Make a short flight, return and align connectors gently. Wait for locking, then transfer cargo through configured insertion and extraction on both sides. Check the final chest quantity and connection stability during unloading.

Confirm manually after the whole cycle without disassembling the craft or carrying cargo between inventories. Removing mass can change how the craft responds to the previous lift setting, so inspect its mode before undocking. This trial links aviation to actual supply and reveals where fuel reserves and maintenance access are needed.
Return to the Dock with Cargo
codex.quest.aero_basics.guide_sensor_sig: Manually verify altitude and both tilt-axis signal directions on a ground rig before connecting thrust

A sensor can amplify an error if its signal controls an actuator in the wrong sense. Prepare altitude and gimbal sensors, lamps or visible indicators, and a small ground-based physical construct. Keep thrust disabled.

Change height or tilt slightly and compare output with the desired correction. Check altitude limits and inversion, and each gimbal axis. Record which signal should reduce lift or restore orientation.

Confirm manually once both responses are understood and command direction matches the actuator. Only then enable limited correction near the ground. If oscillations increase, disable automation and recheck feedback direction instead of increasing force. A correct sensor in the wrong circuit does not become a reliable autopilot.
codex.quest.aero_basics.gyro.text.0: A gyroscopic propeller bearing helps maintain propeller orientation and suits some stable aircraft designs. One item does not lock every heavy ship motionless. Prepare the bearing and gyroscopic mechanism, then choose a small verified construct.
codex.quest.aero_basics.gyro.text.1: Replace or supplement the ordinary propeller assembly according to Ponder. The bearing attempts to keep its propeller upright; block orientation and mass placement still matter. Redstone can reset tilt, so do not connect it without understanding the intended mode.
codex.quest.aero_basics.gyro.text.2: Observe a slight roll without cargo first, then add small balanced loads. If the craft oscillates, inspect placement and thrust rather than expecting complete stabilization. Effectiveness changes with altitude. Retain manual correction and safe descent after a successful trial before relying on stability during a long flight.
codex.quest.aero_basics.gyro.title: Gyroscopes
codex.quest.aero_basics.levitite.text.0: Levitite helps keep a physical construct afloat but does not make it gain altitude by itself. Its heated mixing recipe uses four end stone powders, two zinc nuggets and 500 mB of water, producing 500 mB of blend. Prepare a bucket and a crystallization area.
codex.quest.aero_basics.levitite.text.1: Pour the blend into a chosen mould and initiate heat-driven crystallization as shown in Ponder. The reaction spreads through connected fluid, destroying certain mould blocks. Once catalyzed, the fluid cannot be recollected.
