Waiting nearby or placing a campfire beneath an ordinary zombie does not explain the required interaction.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.text.2: Collect and register the Hulk Hammer before spending trophy loot on Chemical X. Its advancement checks the potion in inventory. Conduct transformation experiments in a separate arena with an escape route.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.title: Chemical X
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.task.0: Read: every weapon has its own arc and its own reach
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.0: Practise your weapon’s movements against ordinary enemies before hunting. Better Combat changes animations and attack sequences by weapon type; a polearm, quick blade, and heavy axe need different spacing. Start in an open area without pets or villagers.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.1: Make one attack, observe its delay and reach, then try a short sequence. Watch target positioning and safe retreat timing. Broad swings help against groups but need careful aim near allies. The damage number alone does not describe how the whole movement handles.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.2: After practising, manually confirm the statement about attack arcs and reach. This marks control preparation, not guaranteed boss success. Bring a familiar weapon into difficult arenas and test new trophies at home before depending on their rhythm.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.title: The New Combat
Craft the Animal Dictionary before searching for rare Alex’s Mobs creatures. Combine a book, green dye, and a suitable animal material, such as a Roadrunner Feather, Bear Fur, or shed Moose Antler. An arbitrary vanilla bone is not sufficient.

Open the entry for a nearby animal and identify its habitat, food, and useful interactions. Many resources come from shedding, feeding, or rescue; killing the first specimen may be less useful than observing it.

Let the book register in inventory, then use it as a field journal. Start in a familiar biome and record a reliable population. Later taming needs several foods, so establishing a food supply at home saves repeated searching.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.dictionary.title: Animal Dictionary
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.0: Frostmaws sleep in snowy regions. Scout the approach and choose clear retreat space without deep drops. Bring dependable armour, healing, and a weapon suited to short attacks after dodging.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.1: Once it awakens, watch its freezing breath and broad strikes. Avoid standing in front of its face: freezing makes the next hit especially dangerous. Move around the creature and heal during safe openings rather than treating a pause as victory.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.2: This card requires killing Frostmaw and separately obtaining an Ice Crystal. Acquiring the crystal through stealth alone does not complete the combat advancement. Collect the trophy and test its freezing breath on ordinary enemies while watching durability, then repair before visiting the savanna.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.title: Frostmaw
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.guide_blowgun.te: Nagas from Mowzie’s Mobs live on rocky shores: where beaches meet mountains or hills, and on stony coasts. They attack from the air, spit and dive, so prepare a bow or crossbow, a shield and a roofed spot to retreat to. The kill counts personally, and a naga drops fangs.

Craft a blowgun from bamboo and two strings; darts come from a naga fang, a stick and a feather, eight per recipe. A dart poisons its target, so the weapon suits hunting and weakening dangerous creatures at range, not finishing sturdy bosses quickly.

For the mark, show the book the blowgun and eight darts at the same time, then use them as intended. Check the dart’s range and drop on a stationary target before trusting it in combat. Leftover fangs go into the naga fang dagger, a fast blade from the same hunting branch.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.guide_creeper_mi: Hatch a Creeper Minion from its egg

When a Mutant Creeper dies, a minion egg remains at the battle site. It does not fit in the inventory: walk up, sneak and right-click, and the egg settles on your head to be carried home. Until it hatches, keep it away from explosions and falls and stay out of new fights.

After a while the egg hatches, and the Creeper Minion is already tamed to whoever defeated its parent. The pet follows you, can ride on your shoulder, and its explosion, blast radius and block destruction are configurable. The advancement is granted at hatching, not when the egg is picked up.

The Creeper Minion Tracker is crafted from a creeper shard and four iron ingots. Use it on the pet to open a panel with its name, health, blast radius and explosion mode. Disable block destruction near buildings. The shard drops from the same Mutant Creeper, so both items of this branch come from a single hunt.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.guide_grottol.ta: Kill a Grottol with a Silk Touch pickaxe
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.guide_grottol.te: The Grottol is a small armoured creature of deep caves that flees and burrows into stone the moment it notices a player. A plain kill only earns the kill advancement; the value lies elsewhere: a Silk Touch pickaxe leaves a captured grottol, and a Fortune pickaxe rolls the diamond drop double-or-nothing. Prepare the right pickaxe in advance.

Look for grottols in deep caves of any biome except mushroom fields; they favour dark stone hollows and are easy to spot by their glittering shell. Block the escape routes and strike quickly: the creature vanishes into rock within seconds. Do not use explosives, which destroy the prize as well.

A captured grottol smelts into one diamond in a furnace or blast furnace; showing it to the book is enough for the mark, and you can smelt it afterwards. This is not a diamond farm but a rare find, and it teaches matching the tool to the creature: almost every Mowzie’s Mobs beast wants its own approach.
Steal the ice crystal from a sleeping Frostmaw while invisible

The ice crystal need not be won in battle: it can be stolen from a sleeping Frostmaw. The beast dozes beside its crystal in snowy plains and wakes when it notices a player. The mod hands the crystal to whoever comes right up to it while invisible, so brew a potion of invisibility and budget its duration for the approach and the retreat.

The crystal rests by the front paws, and you must be closer than two blocks. Sneak in from the crystal’s side, wait for it to jump into your inventory, then withdraw at once. A woken Frostmaw remains dangerous, although by the mod’s description it loses its ice breath without the crystal.

The advancement is granted at the moment of theft; the book requires no separate item, but the crystal stays with you and counts for the Frostmaw card. Stealing is enabled in this pack’s settings. It is the safest route to a crystal for a player without heavy armour, yet it does not replace the personal kill the neighbouring card demands.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.text.0: Ambergris rewards rescuing a Cachalot Whale stranded during a thunderstorm. Search suitable ocean coasts and gently push the animal into water without hurting it. Killing a whale does not replace this rescue reward; clear its route to the sea.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.text.1: Craft an Echolocator from Ambergris to reveal nearby caves. It has limited uses, so use it where you already intend to explore underground and plan a safe descent. It is not a universal structure finder.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.text.2: After detection, upgrade it with four Ender Pearls into an Endolocator. This reveals a nearby End Portal around a stronghold rather than locating distant strongholds across the world. Reach the area with ordinary Eyes of Ender first. Register the two locator stages sequentially.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.title: Echolocation
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.mutant_gear.text: Build the Mutant Skeleton Chestplate from separate bones. Two Shoulder Pads and four Limbs make Arms; six Ribs make a Rib Cage. Combine the Arms above the cage, collecting scattered pieces after battle.

Mutant Endermen leave Endersoul Fragments when defeated. Right-click fragments to claim them, then toss an Eye of Ender while nearby: owned fragments within eight blocks transform it into an Endersoul Hand. More fragments provide more initial durability. Attacking them is dangerous.

Obtain a Creeper Shard after defeating a Mutant Creeper. Retreat from its final explosion and return only after the dangerous animation ends. Register the three items sequentially, and practise telekinesis and explosive abilities away from your base.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.0: The Sculptor’s challenge begins with a Bluff Rod, obtained from stone Bluff creatures. Find the Sculptor and bring food plus a safe approach route. Register the rod before offering it; the configured entry price is one rod.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.1: Climb the generated platforms to the top. Placing or breaking blocks, flying, and teleporting are forbidden: this challenge checks the route, so ordinary shortcuts cause failure. Judge jump distances and choose each platform carefully.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.2: At the summit, right-click the Sculptor to finish. Reaching the height without interacting is insufficient. Wait for the advancement and obtain the Earthrend Gauntlet, then practise its abilities away from buildings. Killing the Sculptor does not replace successfully completing his challenge.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.title: The Sculptor's Trial
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.task.0: Tame a grizzly bear with honey and salmon
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.0: Prepare honey and salmon for a Grizzly Bear. Let it become honey-sated through a beehive, then offer salmon to tame it. A hungry predator is dangerous, especially near cubs.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.1: Find Gorilla groups in jungles. Bananas drop from Jungle Leaves; gather several and feed your chosen gorilla until tamed. Check both advancements separately because friendship with one species does not complete the other.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.2: The Falconry Glove belongs to a different animal: the Bald Eagle of wooded mountains. Tame it with Fish Oil, then use the glove to hold and launch it at a target. Owning the glove does not prove an eagle is tamed. Bring companions to a protected enclosure and practise commands before travelling.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.title: Taming
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.text.0: The Transmutation Table requires two Farseer Arms, a Nether Star, and Obsidian. Farseers appear near the world border, so defeating the Void Worm only begins transport preparation. Transform a Dimensional Carver into its Shattered version inside a Capsid and prepare your return route.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.text.1: The shattered carver travels enormous distances in the chosen direction; repeated trips approach the border. Farseer beams bypass familiar defences, so use cover instead of standing still. Collect both arms and bring them home.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.text.2: Place the table permanently. It exchanges the entire input stack for one of three offers at an experience cost and learns from supplied items. Test a small cheap stack first. Breaking it erases its knowledge and causes a powerful explosion, returning only the Nether Star.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.title: Transmutation Table
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.0: Obtain Sun’s Blessing peacefully before attacking Umvuthi. Find a savanna settlement, obtain an Umvuthana Mask, and wear it in the helmet slot. Approach the calm leader: the mask enables trading while he is not fighting.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.1: This pack’s first trade costs seven Gold Blocks. Open the trade, pay, and wait for the Sun’s Blessing effect and advancement. Register this peaceful stage before planning combat; a dead leader cannot bless you at that settlement.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.2: For the fight, bring full protection, healing, and room to avoid solar beams and summoned warriors. Collect Sol Visage after a personal victory. Blessing, victory, and the mask are separate checks, so the trophy cannot prove a skipped peaceful interaction.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.title: Umvuthi
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.0: Summon the Void Worm in the End by throwing a Mysterious Worm directly into the void. Craft a Mosquito Larva from a Maggot and Mosquito Proboscis, then transform it inside an Enderiophage’s Capsid. Let the resulting worm register before consuming it.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.1: Choose a large island with clear sightlines, fall protection, healing, and ranged equipment. Attack the head: damaging body segments splits the worm and complicates the encounter. Avoid chasing every segment beyond the island.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.2: A personal victory completes the advancement. Collect the eye and mandibles for a Dimensional Carver with its Netherite component. The carver opens a route to spawn with a return portal lasting about a minute. Test this limited-use evacuation tool near home before relying on it.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.title: Void Worm
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.wroughtnaut.text: Find the Ferrous Wroughtnaut in its underground stone chamber. Bring a strong melee weapon, food, and enough room to circle its wide axe swings. Blocking the entire arena with obstacles removes your manoeuvring space.

Ordinary hits against its protected body accomplish little. Bait the heavy attack that leaves the axe stuck and exposes its back, circle behind, and strike the vulnerable area. Retreat after the short opening and repeat while watching attack preparation.

Register a personal victory and collect both Wrought Axe and Wrought Helmet. These item checks are separate from the advancement. Practise the axe’s broad attacks away from pets and villagers, then replenish healing before the Frostmaw expedition.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.acropolis.tas: Find the Acropolis above a warm ocean
Personally defeat Scylla, the Storm Empress
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.acropolis.tex: Cataclysm’s Acropolis generates in warm oceans, and the Storm Eye locates it. Prepare transport, fall protection, armour, and healing. Mark a safe arrival point before exploring exposed platforms and connecting passages.

Defeat Clawdian, then find Scylla and replenish supplies before another encounter. Interacting with inactive Scylla starts her fight, so avoid accidental clicks during scouting. Dodge lightning, thrown weapons, and hazardous areas while retaining movement space.

Collect four Lacrima and two Essence of the Storm, accumulating each type together. The card also requires both personal victories and Acropolis discovery. Once detected, allocate materials to weapons and later recipes; spending loot does not remove the guide’s saved marks.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.all_bosses.ta: Personally defeat all eight Cataclysm bosses
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.all_bosses.te: Cataclysm’s final advancement requires eight personal victories: Netherite Monstrosity, Ender Guardian, Harbinger, Ancient Remnant, Leviathan, Scylla, Maledictus, and Ignis. Additional foes such as the Ender Golem and Clawdian have their own cards but are outside this particular list.

Open the advancement and compare its criteria with your expedition log. For each missing boss, prepare the correct dimension, locator eye, awakening item, and fresh healing. Transferred weapons or trophies do not satisfy player-killed-entity conditions; check registered battle results.

Finish remaining arenas one at a time and bring loot home between attempts. Wait for the combined advancement after the last victory and retain your route notes. Further repeats then serve materials, new weapon builds, or personal challenges.
Find the Burning Arena in the Nether
The Burning Arena generates in Nether Wastes and is located with a Flame Eye. Prepare Fire Resistance, strong armour, healing, and a familiar weapon. Defeat the Ignited Revenant first and collect Burning Ashes without spending them on random experiments.

Place the ashes on the arena’s Altar of Fire to summon Ignis. The offering is consumed. Inspect the arena and refill supplies beforehand: Ignis uses long dangerous sequences, and some attacks require sidestepping instead of merely holding a shield.

Collect Ignitium and materials for The Incinerator after personal victory. Let three ingots register before allocating them to weapons and armour. Revenant and Ignis victories are separate advancements; expensive gear from someone else’s chest cannot replace them.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.burning.title: Burning Arena
Find the Ruined Citadel in the End
Locate a Ruined Citadel on the outer End islands with a Void Eye. Prepare fall protection, strong armour, healing, and a reliable route back to the gateway. A large stone structure does not eliminate void hazards around the island.

Explore the citadel, defeat the Ender Golem, and then reach the Ender Guardian. Watch area attacks and emerging rune hazards, repositioning instead of standing still through dangerous sequences. Recover health and durability between encounters.

This card requires both personal victories and structure discovery. Collect the Gauntlet of Guard and Void Core from the relevant battle loot; one does not complete the other objective. Reserve the core for Infernal Forge fusion and test the gauntlet safely away from home.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.citadel.title: Ruined Citadel
Wake and personally defeat the Harbinger
The Ancient Factory lies underground in the Overworld, and a Mech Eye locates it. Descend safely and leave supplies outside. Prepare a Nether Star before meeting the Harbinger; it is a consumed awakening item, not arena decoration.

Use the star on the inactive Harbinger when ready. Avoid rockets, laser lines, and charges, attacking between sequences. Do not assume a narrow entrance enables unlimited damage from any distance; fight within the intended area.

Collect Witherite after victory and accumulate four ingots for detection. Craft the Mechanical Fusion Anvil for weapon combination. Discovery, boss victory, material, and workstation are separate objectives, so verify each before spending all the loot elsewhere.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.factory.title: Ancient Factory
Find the Frosted Prison in snowy plains
The Frosted Prison stands in snowy Overworld plains, located with a Cursed Eye. Bring substantial protection, healing, and durability reserves. Explore gradually, marking exits and safe intermediate rooms; this is a large combat expedition rather than sightseeing.

The Strange Key drops from Aptrgangr and opens the Door of Seal. Let it register before use. Continue toward Maledictus beyond the opened passage and recover before entering the main chamber; winning the earlier encounter does not guarantee readiness.

Avoid grabs, strikes, and ranged sequences, retaliating during pauses. After personally defeating the boss, collect three Cursium Ingots together. Check the boss advancement separately from the key and structure discovery, then bring the metal back to your prepared cache.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.frosted.title: Frosted Prison
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.0: The Void Forge combines trophies from different dimensions. Prepare an Infernal Forge from the Netherite Monstrosity and a Void Core from the Ruined Citadel. The operation requires the Mechanical Fusion Anvil from Ancient Factory progression.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.1: Use the Infernal Forge as the base and Void Core as the addition, then collect the fusion result. Inspect the output before confirming; a vanilla anvil and arbitrary void material cannot substitute. Both inputs become part of the new weapon.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.2: Test the Void Forge away from animals and buildings. Using it on a block summons a fan of Void Runes, so keep allies out of the area ahead. The quest detects the item; a short practical test establishes its reach before your next difficult hunt.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.title: Fusion
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.guide_black_s: Black steel is the first Cataclysm metal that turns into tools at an ordinary crafting table. The sword takes two ingots and a stick, the pickaxe three ingots and two sticks, in the familiar iron-tool shapes. The targe, a small shield, is built differently: an ingot in the centre, four planks on the sides and four nuggets in the corners; nuggets come from an ingot at the same table.

Gather your stock from abandoned snowy structures and draugr drops, then craft the items one by one. Tracking is historical: after the mark you may use the tools rather than keep them untouched. Unwanted black steel gear smelts back into a nugget in a furnace or blast furnace, so part of the material returns.

Hold the targe in the off hand and raise it with the right button like a normal shield. Test its block on simple mobs before relying on it against a boss. This branch does not replace netherite gear, but it gives a clear intermediate kit for trips into the mod’s first structures, where black steel is found most often.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.guide_cursium: Cursium drops only from Maledictus: three or four ingots per victory. The Frosted Prison card merely checks that you have them, so the same ingots can be put to use. The cursium upgrade template is crafted with a netherite upgrade template in the centre, two black steel ingots at the sides and six gold ingots above and below.

At a smithing table combine the template, a netherite helmet and one cursium ingot. The other netherite armour pieces upgrade the same way; a full set costs four ingots, which may mean more than one fight with Maledictus. Cursium and black steel also make weapons: the Soul Render with its rush attack and the Cursed Bow that fires three phantom arrows.

Start with the helmet: one piece shows whether the remaining metal should go into armour or weapons. Do not melt netherite pieces for experiments and do not hand the ingots to consuming cards elsewhere until you have decided what matters more. The finished set is a real step up before the Burning Arena and Ignis.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.guide_eyes.te: The eight Cataclysm eyes are the only reliable way to find a specific structure. Each is crafted around an Eye of Ender from materials hinting at its purpose: the Eye of Monstrous needs two lava buckets, two netherite scrap and blackstone, while the Eye of Desert uses gold, an emerald, chiseled sandstone, cactus, a dead bush, bone and rotten flesh. JEI shows the exact layouts.

Use an eye in the dimension where its structure generates: the Eye of Monstrous works in the Nether, the Eye of Desert in Overworld deserts. Once thrown, the eye flies toward the target like an Eye of Ender heading for a stronghold and then vanishes; the item itself stays in your hand, so throw again every few hundred blocks until the direction is obvious.

Having both items once is enough for the mark; the book does not consume them. Craft them before hunting the Netherite Monstrosity and the Ancient Remnant so you never wander at random. Record coordinates as soon as you find a structure: the “find” advancement triggers on entering its bounds, and the fight itself can wait until you are fully prepared.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.guide_wither_: Test both firing modes at an open range away from any buildings

The Wither Assault Shoulder Weapon is a ranged weapon made of witherite from the Ancient Factory. The recipe places two witherite ingots in opposite corners, four gunpowder and a block of redstone in the centre. Witherite is also needed for the factory card and the Mechanical Fusion Anvil, so decide in advance how many ingots the weapon may take.

The right button fires Wither Missiles; sneaking while firing launches heavy howitzer shells. Both modes hit an area, so run the first test on open ground far from your base, animals and colony. Check the range, the spread and whether the shells break blocks, so you know where the weapon helps and where it endangers the shooter.

Confirm the manual objective only after trying both modes. The cannon works well against dense groups on Cataclysm arenas but does not replace melee in tight corridors where the blast catches you too. Keep it in a separate slot for open spaces and never fire near loot chests.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.ignitium.text: Ignitium armour upgrades Netherite equipment with a smithing template. Craft the template from a Netherite Upgrade Template, Nether Bricks, and Blaze Powder. Let it register, then prepare Netherite helmet and chestplate plus Ignitium Ingots.

Upgrade the pieces at a Smithing Table and inspect retained properties. The Elytra Chestplate additionally needs ordinary Elytra and a Mechanical Fusion Anvil: combine the completed Ignitium Chestplate with the wings. This follows smithing rather than attaching wings to an empty template.

Collect the helmet and combined chestplate, then test flight and protection safely. Two items do not demonstrate a complete armour set. Maintain repairs and rockets so the rare equipment supports future expeditions rather than remaining a one-time collection trophy.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.text.0: These two objectives concern smaller Cataclysm creatures and interaction items. Craft a Netherite Effigy from a Netherite Ingot, Totem of Undying, redstone, gold, and Nether Bricks. Prepare it at home and let it register before use.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.text.1: Remnant Skulls occur in Ancient Remnant and Modern Remnant loot. After item detection, use the effigy or skull on a clear surface: the item is consumed and creates a Netherite Ministrosity or Modern Remnant respectively. Leave enough room or creature placement fails.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.text.2: Tame the Ministrosity with a Lava Power Cell and the Modern Remnant with a Sniffer Egg. Prepare these expensive items in advance, then check behaviour and pet commands. Keep the creature protected near home; spawning and taming are distinct steps even though this card only requests the original items.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.title: Pets
Find the Cursed Pyramid in the desert
Wake the Ancient Remnant by brushing the suspicious sand, then personally defeat it
The Cursed Pyramid generates in Overworld deserts and is located with a Desert Eye. Bring a brush, strong weapons, protection, and food. Preserve suspicious sand while exploring; mining it destroys archaeological loot needed to awaken the boss.

Brush the sand until you obtain the Necklace of the Desert. Let it register, then use it on the inactive Ancient Remnant. It is a consumed awakening key; merely finding the large statue does not complete victory.

Avoid charges, stomps, and hazardous sand areas, striking after attack sequences. Collect personal victory loot, including material for Sandstorm in a Bottle, and complete that recipe. You need no replacement necklace for its saved mark, though another summon requires its offering.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pyramid.title: Cursed Pyramid
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.0: For early Cataclysm materials, explore the Overworld rather than searching everywhere for matching ores. Black Steel comes from abandoned snowy structures and Draugr, while Ancient Metal appears in desert structures and Koboleton loot. Prepare a shield, weapon, and room for separate batches.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.1: Collect four ingots of each metal together by type. Both types need not remain present simultaneously after detection. Craft the Belt of the Beginner separately from leather and an iron ingot for accessible starter equipment.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.2: Scout a smaller structure and bring its loot home before planning a major boss. The first card does not imply every Cataclysm enemy suits early iron gear. The Soul Blacksmith expedition requires substantially stronger protection, healing, and Fire Resistance.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.title: First Find
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.soulforge.tas: Find the Soul Forge in the Nether
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.soulforge.tex: The Soul Blacksmith generates in the Nether. Craft a Monstrous Eye to locate it, record coordinates, and secure the approach. Bring Fire Resistance, enchanted armour, healing, and a weapon suited to a prolonged close fight.

Find the Netherite Monstrosity and clear smaller enemies from your route before the main battle. Avoid area strikes, lava attacks, and straight charges. Attack during openings and move away after your own sequence.

Collect the Infernal Forge after personally defeating the boss, checking structure discovery and victory separately. Despite its name, the forge item is a weapon rather than an industrial machine. Save it for later fusion with the Ruined Citadel’s Void Core at the Mechanical Fusion Anvil.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.task.0: Find the Sunken City in a deep ocean
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.task.2: Summon and personally defeat the Leviathan
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.0: Locate the Sunken City in deep Overworld oceans with an Abyss Eye. Prepare sustained Water Breathing, underwater mobility, lighting, and protected air reserves. Scout the entrance and local enemies while preserving a separate route to the surface.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.1: Craft an Abyssal Sacrifice for Leviathan using a Heart of the Sea, Nautilus Shell, Athame, coral component, and valuable material blocks. Let it register, then place it on the Altar of Abyss when ready; summoning consumes the offering.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.2: Track Leviathan’s movement and major attacks without neglecting air. Collect victory loot and craft Tidal Claws. Visiting the city, obtaining the sacrifice, personally winning, and crafting claws are distinct results; complete and check them in sequence.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.title: Sunken City
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.task.1: Manual: form and power the bottling machine, supply water and an empty bucket and collect the filled bucket at the belt output.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.text.0: The bottling machine fills containers and performs fluid recipes, including shaping duroplast. It is a multiblock whose conveyor directions matter. Form it by hammering the central belt, supply fluid to the metal tank ports and power to the upper connection on the opposite side.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.text.1: For the first trial, provide water and an empty bucket. Wait for a filled bucket at the output and collect it rather than leaving it on the floor. This tests belts, power and fluid input independently without spending expensive resin.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.text.2: Mark the manual objective after actually filling a container. The machine may hold larger containers while a continuous supply fills them; that does not necessarily mean the belt is stuck. The manual explains the switchable waiting behaviour. For fuel and resin, use a separate line later or fully account for remaining water before changing fluids.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.title: Bottling Machine
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.text.0: A garden cloche grows supported plants in a compact device using water and electricity. Prepare the required seeds and soil: not every plant accepts every substrate. Choose a familiar crop from the available cloche recipes for the first start.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.text.1: Place the device, connect power through its designated plugs and water through the fluid input. Insert soil and planting material into the central slots. Wait for harvest in the right-hand output slots and provide a receiver at the front hatch on the glass section.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.text.2: Fertilizer speeds growth, but verify ordinary operation before adding it. If production stops, inspect soil compatibility, water, power and output space. A dedicated seed cloche helps the oil line, but compare its own energy use and crop rate with squeezer demand rather than treating it as an unlimited free farm.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.title: Garden Cloche
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.task.1: Manual: form the generator, supply accepted fuel and verify increasing receiving-storage energy while fuel is consumed.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.text.0: The diesel generator turns accepted fluid fuels into substantial electrical output. First establish a biodiesel reserve and independent startup power for the squeezer, fermenter and refinery. The generator should not be the only power source in a completely discharged fuel-production system.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.text.1: Assemble radiators, pipes, engineering blocks and scaffolding from the manual, then form the machine with the hammer at the specified point. Fuel enters lower corner ports and power leaves the upper connections. Total output is divided among connected plugs, not multiplied by their number.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.text.2: Connect a load or partly empty storage and verify fuel consumption alongside rising energy. The generator need not run without an accepting output. Mark the manual objective after that test, then watch whether farming replenishes consumption. A steadily shrinking fuel reserve means insufficient supply even while the generator still sounds normal.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.title: Diesel Generator
Duroplast is made from phenolic resin and serves as an insulator in electrical components. Its chain starts with ethanol: the refinery converts it into acetaldehyde with a silver-plate catalyst. The plate is not consumed, but the stage cannot run without it.

Another refinery recipe then combines twelve units of acetaldehyde and eight creosote into eight resin. Separate the stages between installations or clear incompatible inputs first. Send finished resin to the bottling machine and feed a plate mould as the item ingredient.

Every two hundred fifty units of resin produce a duroplast plate and return the mould. Four plates require one thousand in-game fluid units. Collect both outputs: losing the mould stops repetition. An ordinary metal press without resin does not replace this operation.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.duroplast.title: Duroplast
Manual: form and power the fermenter, process a supported crop and output ethanol into separate storage.
The fermenter turns suitable farm products into ethanol. Build the multiblock from its layout and hammer the central cauldron on the control-port side. Supply power, crop input and a separate reservoir that is not connected to squeezer oil.

Use potatoes or sugar cane for a first trial: each produces eighty units of ethanol in the installed recipe. Different crops give different yields, so do not compare farms by item count alone. Blue-marked input hatches are at the back, and fluid leaves beneath the orange item output.

Produce ethanol and verify transfer to storage before manually confirming. If processing stops, inspect power, fluid level, item leftovers and the panel’s redstone signal. When using honey bottles, provide for returned glass bottles; a secondary item can also halt production.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.fermenter.title: Fermenter
The current biodiesel recipe has a third mandatory participant: saltpeter dust. It belongs in the refinery’s catalyst slot; oil and ethanol remain in their tanks without it. Obtain the dust through an available recipe or processing suitable material, checking JEI’s options.

Open the biodiesel recipe and verify the exact catalyst before insertion. A silver plate belongs to acetaldehyde production and does not replace saltpeter. The catalyst is not consumed, and the manual specifies manual installation, so no automated dust feed is needed.

Check that the item remains in its slot after a completed reaction. This small supply addresses a common reason for an idle refinery with full fluid inputs. If it still does not run, inspect power, correct fluids, output and control signal instead of adding stacks of catalysts.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.guide_fuel_rest: Manual: keep a separate biodiesel reserve, restore generation from it on an isolated load and replenish the reserve.

A fuel line can become trapped: a generator without biodiesel cannot power the machines that make biodiesel. A separate filled jerrycan and charged capacitor allow recovery. Prepare the reserve before the experiment rather than after the whole base stops.

Fill a jerrycan with biodiesel through supported storage and keep it outside automatic consumption. On a small isolated load, stop normal generator supply and use part of the reserve to restore operation. Do not discharge the entire shared grid for the trial.

Mark the manual objective after successful restart and replenishing the saved reserve. An empty jerrycan is not fuel backup; check its fluid type and quantity. If fuel still declines after restarting, fix the long-term oil, ethanol and energy balance: emergency filling solves startup, not a permanent deficit.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.guide_oil_seeds: A dedicated seed reserve separates oil production from incidental harvests. Use industrial hemp for this experiment: its seeds suit the squeezer and produce one hundred twenty units of oil each in the installed recipe. Prepare field crops or a compatible cloche.

Accumulate sixty-four seeds while retaining a separate planting reserve. With a cloche, verify soil, water, power and free space for the plant’s other products. Send only seeds to oil production and store fibre separately for fabric and engineering items.

The item objective checks stock without consuming it or proving farm throughput. After detection, compare seed replenishment with consumption while the diesel line runs. If oil falls faster than it recovers, expand cultivation or reduce load; additional empty tanks only postpone a stoppage.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.task.1: Manual: form and power the mixer, combine water and redstone dust and extract redstone acid separately from input water.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.text.0: The industrial mixer combines a fluid with item ingredients. It makes redstone acid, certain chemicals and bulk potions. Build and form the multiblock from the manual’s layers, preserving access to fluid ports and item input.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.text.1: For a clear first trial, make redstone acid: one redstone dust and two hundred fifty units of water produce the same amount of acid. Supply water, dust and power, then direct the result into a separate reservoir. Keep finished acid off the water input line.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.text.2: After producing and extracting the result, mark the manual objective. If the machine holds multiple fluids, inspect the selected output mode instead of assuming every attached tank receives only the desired product. Before changing recipes, account for residual fluid and ingredients, otherwise the next process may wait on incompatible inputs.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.title: Industrial Mixer
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.refinery_ie.tas: Manual: form and power the refinery, install saltpeter, supply oil and ethanol, obtain biodiesel and check continued operation after extraction.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.refinery_ie.tex: The IE refinery mixes fluids and uses catalysts. Biodiesel requires plant oil from the squeezer, ethanol from the fermenter and saltpeter dust in the catalyst slot. That dust is mandatory in this installed version but is not consumed by the reaction.

Build the structure and form it by hammering the heavy engineering block in the middle layer. Fluids enter the two side ports and product leaves the front orange port. The recipe combines eight oil and eight ethanol into sixteen biodiesel; supply both lines and electricity.

Obtain a bucket of biodiesel and verify continued operation after removing it, then mark the manual objective. If both tanks are full but nothing happens, check the catalyst and redstone control first. Older arrangements without saltpeter are incomplete for this version and cannot run this reaction.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.task.1: Manual: form and power the squeezer, process seeds and output plant oil into separate storage.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.text.0: The squeezer extracts plant oil from suitable seeds and also processes certain solid materials. Build the multiblock from the manual and activate it by hammering the central wooden barrel on the control-port side. Prepare electricity and separate oil storage.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.text.1: Feed seeds through the blue-marked rear inputs. For example, an industrial hemp seed produces one hundred twenty units of oil in the installed recipe. The item output is marked orange, with fluid output beneath it; do not attach the oil pipe to the item hatch.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.text.2: Run a small batch and mark the manual objective after oil appears and reaches a container. Reserve seeds for replanting. This machine also makes graphite dust through a separate recipe, so not every input produces fluid; check the selected process first.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.title: Squeezer
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.text.0: The IE buzzsaw uses a replaceable sawblade and suitable fluid fuel. The requested tool is only the base, so craft an ordinary blade separately and install it through the engineer’s workbench. Fill the saw with biodiesel or another accepted fuel.
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.text.1: Begin with a small tree away from a wooden base. Check which connected blocks the felling mode affects and prepare space for dropped timber. Avoid testing bulk felling on a tree directly joined to decorative construction.
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.text.2: The blade wears out, while lubrication and tank upgrades solve different limits. A rockcutter blade changes the tool’s role to clean stone harvesting and is no longer an ordinary tree-felling blade. Check the installed attachment before changing jobs: one filled saw does not work equally well on every material.
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.title: Buzzsaw
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.text.0: The chemthrower sprays its loaded fluid and can ignite flammable substances. Begin with water rather than fuel so you can learn range and controls without setting the workshop on fire. Fill it through compatible fluid storage or a bottling machine.
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.text.1: Open available settings and check the pilot flame state. Test a short spray in a clear area while watching fluid consumption. Different substances have different game effects, so a bucket’s appearance does not establish safety for plants, animals or structures.
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.text.2: Account for old fluid remaining in the tank before changing liquids. Herbicide damages vegetation and soil, while fuel with ignition enabled threatens the base. Use such modes only in a prepared in-game area with a clear purpose and a way to stop spraying; crafting the chemthrower does not require a hazardous ignition trial.
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.title: Chemthrower
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.text.0: The handheld IE drill runs on biodiesel and requires an installed drill head. Craft the tool body and steel head for this objective, then place the drill in the engineer’s workbench to fit it. An empty electrical battery is not the issue here: the engine needs fluid fuel.
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.text.1: Fill the drill through supported storage or a bottling machine. Test on a small stone patch and inspect the selected head’s working area. Use the supported single-block restriction near utilities and valuable walls.
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.text.2: The head wears independently of fuel and can be repaired on an anvil. A standard drill does not operate underwater without the compressed-air upgrade. Bring spare fuel and monitor head condition before mining; plenty of biodiesel will not rescue a broken working part.
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.title: Drill
Manual: use the maintenance kit to replace a drill head, retain the old head and verify mining one stone block.

A maintenance kit is useful only with a compatible spare part. Bring an assembled drill, replacement iron head and the kit itself for this check. Choose a safe place outside combat, and do not break your only tool needed to escape a mine.

Open the kit’s portable interface and replace the drill head. Keep the old one for later anvil repair. Confirm that the new head is actually installed rather than merely moved to a neighbouring inventory slot, then mine one ordinary stone block.

Mark the manual objective after replacement and successful mining. The kit neither fills an empty fuel tank nor creates spare parts, so a jerrycan remains a separate expedition supply. Before returning to bulk mining, inspect the new head’s working area: changing its material can change tool characteristics.
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.text.0: The floodlight, electric lantern and maintenance kit solve different everyday jobs. The lantern receives power directly through LV wire and lights a work area; the floodlight casts directional light and needs its own power plus the correct control state.
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.text.1: Place a lantern by a walkway and aim the floodlight towards a distant work area. The hammer changes floodlight direction and the screwdriver changes supported redstone behaviour. If light stays off, check both electricity and signal instead of replacing a working lamp.
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.text.2: The maintenance kit performs supported tool adjustments and servicing away from the workbench, such as changing a drill head. It is not universal free repair for every item. Bring a replacement part and test the available interface before travelling: a kit without the required spare cannot remove wear.
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.title: Odds and Ends
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.text.0: The accumulator backpack carries electrical reserves for tools and armour. In this installed version the crafted frame needs an accumulator fitted through the engineer’s workbench. Start with suitable storage and inspect the backpack’s contents before treating it as a working battery.
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.text.1: Install the accumulator, charge the backpack at a station and equip it in a supported way. For the first trial, hold a partly discharged tool and watch energy transfer. The charging station itself must receive power through the correct input.
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.text.2: The pack can attach to compatible bodyarmour, but the manual warns that the combined item cannot be charged at the station in the same way. Test a separate backpack first. By default it serves held tools and worn armour; charging the whole inventory requires the corresponding upgrade rather than happening automatically.
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.title: Powerpack
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.text.0: The railgun accelerates a selected projectile item using electricity. Prepare a charging station or working accumulator backpack and compatible projectiles such as iron rods. Crafting the weapon neither charges it nor adds ammunition to your inventory.
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.text.1: Charge the railgun, select the intended projectile type and test against a safe target. Hold use until charging is ready, then release; verify exact controls and ammunition switching in pack settings. Avoid accidentally using expensive electrodes as your first test projectile.
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.text.2: The weapon consumes both energy and the launched item. Different projectiles may have special effects, so keep a clear firing lane and backstop. Its small internal reserve makes an accumulator backpack useful, but first confirm that the backpack actually contains a charged accumulator.
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.title: Railgun
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.text.0: The revolver is a weapon with separate cartridges, assembled from engineering parts. This objective needs the revolver and a hammer component; retain the specified part until detection even if other copies went into crafting. Ammunition is made separately using the appropriate blueprint.
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.text.1: Open the cylinder with the supported sneaking interaction and insert compatible cartridges. Start with an ordinary cartridge type on a safe target with a backstop. Different rounds have different effects, so avoid mixing unfamiliar ammunition before testing.
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.text.2: Gunfire attracts hostile attention and consumes cartridges; a charging station cannot fix an empty cylinder. A speedloader helps reloading, and further upgrades fit at the workbench. After testing, take the weapon out of your active hand in the workshop and store hazardous ammunition separately from everyday supplies.
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.title: Revolver
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.text.0: Shaders change the appearance of compatible engineering equipment rather than replacing functional upgrades. A common shader bag contains a random shader. The manual lists crates, villager trading and certain boss rewards as acquisition routes; use one already available to you.
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.text.1: Obtain a common bag and let the inventory objective register it before opening. Inspect compatible equipment and fit the chosen shader through the dedicated engineer’s-workbench slot. Some decorative objects use a separate interaction directly in the world.
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.text.2: Do not expect increased damage, fuel capacity or speed from a new pattern. Higher-rarity bags can be crafted into lower-tier bags through available recipes, but this changes the chance of rare designs. This branch is optional for industrial progression and suits a small collection after the workshop is equipped.
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.title: Shaders
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.text.0: The engineer’s skyhook travels along supported wires and cables. Use the requested structural steel cable for a safe first route: it is not an electrical wire. Set supported attachments between two low platforms with easy dismounting points.
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.text.1: Stretch the cable and hook on while standing nearby. Travel along the short span, checking junction steering and controlled dismounting. Grabbing a cable after a large fall can cause injury from sudden deceleration, so do not begin by jumping off a tower.
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.text.2: Live electrical wires are dangerous without the insulated-grip upgrade. Even with protection, a safe landing point is needed; releasing the hook or sneaking can dismount you. Learn on a low non-electrical route first, then extend towards distant sites without blocking conveyors or machine-service access.
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.title: Skyhook
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.text.0: Steel armour provides ordinary material protection before complex electric equipment. Prepare steel ingots from the blast furnace and craft the chestplate using its recipe. Avoid spending the last steel reserved for a tool if the armour is currently only a spare.
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.text.1: Equip the chestplate and compare protection and durability with your current equipment. It works without fuel or charge but wears during combat. Fill other armour slots appropriately for an ordinary protective set and leave room for tools.
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.text.2: Steel does not provide Mekanism radiation shielding or replace Faraday electrical protection. Choose equipment for the actual hazard rather than its material alone. This chestplate makes a useful clean-base reserve while your main set is repaired or charged for the next expedition.
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.title: Steel Armor
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.text.0: Gun and chemical turrets automate defence of a selected area. Before supplying power and an enabling signal, configure ownership, target lists and allied exclusions. Distinguish blacklist and whitelist modes carefully: identical names mean different things under different modes.
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.text.1: A gun turret needs compatible cartridges and space for casings; a chemical turret needs an accepted fluid and the correct pilot-flame mode. Supply resources through the lower and rear ports described in the manual. Start with the installation disabled and inspect possible firing directions.
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.text.2: Test activation in a separate in-game area without villagers, pets or passing players. Provide accessible emergency shutdown and a safe backstop. Owning both turrets completes the item objective but does not establish correct targeting; check each separately before defending the base and prevent fire towards your own structures.
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.title: Turrets
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.task.1: Manual: form and power the arc furnace with three electrodes, run a recipe, collect its product and check the slag output.
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.text.0: The arc furnace smelts metals and processes alloy recipes in parallel. Build its layers from the manual and form it by hammering the cauldron. Supply substantial power through the rear connectors, prepare three graphite electrodes and separate destinations for product and slag.
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.text.1: Main materials occupy the left inputs, additives have dedicated right-hand slots and electrodes sit above. Choose a simple verified recipe and small batch for the first operation. Metal leaves at the front and slag at the back; full outputs prevent continued work.
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.text.2: Electrodes wear during operation and require manual replacement: automatic ore supply does not make the furnace maintenance-free. Monitor remaining durability and keep spare electrodes nearby. Mark the manual objective after successful smelting, product collection and checking the slag output; a crafted electrode without a formed furnace does not demonstrate startup.
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.title: Arc Furnace
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.task.1: Manual: form both machines; run an ordinary assembler recipe and a blueprint recipe in the automated workbench, collecting both outputs.
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.text.0: The assembler repeats ordinary crafting recipes, while the automated engineer’s workbench follows IE blueprints. These are two different multiblock machines, both built from the manual. Do not search for finished inventory items: prepare their structural parts and form each at its own hammer point.
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.text.1: The assembler stores up to three sequential recipes and can use one recipe’s output in the next. Begin with a simple wooden item, supplying materials and energy. In the automated workbench, insert an appropriate blueprint, select its output and supply ingredients; products leave at the conveyor’s end.
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.text.2: Verify that each machine produces at least one item and delivers it to an accessible output, then mark the manual objective. Do not mistake a blueprint for an ordinary assembler pattern. If either stops, compare selected recipe, actual ingredients, power and redstone control before complicating storage routing.
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.title: Assembler
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.text.0: Conveyors move items through the workshop as a visible stream. A basic belt moves items already placed on it but does not extract from every chest without suitable extraction. Prepare eight belts and check a short line’s direction before building a large route.
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.text.1: The item router distributes cargo by filters, while the batcher releases configured complete sets. Begin with two inexpensive materials and separate destinations. Belt directions and filters must agree, otherwise items reach the wrong machine or remain on the line.
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.text.2: Check a full destination and protect dropped items from sitting until they despawn. Covered belt variants and clear walkways help where players pass nearby. Batch delivery is particularly useful for multi-ingredient recipes because it prevents one resource from occupying all input space.
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.title: Conveyors
Manual: form and power the crusher, process cobblestone and collect gravel through its intended output.
The IE crusher processes ores, metals and certain building blocks. Prepare the manual’s layered materials and form the structure by hammering the central fence on the long side with the control input. Power enters the plug on the upper shoulder, while items enter the drums.

Fence off the upper intake: living entities inside take severe damage. For the first trial, drop in one cobblestone block and collect the result at the lower front output without entering the machine. Mark the manual objective after actual processing and product retrieval.

An iron ore block gives two dust and a possible byproduct, while raw iron gives one dust with a chance of an additional one. This is not guaranteed doubling of every input. If the crusher stops, inspect power, recipe, output and the panel’s redstone signal; a screwdriver can reverse control behaviour.
codex.quest.ie_machines.crusher_ie.title: Crusher
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.task.1: Manual: form the engine and bucket wheel at a surveyed vein, supply power and collect mined output at the rear.
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.text.0: The excavator extracts minerals from a surveyed IE vein and gradually reduces its available yield. Choose a location from core samples, then prepare two structures: the engine and bucket wheel. Their relative placement is shown in the manual, with mining occurring at the wheel’s lower edge.
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.text.1: Build and form the engine by hammering the rear central heavy engineering block; a correctly positioned wheel joins the formation. The wheel can also form separately by hammering its central steel block. Supply power through side connectors and prepare the rear product output.
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.text.2: Fence off the moving area, run a trial and collect output in storage before manually confirming. Spoil does not necessarily indicate a fault: its proportion depends on placement and saturation. Monitor energy, output space and vein depletion; the excavator does not create unlimited ore from any patch of world.
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.title: Excavator
codex.quest.ie_machines.guide_electrode_: The arc furnace needs manual replacement of worn electrodes. Prepare a separate reserve of three so a stoppage does not surprise you, and store it near safe interface access. Electrodes also serve some weapon uses, so keep maintenance stock separate from ammunition.

In this installed version, the squeezer compresses eight coke dust into one HOP graphite dust. The bottling machine forms an electrode from four such dust, a rod mould and one thousand units of creosote, returning the mould. Prepare this chain rather than searching for an old rare-blueprint recipe.

Stop the furnace before servicing, inspect all three working electrodes and replace worn ones manually. The objective itself does not consume your spares. Afterwards, check ordinary smelting and slag removal: electrode maintenance does not fix a blocked output or insufficient power.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.task.4: Manual: form the press, install the plate mould and produce an iron plate from an ingot while supplying FE.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.text.0: The metal press shapes metal using exchangeable moulds. Build the multiblock from the manual and activate it by hammering the piston. Energy enters above the piston and items travel on conveyors; belt direction matters for the correct input and output.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.text.1: Craft plate, rod and wire moulds using the required blueprint at the engineer’s workbench. Apply a mould to the press and feed a suitable metal. Test an iron plate: the installed recipe uses one iron ingot, while the mould remains in service instead of being consumed with the metal.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.text.2: After a successful operation, verify delivery to the output inventory and mark the manual objective. Change moulds deliberately before a new batch. Iron rods and copper wire have separate recipes and yields; owning three moulds does not mean the press makes all variants simultaneously.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.title: Metal Press
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.text.0: IE mineral veins are separate deposits for an excavator, not merely visible ore blocks in a cave. Survey tools detect traces in natural soil and stone. Take readings at separated locations: samples too close together do little to refine the deposit centre.
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.text.1: After finding a suitable area, place a core sample drill on solid ground, supply energy and start it. Extract the core manually once drilling finishes. Water, air and artificial structures do not substitute for a suitable mineral-survey site.
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.text.2: Inspect composition and saturation, record coordinates and compare neighbouring locations before building the excavator. Better placement increases useful material relative to spoil. The item objective requires the tools, drill and core, but one random sample does not establish an economically useful deposit.
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.title: Ore Survey
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.task.1: Manual: form the silo and fluid tank; test insertion and extraction of items and fluid through their intended ports.
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.text.0: A silo holds many items of one type, while the large tank holds one fluid. These are separate multiblocks built from sheetmetal and supports according to the manual. Choose their roles first, such as seeds in the silo and creosote in the tank, to keep working flows separate.
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.text.1: Build both structures and form them with the hammer. Silo items enter at the top or bottom and are extracted below. Tank fluid enters through the upper or lower port and is extracted through the bottom centre block; a redstone signal can enable automatic output.
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.text.2: The installed manual lists capacities of 41,472 items for the silo and 512 buckets for the tank. Test a small insertion and retrieval of each resource, then mark the manual objective. A comparator monitors fullness but cannot stop upstream production unless connected to its control.
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.title: Storages
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.text.0: An LV capacitor stores energy between generation and machines. It bridges a short wind interruption or accumulates enough power to run a core drill. It neither generates energy nor increases a weak transmission line’s capacity.
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.text.1: Place the block, configure sides with the hammer and connect a source to an input and a consumer to an output. Compare face markings with the manual, especially after rotating the block. With the consumer disconnected, storage should rise; then attach a small load and verify discharge.
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.text.2: If the battery is full but the machine is idle, inspect the output face, connector and machine energy port. If reserves fall whenever anything runs, compare average generation with demand. Later network tiers require compatible capacitors or transformers; randomly joining unlike wires does not create a voltage transition.
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.title: Capacitors
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.text.0: A kinetic dynamo converts an IE water wheel’s rotation into electricity. The wheel itself has no FE output, so it needs the generator beside it. Place the dynamo first, then attach the wheel to its mechanical side as shown in the manual.
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.text.1: Arrange water flow around the wheel so it drives rotation instead of merely surrounding it with still source blocks. As you adjust the channel, watch speed and actual energy entering a capacitor. Up to three IE water wheels can share one shaft in a row.
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.text.2: Connect wire to the dynamo’s electrical output while preserving access to the water channel. An arbitrary Create shaft is not a substitute: the dynamo accepts IE’s own rotational sources. If the wheel turns but storage stays empty, inspect dynamo orientation and the electrical link separately from water.
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.title: Dynamo and Water Wheel
codex.quest.ie_power.guide_grid_diagnosi: Manual: verify unloaded capacitor charging, supply to one operating machine and transfer interruption with the breaker.

For grid diagnosis, choose one generator, one capacitor and one ordinary machine. Disconnect other branches while retaining safe access to readings. The aim is to distinguish absent generation, incorrect routing and insufficient power under load without building another power station.

First charge the capacitor with the machine disconnected. Then run a short known batch and observe storage and voltmeter readings. A full battery beside a starving machine points to output, connector or wire problems; falling storage with working transfer means consumption exceeds generation.

Open the breaker to confirm supply stops, then restore the original arrangement. Mark the manual objective after all three observations: unloaded charging, loaded operation and controlled disconnection. Do not deliberately burn a wire through overload; compare readings with its current manual limits.
codex.quest.ie_power.guide_insulated_rou: Insulated low-voltage wire helps where a power route runs close to a workstation. Prepare insulated copper coils from the recipe and choose a short replacement section. Do not replace a live wire: disconnect sources and account for storage on both sides.

Remove the old connection with wirecutters and stretch insulated wire between compatible LV fittings. Maintain a clear span and safe connector placement. Insulation addresses wire contact hazards but does not increase its permitted energy throughput.

Restore power and test the same load as before. If a wire disappears under load, investigate overload rather than insufficient insulation. Do not test safety by deliberately touching it; confirm the wire type and correct connection instead. The next experiment distinguishes transmission trouble from inadequate generation.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.task.1: Manual: form the lightning rod from the manual, install its steel mast and connect its energy output to storage.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.text.0: IE’s lightning rod is a multiblock power station, not Minecraft’s ordinary copper lightning rod. Assemble the base from the manual’s layers and form it with the hammer at the specified point. No finished multiblock inventory item is required: construction parts become the installation in the world.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.text.1: Stack steel fences above the top port to form a tall mast; widening its top into a fence network improves the chance of capturing a strike. Connect side energy outputs to storage able to accept a burst and maintain safe observation distance.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.text.2: Generation depends on weather and lightning strikes, so this is supplementary power rather than guaranteed continuous factory supply. Mark the manual check after forming the base, installing the mast and checking the output connection. A real storm is useful to observe, but summoning lightning with commands or risking a player is unnecessary.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.title: Lightning Rod
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.text.0: Wire work begins with isolation and safe routing rather than trying to survive a shock. A breaker switch opens a controlled connection, a voltmeter reports electrical values, and Faraday armour has limited protective mechanics. The requested chestplate alone is not a complete suit.
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.text.1: Install the breaker in a test line and verify that transfer stops. Measure available readings with the voltmeter before and after opening it. Account for downstream storage: disconnecting a generator does not mean the entire section has no energy left.
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.text.2: A complete Faraday suit is intended for its supported voltage conditions, not universal HV safety; a strong discharge can be especially dangerous. Do not test this with your body. Use insulated wires where available, route other wires away from walkways and verify the absence of active transfer before tool contact.
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.title: Safety
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.text.0: A thermoelectric generator produces energy from a temperature difference across opposite sides. It requires no dynamo rotation. Prepare one hot and one cold source from supported fluids or blocks, checking their properties in the manual.
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.text.1: Place the sources opposite each other across the generator. Two adjacent faces do not form the required pair: heat in front and cold at the side may not give the expected result. Connect output to storage and observe actual generation.
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.text.2: Protect the surroundings from lava and changes to the cold block. If the cold source melts or is replaced, reassess the temperature difference. This generator suits small steady loads, but actual output depends on the chosen pair; adding connected wires will not make it replace a diesel generator.
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.title: Thermoelectric Generator
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.text.0: Transformers link different wire-grid tiers. A normal transformer connects LV and MV, while an HV transformer connects MV and HV. They do not generate energy or replace storage, so first prepare a source and tested consumer on opposite sides of the transition.
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.text.1: Place the transformer with access to both connections and attach the permitted wire types. The manual shows sides and placement variants. Two identical tiers are not the correct transformer pair; use an appropriate connector or relay simply to continue a line.
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.text.2: Test with a small load before connecting the rest of the workshop. The lower-tier section still limits permitted power: an HV trunk does not make a thin LV tail immune to overload. Position transitions so every wire stays outside walkways and remains serviceable with power disconnected.
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.title: Transformers
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.text.0: An IE windmill rotates a kinetic dynamo, which produces electricity. Prepare the dynamo separately from the requested items. Place it first, attach the windmill to the appropriate side and leave open space in front of the blades.
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.text.1: Eight cloth sails improve the blades’ effective surface. Apply them to the placed windmill as described in the manual and observe speed changes. Obstructions in front reduce performance, while rain and storms can strengthen wind; height alone does not describe the full mechanic.
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.text.2: Connect the dynamo to a capacitor and check generation in ordinary weather. Avoid building tightly around the site after a successful trial: a decorative wall can spoil airflow. Carrying a windmill and eight sails confirms equipment, not connection to a generator.
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.title: Windmill
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.text.0: High-voltage grids serve large consumers and distant power routes. Steel wire coils and HV connectors belong to their own voltage tier. Before installation, plan a route where accidental wire contact is impossible and servicing points remain safe.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.text.1: Connect compatible source and destination devices, using an HV transformer where a transition to MV is needed. Do not connect HV wire directly to an LV connector. Check the manual for permitted span, wire throughput and each connected fitting’s limit.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.text.2: Ordinary insulated LV and MV variants do not automatically solve HV protection. Use distance and disconnect the line for work; a Faraday suit is no reason to touch high voltage. With several generators, total flow through a shared span can exceed its limit even when individual sources operate normally.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.title: High Voltage
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.text.0: A low-voltage grid suits early machines and small generators. Craft a copper wire coil and two LV connectors. Put one connector on an enabled source output and the other on a consumer’s energy input; a decorative relay cannot replace the connector here.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.text.1: Use the coil on the first fitting, then the second. The wire needs a clear route without intersecting blocks. Confirm that the consumer gains energy and inspect the source before adding branches.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.text.2: An uninsulated live wire can shock anything touching it. Keep it outside walkways or use the available insulated LV variant. Wire capacity and connector limits are separate constraints, with current values shown in the manual. Several sources can overload a shared span even when each individual connection is valid.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.title: Low Voltage
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.text.0: Medium voltage uses electrum wires and MV fittings. It helps expand a workshop when low-voltage transmission becomes limiting. First confirm that generation is sufficient: new wire does not increase a water wheel’s output.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.text.1: Craft an electrum coil and two MV connectors, then prepare compatible connection points. Join them with a separately testable line and measure consumer supply. Connecting an existing LV section requires a transformer, not a differently coloured relay.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.text.2: Keep uninsulated wire away from contact areas; an insulated MV option is available. Check the shared line’s total load because branches add together. If the problem persists, inspect connector or machine-port limits before replacing every cable with a higher tier; the actual bottleneck may occupy only one section.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.title: Medium Voltage
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.text.0: The crude blast furnace turns iron into steel using high-carbon fuel. Prepare twenty-seven blast bricks, iron and coke or suitable charcoal. The structure is a solid three-by-three-by-three cube activated with the hammer at the centre of a side face.
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.text.1: Load material and fuel through its interface. Steel production also makes slag, so clear both outputs regularly. This furnace needs no electrical cable, and ordinary coal should not be assumed equivalent to its permitted fuels.
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.text.2: Collect sixteen steel ingots. The crude furnace does not support automated inputs or outputs: an external hopper does not remove manual servicing. Upgrade the furnace later for continuous supply; for now, keep coke nearby and remember that accumulated slag can halt production even with plenty of iron remaining.
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.title: Blast Furnace
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.text.0: The coke oven produces coke and creosote without electricity. Craft twenty-seven coke bricks, build a solid three-by-three-by-three cube and use the hammer on the centre block of a side face. Once formed, open its interface rather than trying to ignite an individual brick.
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.text.1: Load coal for coke or logs for charcoal. In this installed version the oven processes batches of up to sixteen coal or eight logs simultaneously; the process is slow, so keep batches well supplied. Collect sixteen coke for the objective.
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.text.2: Creosote accumulates separately and needs removal, otherwise a full tank stops production. The oven does not automatically push out fluid: use containers or a pump to extract it. Save creosote for treated wood and coke for the blast furnace; both are useful outputs of one installation.
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.title: Coke Oven
codex.quest.ie_start.components.text.0: Iron, steel and electronic components recur in engineering machine recipes. Prepare plates, wire and the appropriate blueprint as well as ingots. Hand tools suffice for the first small batches; the industrial press comes later.
codex.quest.ie_start.components.text.1: Craft eight iron components, eight steel components and four electronic components. Check each specific recipe: similar-looking parts are not interchangeable, and an electronic component is not made simply by adding redstone to a finished steel one. Some operations use blueprint recipes at the engineer’s workbench.
codex.quest.ie_start.components.text.2: Keep the three stocks separate and inspect the next multiblock’s material list in advance. This reduces return trips to the bench while building. Once components are needed continuously, an automated workbench can repeat the relevant blueprints, but completing the chain manually once is useful first.
codex.quest.ie_start.components.title: Components
codex.quest.ie_start.guide_creosote_drai: A coke oven stops when creosote has nowhere to go. A pump and separate barrel turn manual emptying into a clear extraction system. Prepare pipes and place the barrel where its level is easy to inspect without approaching wires or exposed lava.

Configure the pump’s lower faces with the hammer: input towards the oven, output towards the barrel and unnecessary connections disabled. The pump operates with an enabling redstone signal; electricity engages higher-pressure transfer. Verify actual fluid movement rather than just connected pipe models.

Remove accumulated creosote and wait for the coke batch to continue. The barrel is finite too: use the fluid for wood or expand storage when surplus is persistent. This branch resolves a specific steel-supply stoppage and prepares a controlled creosote reserve for graphite and chemistry.
codex.quest.ie_start.guide_hot_blast.tex: Preheaters accelerate the improved blast furnace by supplying hot air. They do not replace coke or act as universal upgrades for the crude furnace. Prepare two devices and an electrical grid that can power them alongside the workshop.

Place one preheater at each intended side port of the improved furnace. Supply power through the correct plugs and compare the same recipe with heating disabled and enabled. Use identical iron amounts and clear outputs for a meaningful comparison.

If acceleration is absent, first inspect placement and power, then fuel and slag. A faster furnace consumes coke sooner, so make sure coke production and creosote removal do not become the next bottleneck. Two crafted preheaters confirm equipment; actual acceleration must be observed on the working combination.
codex.quest.ie_start.guide_improved_blas: Manual: form an improved blast furnace, feed iron and coke from above and receive steel at the front and slag at the back.

The improved blast furnace removes the crude furnace’s manual-input limitation. Craft twenty-seven reinforced blast bricks and prepare the top hopper. Before rebuilding, stop the old furnace and remove iron, fuel, steel and slag to preserve its contents.
