codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.text.0: The scuba mask works with an oxygen tank that is not listed among the objectives; craft and fill it separately. The jetpack uses hydrogen, while free runners use energy. Each needs its own resource, so owning the equipment alone is insufficient.
codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.text.1: Electrolysis of water conveniently supplies oxygen and hydrogen; use the appropriate equipment-filling slots. Charge the free runners and check enabled modes. The pack includes jetpack accessory integration, but verify the actual slot and controls in the equipment interface.
codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.text.2: Test breathing beside the shore and flight just above level ground. Watch gas reserves and keep an ordinary route out of the water. Free runners help movement and falls, but checking remaining charge is still necessary before a large drop.
codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.title: Breathing and Flight
codex.quest.mek_gear.security.text.0: The security desk helps manage access to supported Mekanism devices. It is useful on a shared base where some machines are personal and others serve the team. Begin with an ordinary test device so you do not accidentally block service access to an important line.
codex.quest.mek_gear.security.text.1: Craft the desk, open owner settings and select an appropriate access mode. Add trusted players deliberately and verify behaviour on a device using the intended security setting. Wireless frequencies also have access settings that must be aligned separately.
codex.quest.mek_gear.security.text.2: Machine security does not replace server land protection or prevent every form of world damage. Leave the owner a clear way to recover access, especially for power and teleporters. This objective confirms desk crafting; a working access policy requires configuration and checks on the actual devices.
codex.quest.mek_gear.security.title: Security
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.text.0: A fuel assembly is an internal reactor component; fissile fuel itself enters as a chemical. Prepare the chain without starting the reactor: enrichment produces yellow cake, and the chemical oxidizer turns it into uranium oxide. Separately dissolve fluorite with sulfuric acid to obtain hydrofluoric acid.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.text.1: The chemical infuser combines uranium oxide and hydrofluoric acid into uranium hexafluoride. The isotopic centrifuge converts that into fissile fuel. Check chemical names in the tanks: a similarly named fluid cannot use a chemical input without the required conversion.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.text.2: Run separate lines and power every stage. Owning the five requested devices does not establish a working chain. Before feeding the reactor, keep production stopped or direct output to permitted storage; cooling and waste handling must be ready before the first reaction.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.title: Fuel Assemblies
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.text.0: Fusion requires deuterium and tritium rather than uranium-based fissile fuel. An electric pump with a filter upgrade produces heavy water, which electrolysis separates into deuterium and oxygen. Evaporate brine into lithium, convert it to chemical form and use a solar neutron activator to produce tritium.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.text.1: Prepare both continuous supply lines and enough tritium for nighttime. Build the reactor according to its layout with ports and a laser focus matrix. Fill a hohlraum with D-T fuel, insert it into the controller and prepare a laser pulse with sufficient stored energy as indicated by the installation.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.text.2: Before firing, enclose the beam and verify energy removal or water cooling with steam output for your chosen mode. Keep fuel injection within proven supply. Initial ignition does not establish sustained operation: watch temperature and both fuels after the starting hohlraum is spent.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.title: Fusion Reactor
Manual: without fuel, verify that the emergency control withdraws operating permission and leaves the reactor stopped.

Test reactor control before its first fuel load. Leave fuel input disconnected and confirm there is no fissile fuel inside. Prepare the control adapter, a separately accessible emergency button or lever and a clear reactor-state indication.

Enable operation permission, then withdraw it using the emergency control. Verify that the reactor enters its stopped state and cannot restart from an unrelated machine’s constant signal. For temperature automation, separately trace the signal from the sensor to the control input.

Mark the manual objective after actually checking shutdown on the cold empty installation and restoring a controlled state. Codex does not measure this circuit. The trial does not prove cooling capacity under load; water, steam removal and spare waste capacity must be checked independently before admitting fuel.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.guide_complete_h: The previous node introduced the gown and instruments; now prepare all four Hazmat pieces. A complete set is needed before working near a possible radioactive release. Check each recipe and do not substitute ordinary metal armour for missing boots.

Craft the mask, gown, pants and boots, registering the different items sequentially, then equip the complete set in the appropriate slots. Check that no familiar equipment remains in a slot after changing. All four pieces are required together for protection during work, not for the Codex’s persistent item checks.

Record clean instrument readings and designate a safe cabinet for a spare set. Do not enter contamination merely to test protection: the check is the set’s composition and equipped pieces. Contamination is addressed by stopping releases and allowing time; the suit protects its wearer within its mechanics.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.guide_heavy_wate: The deuterium line begins with heavy water from an electric pump fitted with a filter upgrade. It does not come from a brine evaporation tower. Prepare the pump, filter, power and an accessible water source beside the future fuel workshop.

Install the upgrade and check the output fluid’s name. Send heavy water through mechanical pipe to an electrolytic separator; the installed recipe turns two heavy-water units into two deuterium and one oxygen. Both chemical outputs need free capacity.

If deuterium stops arriving, inspect the separator’s oxygen tank as well as the pump. A small buffer reveals interruptions before a reactor loses its flame. This branch establishes deuterium supply separately; tritium still requires lithium, solar activation and storage for the nighttime pause.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.text.0: Radiation protection requires a complete set of suitable equipment. The gown requested here is only one piece: also craft the Hazmat mask, pants and boots, and wear the entire set before entering the site. Ordinary armour does not replace radiation shielding.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.text.1: A Geiger counter measures environmental radiation, while a dosimeter measures the player’s accumulated exposure. Take baseline readings in a clean area and learn to distinguish the two. A protective suit does not remove world contamination or erase a dose already received.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.text.2: Keep a spare set outside the reactor room. If a release is detected, do not approach unprotected and stop the source by a safely available method. Owning one gown and the instruments completes the item portion, but does not establish protection: check every equipped piece before working.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.title: Hazmat Suit
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.text.0: A fission reactor heats coolant and produces radioactive waste. Build the shell from its layout, place fuel assemblies with control rods above them and configure ports for fuel, coolant, heated output and waste. The requested casing count does not replace a complete structure plan.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.text.1: Before loading fuel, fill the cooling system and prepare steam reception and safe waste capacity. Configure a logic adapter to control operation, then test the emergency circuit on the cold reactor: withdrawing permission must stop it. Monitoring and control may need separate adapters.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.text.2: Start at a low burn rate and watch temperature, damage, coolant and waste. Stop the reaction immediately if any flow cannot keep up. Overheating can cause destruction and radioactive contamination; do not dismantle a hot reactor or one containing radioactive chemicals just to fix a pipe.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.title: Fission Reactor
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.reward.0: The top of Mekanism's tech tree
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.text.0: The supercritical phase shifter processes polonium into antimatter at a large energy cost. Begin after establishing reliable polonium production and powerful generation: this separate load should not share the emergency reserve needed for reactor cooling.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.text.1: Build the specified SPS shell, ports and supercharged coils. The requested casing batch is not a complete structure. Supply polonium through a dedicated chemical line and energy through the prepared coils, watching internal progress and output space.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.text.2: Antimatter can be crystallized: one thousand units produce one pellet in the installed recipe. The antiprotonic nucleosynthesizer uses antimatter in specific item-conversion recipes; it does not create an arbitrary chosen item. Do not dismantle an input containing radioactive polonium, and do not treat possession of a pellet as proof that the SPS is safely stopped.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.title: Supercritical Phase Shifter
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.text.0: Uranium ore supplies fissile-fuel production, but a uranium ingot is not reactor fuel yet. Mine ore, smelt some of the material and prepare an enrichment chamber. Do not confuse radioactive-waste hazards with merely carrying ordinary uranium ingots.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.text.1: Produce yellow cake from uranium ingots in the enrichment chamber using its recipe. First let the Codex record eight ingots in one batch, then process them and register four yellow cake. Different item objectives are remembered sequentially; recorded ingots need not be recovered afterward. The cake feeds a chemical oxidizer.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.text.2: Before expanding, stock fluorite and prepare sulfuric acid: another stage of the fuel chain needs them. No operating reactor is required yet. This preparation lets you debug chemical production and transport before genuinely radioactive waste enters the system.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.title: Uranium
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.text.0: Reactor waste needs a separate chemical line and spare storage capacity. A radioactive waste barrel accepts supported waste and gradually reduces its contents; a full barrel is not bottomless. Filling it chiefly blocks removal, so monitor the entire path back to the reactor.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.text.1: Nuclear waste becomes polonium in a solar neutron activator or plutonium in an isotopic centrifuge. A pressurized reaction chamber combines the corresponding chemical, water and fluorite dust into a pellet, leaving spent nuclear waste. That additional output also needs attention.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.text.2: The activator depends on solar conditions, so provide capacity for production pauses. Do not break filled radioactive tubes or containers, as this can release radiation. A complete protective suit protects the operator but does not make a release acceptable. Inventory pellets confirm a product, not safe waste storage.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.title: Waste
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.text.0: Mekanism’s crusher turns suitable items into dust and processes clumps from the purification chamber. The combiner serves a different purpose: it joins a main material with an extra ingredient to reconstruct certain blocks. Both machines need power and clear outputs.
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.text.1: For a straightforward first trial, crush one iron ingot into one iron dust. Test the combiner separately: its ordinary iron ore recipe needs eight raw iron and cobblestone. The main and extra ingredients use different inputs.
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.text.2: Reconstructing ore does not create a free loop: eight raw items become just one ore block. Do not route all mining output into the combiner to chase an attractive ×5 label. The crusher belongs in productive purification chains; reserve the combiner for a particular recipe or block you actually need.
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.title: Crusher and Combiner
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.text.0: Dissolution introduces chemical slurry before the existing ore chain. You need sulfuric acid, washing water and separate pressurized tubes for dirty and clean slurry. Build the sulfur chain through sulfur dioxide, sulfur trioxide and water vapour; brine is not a substitute.
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.text.1: The dissolution chamber produces one thousand units of dirty iron slurry from an iron ore block, or two thousand from three raw iron. The washer consumes water to make clean slurry; the crystallizer turns each two hundred units into one crystal.
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.text.2: Crystals still pass through hydrogen chloride injection, oxygen purification, crushing, enrichment and smelting. The result is five ingots per ore block or ten per three raw iron. Avoid mixing metals in an unfinished shared batch: residual slurry of one type can block the next.
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.title: Dissolution and Crystallization (×5)
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.text.0: An enrichment chamber produces clean metal dust for subsequent smelting. Craft the machine, connect power and place a furnace nearby: the chamber does not output ingots itself. Use iron for your first trial so input and output are easy to compare.
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.text.1: In the installed recipe, one iron ore block gives two dust, three raw iron give four, and a raw iron block gives twelve. Each dust then smelts into one ingot. A single raw iron does not start the recipe that requires three.
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.text.2: Configure dust output and furnace input, then compare the result with the selected recipe. The ×2 name cannot be applied to raw material dropped by ordinary mining. The chamber also produces concentrated infuser supplies, so it remains useful after you move to a more complex ore-processing line.
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.title: Enrichment Chamber (×2)
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.text.0: A thermal evaporation plant turns water into brine, while a separate plant of the same kind turns brine into liquid lithium. Both installed recipes use ten units of input fluid for one unit of output. Liquid lithium later feeds a different fuel chain.
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.text.1: Build the hollow tower according to Mekanism’s structure layout, including its controller and valves; the sixteen blocks requested here are a component stock, not a complete structure of every height. Supply water through an input valve and remove brine through an output valve using mechanical pipe.
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.text.2: Operation depends on temperature: provide suitable heating and watch the readings before increasing height. If water is present but brine is absent, check formation, heat and output space. The plant does not produce heavy water or sulfuric acid; those have their own processes.
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.title: Thermal Evaporation Plant
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.text.0: A factory performs several operations of the same kind in parallel. Basic factories have three processing lanes, advanced five, elite seven and ultimate nine. This increases simultaneous operations rather than guaranteeing that every tier doubles each lane’s speed.
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.text.1: Start with a basic smelting factory and basic tier installer. An installer upgrades a compatible placed machine; check the required tier, stop its input and note its settings before use. A different operation requires the corresponding factory type.
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.text.2: After upgrading, supply enough dust and enable item distribution between lanes if your workflow needs it. One busy lane beside empty ones may indicate sorting settings or insufficient input. Also check power delivery: extra lanes are useless when the shared network is constantly empty.
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.title: Factories
codex.quest.mek_ore.guide_carbon.text.0: Enrichment makes carbon supply for steel infusers more economical. In the installed version, ordinary coal supplies ten infusion-carbon units, charcoal twenty and enriched carbon eighty. One coal or charcoal enriches into one unit of concentrate.
codex.quest.mek_ore.guide_carbon.text.1: Produce eight concentrates in the chamber and route them to the infuser’s infusion-material input. The main input still receives iron or enriched iron. Do not smelt concentrate instead of processing metal: it stores infusion substance rather than being a steel intermediate.
codex.quest.mek_ore.guide_carbon.text.2: Compare how many cycles the line runs between refills. Saving material requires an extra electrical operation, so retain ordinary supply as an option if enrichment stops. A small concentrate reserve is particularly helpful with two infusers consuming carbon independently in the two passes.
codex.quest.mek_ore.guide_carbon.title: Concentrated carbon
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.text.0: Chemical injection goes before purification and turns ore into shards using hydrogen chloride. Keep the oxygen line: shards still require purification, crushing, enrichment and smelting. One new machine alone does not produce finished metal.
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.text.1: Make brine in an evaporation plant, separate it by electrolysis and combine chlorine with hydrogen in a chemical infuser. The chemical infuser accepts two chemicals; it is a different machine from the metallurgic infuser with its item input. Arrange separate chemical lines before assembling the main chain.
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.text.2: One iron ore block yields four shards, while three raw iron yield eight. If production stops, inspect chlorine, hydrogen and separator byproduct space. Increase speed only after both gases and the oxygen required by the next stage arrive reliably.
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.title: Chemical Injection (×4)
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.text.0: The digital miner extracts blocks matching a filter within a configured area. Prepare stable power, output storage and a clear filter for the desired ore. Set radius and height range before starting; a small trial area is easier to verify than the entire neighbourhood.
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.text.1: Run the search and inspect the number of matching blocks before mining. Inverse filtering changes the list’s meaning, so do not enable it without understanding the result. Silk Touch preserves ore blocks and affects energy cost, making it useful when comparing processing recipes.
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.text.2: The stone generator upgrade helps replace mined blocks with the appropriate settings, but does not choose a safe filter for you. Check the first few extracted items and behaviour with a full output. Avoid placing the work area over other players’ structures or hidden utilities while trusting a filter name alone.
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.title: Digital Miner
Prepare twelve raw iron for this trial: enrichment produces sixteen dust, then smelting produces sixteen ingots. Alternatively, use eight iron ore blocks preserved with Silk Touch. Do not mix these input methods in one yield calculation.

Clear old leftovers from the chamber, smelter and output chest. Run the chosen batch and follow dust through smelting. If one or two raw iron remain in the chamber, it lacks the complete group of three required for another recipe.

Collect sixteen iron ingots in your ordinary inventory. Codex checks possession without taking the metal, and does not automatically establish where it came from. Record your selected input for the following manual check, otherwise old ingots accidentally left in storage will distort the measured line yield.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_batch.title: Enrichment workshop: test batch
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_run.task.0: Manual: compare batch inputs and outputs; fill the destination chest and verify that intermediate dust is retained.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_run.text.0: This trial checks material accounting and a backed-up line. First clear leftovers from earlier batches, count the input and count the resulting ingots. Compare against the recipe for the actual raw iron or ore blocks, rather than the chapter’s general multiplier.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_run.text.1: Then fill the final chest with inexpensive items so ingots cannot leave. Feed a small new batch and confirm that dust remains in machines or the transport system, with processing stopping without losing intermediate material.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_run.text.2: Clear the chest and wait for operation to resume. Mark the manual objective only after checking output counts and retained dust with a full destination. This is an in-world observation, not an automatic Codex measurement; if results disagree, find the incorrect side or unintended route and repeat the test.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_run.title: Enrichment workshop: operation test
A small enrichment line consists of a chamber and an energized smelter. Prepare an input chest, ingot destination and power for both machines; a short line without factories or upgrades is enough for now. Keep every interface accessible so you can see intermediate dust.

Set the chamber’s item input towards the chest and its output towards the smelter. Allow input on the matching smelter side and configure its ingot output. Enable automatic ejection where a machine must push items; passive chests need extraction.

Before feeding a stack, choose the actual recipe: an ore block gives two dust, while three raw iron give four. Possessing the two machines completes equipment preparation only. The next batch checks production; the manual trial tests whether materials remain safe when the final chest fills.
codex.quest.mek_ore.ore_line_setup.title: Enrichment workshop: equipment
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.text.0: The purification chamber starts an oxygen-based chain and outputs metal clumps. Have a crusher, enrichment chamber and furnace ready before starting, otherwise clumps remain unfinished intermediates. The electrolytic separator receives water through mechanical pipe and power through cable.
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.text.1: The separator splits water into hydrogen and oxygen. Send oxygen through pressurized tube to the purification chamber; give the other product separate storage or deliberately dump its excess. A full hydrogen output can stop oxygen production.
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.text.2: One iron ore block gives three clumps, while one raw iron gives two. Each clump then becomes dirty dust in the crusher, clean dust in the enrichment chamber and an ingot in the furnace. Track every intermediate form and avoid mixing clean and dirty dust in an unfiltered input.
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.title: Purification Chamber (×3)
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.text.0: The precision sawmill, energized smelter and formulaic assemblicator solve different workshop jobs. The sawmill processes wood and produces sawdust in suitable recipes; the smelter uses electricity for smelting; the assemblicator repeats a recorded crafting recipe.
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.text.1: Connect the machines and test one clear input each: a log for the sawmill and metal dust for the smelter. Check space for both the sawmill’s primary and secondary outputs. A sawdust backlog can stop useful plank production.
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.text.2: For the assemblicator, prepare a crafting formula, record the intended recipe and supply every required ingredient. A random mixture of resources without a formula does not make it an automatic crafting table. These devices are particularly useful for repeated casings and construction parts once circuits and metals arrive reliably.
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.title: Sawmill and More
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.text.0: Upgrades change compatible machines, but first identify the actual bottleneck. Speed cannot create iron or oxygen that an infuser is waiting for. Prepare one speed, one energy and one anchor upgrade as requested.
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.text.1: Install speed in a busy machine and watch its energy consumption. Add an energy upgrade and compare the same recipe. Do not confuse internal buffer capacity, cable transfer rate and average generation: each can impose a separate limit.
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.text.2: An anchor keeps a supported device operating when its area would otherwise unload, subject to server permissions. It is not a universal upgrade for every machine and does not replace checking the entire chain’s loading. Improve efficiency when the network sags; accelerate only the stage with material genuinely accumulating in front of it.
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.title: Machine Upgrades
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.text.0: The bio-generator turns Mekanism bio fuel into electricity. Bio fuel comes from crushing suitable plants and crops; yields vary, so choose a crop you can already grow consistently for the trial.
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.text.1: Craft the generator, prepare a crusher and process a small batch. Feed the resulting bio fuel into the generator’s item input and send energy to a cube. The crusher also needs power: retain a startup reserve rather than leaving a closed system completely discharged.
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.text.2: Watch whether crop production sustains operation and whether the crusher output remains clear. Do not consume the last seeds needed to replant the farm. This bio fuel line later supplies a pressurized reaction chamber for ethene, so keeping it separate from food storage is worthwhile.
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.title: Bio Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.text.0: The thermoelectric boiler transfers heat into water and produces steam; a separate turbine turns that steam into electricity. Prepare casings, valves, superheating elements and pressure dispersers according to the structure layout. The objective’s two valves and sixteen casings are not a complete boiler.
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.text.1: Build the water section with superheating elements, separate the steam area with the disperser layer and confirm that the structure forms. Supply water and a suitable heat source; when cooling a reactor with sodium, route heated and cooled coolant through their own connections as well.
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.text.2: Begin with a small safe heat flow and unrestricted steam removal. Losing water or stopping the consumer changes the entire connected system’s heat balance. Assess the boiler together with pumps, turbine and water return, rather than by the number of crafted casing blocks.
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.title: Thermal Boiler
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.text.0: The gas-burning generator can use ethene made in a pressurized reaction chamber. Prepare crusher-produced bio fuel, water and hydrogen from an electrolytic separator. The chamber simultaneously needs an item input, fluid, chemical and its own electricity.
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.text.1: The installed recipe consumes two bio fuel, ten units of water and one hundred hydrogen, producing one substrate and one hundred ethene. Substrate is a byproduct here, not a starting ingredient. Send it to a separate chest and ethene through pressurized tube to the generator.
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.text.2: Build an energy reserve for the crusher, separator and chamber before relying on the system’s own output. If it stops, inspect all three inputs and both outputs, including unwanted separator oxygen. More generating capacity is pointless while a full substrate chest or insufficient hydrogen blocks the chamber.
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.title: Gas-Burning Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_ethene_phase: Ethene for the gas-burning generator and liquid ethene for plastics are different forms of the same material. The rotary condensentrator converts supported substances between chemical and fluid forms. Craft one and retain an energy reserve, because conversion also consumes electricity.

Select condensation, supply reaction-chamber ethene through pressurized tube and remove fluid through mechanical pipe. Different interface tanks should change rather than sharing one undifferentiated pipe. Reverse conversion uses the device’s other mode.

Do not divert all ethene from your only working generator: plastic production could remove power from its own material supply. Begin with a small separate reserve and check stopping with a full output. Distinguishing forms is also necessary for lithium in fusion-fuel preparation.
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_hdpe.text.0: High-density polyethylene is made in a pressurized reaction chamber from substrate, liquid ethene and oxygen. All three resources connect to the biofuel line, but this recipe differs from producing ethene itself. Prepare a separate chamber or completely clear the previous inputs before switching.
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_hdpe.text.1: One substrate, fifty units of liquid ethene and ten oxygen produce one HDPE pellet in the installed recipe. Feed the liquid through mechanical pipe, oxygen through pressurized tube and substrate through item transport. Connect power and collect six pellets.
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_hdpe.text.2: If the chamber accepts substrate but does not run, first check ethene’s form and any residual incompatible chemical. Pellets unlock sheets and other plastic components. Keep some substrate in reserve so plastic production does not depend on whatever happens to remain in the generating line’s output chest.
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_hdpe.title: First plastic pellets
codex.quest.mek_power.guide_hdpe_sheet.t: HDPE sheets are the next practical product of the chemical workshop. An enrichment chamber converts three pellets into one sheet, so the previous six-pellet batch makes two. This stage needs energy but no further oxygen or liquid ethene.

Clear ore-processing leftovers from the chamber and supply pellets in complete groups of three. Obtain two sheets and inspect input leftovers: one or two pellets do not indicate a fault, only an incomplete recipe group. A separate input prevents mixing with ordinary ore processing.

Inspect sheet uses before starting bulk production: plastics serve particular late components and equipment variants. A small reserve is more useful than overflowing pellet storage when ethene also powers your generator. This batch completes the practical chain from plants to a finished industrial material.
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.text.0: The heat generator is an early electricity source for an infuser. It supports active fuel burning and passive generation from surrounding heat. For the first start, craft it, place it near the future workshop and prepare fuel.
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.text.1: Connect its output to a machine or energy cube with universal cable. First check that storage rises without a load, then run one recipe. For a passive arrangement, consider lava placement and protect the walkway: exposed hot blocks threaten players and dropped items.
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.text.2: Do not expect this source to power a large factory merely because a cable connects. If the infuser works in bursts, compare demand with current generation and allow the buffer to charge. Later, the heat generator remains useful as a small independent startup source.
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.title: Heat Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.text.0: The induction matrix is a multiblock battery for a large power system. Cells determine storage capacity, while providers determine transfer rate. Many cells with one weak provider therefore create a large reserve that may discharge too slowly for your load.
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.text.1: Build the shell with induction ports and place at least a cell and provider inside. The requested sixteen casings are only a starting batch; build the complete boundary and volume according to matrix rules. Once formed, configure an input port and a separate output.
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.text.2: Charge the matrix and connect a known load, comparing readings in the same energy unit. If it holds plenty of energy while machines starve, check providers, ports and cables. The matrix does not generate electricity or make a reactor safe when every consumer stops; it only adds reserve time.
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.title: Induction Matrix
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.text.0: Solar generators supply power when sky lighting permits. Craft both the normal and advanced versions for this objective, but prepare storage before spending all your parts: a continuous production line loses its solar input at night.
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.text.1: Place the panels in an open area and connect an energy cube. Leave room for the advanced generator’s extended panel and avoid building over it. Open the interface during daytime and inspect actual generation in your biome and weather.
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.text.2: Compare daytime accumulation with the workshop’s overnight consumption. If reserves run out, reduce night demand, add storage when there is sufficient daytime surplus, or provide an independent source. Owning an advanced panel does not guarantee continuous power and does not remove the need to check cable sides.
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.title: Solar Panels
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.text.0: The industrial turbine accepts steam and converts its flow into energy. A real installation requires more than the listed parts: prepare valves, vents, pressure dispersers, a rotational complex and electromagnetic coils according to the Mekanism Generators layout.
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.text.1: Build the central rotor and blades inside the casing; the upper section couples rotation to coils, while condensers recover water. Follow the layered layout and confirm formation before supplying steam. Four rotor blocks alone do not establish generating capacity.
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.text.2: Connect steam, energy output and water return. Observe actual flow, stored energy and steam accumulation: full energy storage or inadequate removal can limit operation. In a reactor system, test loss of consumption beforehand while the system is cold and provide an emergency way to stop heat production.
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.title: Steam Turbine
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.text.0: The wind generator provides passive power and suits an outlying workshop. Its output depends on installation height within the world’s configured limits, so choose deliberately: an accessible service tower can be more practical than a distant peak without a route.
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.text.1: Prepare a platform, place the generator with room for its structure and run cable to storage. Before connecting machines, confirm that energy actually enters the battery. A tall tower without a working output is only an expensive landmark.
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.text.2: Compare the reading at your chosen height with base demand instead of assuming a fixed output from another guide. When expanding, check the shared cable’s throughput and reserves for demanding recipes. Wind is useful as a steady power foundation, but accelerated chemical machinery may require substantially more.
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.title: Wind Generator
The quantum entangloporter transfers supported resources between devices on one frequency. A real link needs at least two blocks, although this objective requests one. Start by testing ordinary items or energy over a short distance where both ends are visible.

Select the same frequency and configure sides separately for each resource. Allow input at the source and output at the destination, enabling automatic ejection where needed. Frequency storage is shared, so independent processes with incompatible fluids should use separate frequencies.

Check access rights and loading at both sites. An entangloporter is not a universal way around restrictions on radioactive chemicals: do not plan reactor-waste transport through it without confirmed support. If energy transfers but items do not, the entire network is not necessarily broken; item-side settings usually deserve inspection first.
codex.quest.mek_qio.entangloporter.title: Quantum Entangloporter
Manual: transfer eight items, retain the next batch with a full output and complete delivery after clearing it.

Test quantum delivery with ordinary items before moving devices to different dimensions. Place two entangloporters nearby, choose a dedicated test frequency and prepare an input chest with eight cobblestone. Leave the receiving chest empty for this batch.

Configure item input at the source and item output at the destination, enabling the required extraction. Wait for eight items at the output and compare counts. Then block the destination by filling it, feed another small batch and confirm that material remains in accessible buffers.

Unblock the output and verify delivery completes without loss. Only then mark the manual objective and move the tested pair to distant sites. Those sites additionally require both ends loaded and matching frequency permissions; the nearby test establishes routing, not these world conditions.
codex.quest.mek_qio.guide_stock_signal.t: Manual: add and remove one material to verify the QIO signal switches both ways across the configured threshold.

A QIO adapter can produce a consumable up to a chosen stock level without filling an entire drive. Use ordinary cobblestone and a small easily counted amount for the experiment. Connect the adapter to the frequency containing the test material and prepare a visible signal indicator.

Set a cobblestone filter and threshold. Add material to cross the threshold, then remove some again. Watch the output change; if its logic is opposite to your expectation, correct the mode before connecting actual production.

Mark the manual objective after verifying both threshold crossings. For practical use, connect the signal to supported machine control and allow for operations already in progress. A signal stops nothing until connected to a consumer; carrying an adapter does not demonstrate automatic replenishment.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.text.0: A QIO drive array holds the media for wireless item storage. An array without a drive provides no useful capacity, and a drive without a selected frequency does not create an accessible network. Prepare a base drive and array, then place them in a serviceable part of the base.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.text.1: Insert the drive, create a storage frequency and set access. A QIO dashboard from the next node will provide item interaction. Run the first test with a small amount of ordinary cobblestone, leaving valuables in the old chest until retrieval works.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.text.2: Drives limit both total item count and the number of different types. Many distinct damaged tools can therefore use storage differently from large stacks of stone. Inspect both values before expanding; choose a higher drive tier for the limit you actually reached rather than its name alone.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.title: QIO Drive Array
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.text.0: A QIO dashboard exposes the contents of a selected storage frequency. A stationary dashboard suits a workstation, while the portable version travels with you. Both need an existing drive array and the right frequency; crafting a dashboard alone creates no populated network.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.text.1: Select the array’s frequency and insert a few ordinary items through the interface. Find them with search and retrieve them again. Charge the portable dashboard and test access before placing backup tools into remote storage.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.text.2: If the list is empty, first compare frequency, ownership and permissions, then inspect the array. Do not consider the whole warehouse migrated until retrieval is proven. The dashboard then becomes a useful access point, while importers and exporters can connect QIO to production machines.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.title: QIO Dashboard
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.text.0: A QIO importer moves items from an adjacent inventory into the network; an exporter sends matching items back out. The redstone adapter converts a configured stock level into a control signal. Together they support automatic replenishment without repeated dashboard searches.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.text.1: Connect all three devices to the intended frequency. First import a small test chest, then give the exporter one specific filter and a separate destination. Avoid broad extraction beside a chest containing personal tools.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.text.2: Set the adapter threshold and verify its signal while adding and removing material. This can stop automatic production once enough stock exists. Avoid an importer–exporter pair that endlessly circulates the same item through one chest: define a one-way purpose for each inventory first.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.title: Import and Export
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.text.0: The dimensional stabilizer keeps selected chunks loaded while powered and while the feature is permitted. It serves remote production that must continue without a player present. Before installing one, confirm that unloading actually stops the line rather than an empty battery or blocked output.
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.text.1: Place and power the device, then select the required areas in its interface. Include the whole chain: generator, pump, input storage and destination may occupy neighbouring chunks. A loaded machine with an unloaded water source is still unreliable.
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.text.2: Test with safe ordinary production, leave the area and compare accumulated output after returning. Do not use a radioactive reactor as the first experiment. Select only the necessary area: extra loading consumes server resources and should not replace placing related devices compactly.
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.title: Dimensional Stabilizer
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.text.0: The teleportation core is an ingredient for devices that work across distance. It is a component, not a portable teleporter: using the core itself does not move a player. Prepare the required circuits, alloys and other recipe ingredients before spending rare reserves.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.text.1: Craft four cores and let the inventory objective register them. Then choose your first application: a stationary teleporter for a frequently visited location or wireless infrastructure devices. A complete route generally needs several finished blocks and its own power.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.text.2: Plan the destination first: a safe platform, energy access and a clear frequency name matter more than another core in a chest. Do not make a remote teleporter your only return route before testing both directions. The cores unlock the quantum branch but establish no connection on their own.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.title: Teleportation Core
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.text.0: A stationary teleporter creates a travel point once its frame is built and a frequency selected. A portable teleporter selects a suitable stationary destination but does not replace it. Prepare frame blocks in addition to the requested items and charge the portable device.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.text.1: Build the required teleporter frame, supply power and choose a frequency with appropriate access. For two stationary sites, match the frequency and check readiness at each end. Confirm that the interface sees a valid destination before leaving for another dimension.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.text.2: Make the first trip with a backup return method and a clear exit platform. Do not place an exit in lava, a cramped shaft or an operating machine. If unavailable, check power, structure, frequency permissions and destination loading; a matching name alone does not guarantee travel.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.title: Teleporter
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.text.0: Infused alloy is iron processed with redstone in an infuser. It is already needed for the configurator and many early machines. Prepare a separate batch of iron ingots: osmium in this recipe would produce basic circuits instead.
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.text.1: Obtain four alloys while watching the internal redstone reserve and power supply. Later, infused alloy is treated with diamond infusion material to become reinforced alloy; the next step uses refined obsidian infusion material to produce atomic alloy.
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.text.2: Do not add diamond material on top of unfinished redstone in the tank. Dedicate infusers to individual substances or finish a batch before clearing the tank. An enrichment chamber can concentrate infusion supplies in advance, often helping more than blindly increasing speed while materials are still delivered by hand.
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.title: Alloys
codex.quest.mek_start.box.text.0: A cardboard box can move supported blocks together with their stored data. Crafting uses sawdust, conveniently produced by a precision sawmill. Before you have a sawmill, inspect available sawdust recipes in JEI; a box is not required for your first steel.
codex.quest.mek_start.box.text.1: Begin with a safe trial on an ordinary chest containing one expendable item. Pack the block, move the resulting box, place it and unpack it with the supported interaction. Confirm that its contents survived before relocating the workshop.
codex.quest.mek_start.box.text.2: Packing has restrictions and is not a universal way to dismantle multiblocks. In particular, do not experiment with radioactive containers or a running reactor. For ordinary machines, stop material and energy supply first, remember their orientation and check every connection again after moving.
codex.quest.mek_start.box.title: Cardboard Box
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.text.0: Mekanism networks differ by what they carry. Universal cable transfers energy, mechanical pipe carries fluids, pressurized tube carries chemicals, and logistical transporter moves items. For example, separator water travels through mechanical pipe while the resulting oxygen needs pressurized tube.
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.text.1: Craft the requested starter set and connect one pair of devices for each type you need. Configure machine inputs and outputs separately for energy, items and chemicals. A visible pipe connection does not guarantee that the attached side allows transfer.
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.text.2: Use Pull mode on a connection or a suitable active output to extract from passive storage. Keep incompatible fluids or chemicals off the same line. The main transport tiers are basic, advanced, elite and ultimate; heat uses a separate conductor.
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.title: Transmission
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.text.0: Steel casing is an ingredient in many machines, so a batch of eight will soon find a use. Prepare steel, osmium and glass; reserve some osmium for circuits beforehand so casing production does not stall everything else.
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.text.1: Craft the casings at a crafting table using the current recipe. They have no working machine interface of their own: placing one does not create a furnace or enrichment chamber. Each complete machine has a separate recipe requiring the appropriate circuits and materials.
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.text.2: Choose your first production line before spending the batch: an enrichment chamber and energized smelter provide an immediate benefit. The objective checks for eight casings in your inventory, so let it register before crafting the last one into a machine. Transport networks will also require further steel.
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.title: Steel Casing
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.text.0: Control circuits appear in machine, cable and upgrade recipes. Start with basic circuits: infuse an osmium ingot with redstone in the metallurgic infuser. Iron in that same main slot would produce alloy, so keep the two batches separate.
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.text.1: Supply redstone, insert four osmium ingots and wait for four circuits. Carbon left over from steel prevents this recipe from starting: use a dedicated redstone infuser or clear its internal tank first.
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.text.2: Advanced, elite and ultimate circuits are crafted from the previous tier using the corresponding alloys. These are successive crafting recipes, not different infuser settings. Keeping a small dedicated stock of basic circuits makes power-network expansion easier and avoids dismantling working machines to recover components.
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.title: Control Circuits
The configurator changes transport connections and helps set up equipment. It is an electric tool, so charge it in an available energy device first. The configuration card transfers supported settings and is useful when installing identical machines.

Check the selected tool mode before interacting. Items, fluids, chemicals and energy require the appropriate actions; consult control settings for key combinations because the pack allows rebinding. Practise changing a connection on a short section beside a chest.

Copy settings from one tested machine onto the card, then apply them to a compatible second machine. Afterwards, check orientation and sides: identical settings on a rotated machine put the actual inputs elsewhere. A familiar configurator saves more time than dismantling a whole network whenever it stops.
codex.quest.mek_start.configurator.title: Configurator
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.text.0: An energy cube bridges gaps in generation and short peaks in demand. It stores previously generated energy, so it cannot fix a permanent power deficit by itself. Craft a basic cube and keep its interface accessible.
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.text.1: Connect the generator to an input side and consumers to an output side. Check the cube’s own side configuration: rotating a block can leave a cable attached to a disabled face. With machines stopped, confirm that stored energy rises.
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.text.2: Start an enrichment chamber and compare the reserve. A gradual decline means average demand exceeds generation; a full cube beside starving machines points to output configuration or transfer limits. Choose one energy unit, such as FE, in the available interfaces when comparing readings.
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.title: Energy Storage
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.text.0: The metallurgic infuser combines a main item with a substance stored inside the machine. Craft it from iron, furnaces, redstone and osmium using its recipe, then connect a heat generator with universal cable.
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.text.1: Distinguish the main input from the slot that supplies infusion material. Redstone fills the internal redstone reserve; iron in the main slot becomes infused alloy. Carbon is used for steel and belongs to a different production batch.
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.text.2: If nothing happens, check stored energy, both input types and output space. Residual redstone prevents switching the internal tank to carbon: remove supplies and deliberately clear the tank, or use another infuser. Clearing destroys the substance left inside.
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.title: Metallurgic Infuser
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.text.0: Osmium is needed for Mekanism’s first mechanisms, while tin will be useful for bronze and later recipes. Look for their ores during ordinary mine exploration; collect neighbouring resources too, but keep a separate iron reserve for tools and a generator.
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.text.1: Smelt the raw material in an ordinary furnace. Electrical processing is not required yet: the immediate aim is the sixteen osmium and eight tin ingots requested here. An ore block and the raw material it drops are different inputs for future machines.
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.text.2: Store technical metals separately from building supplies. The objective detects the specified ingot items; carrying ore instead does not complete it. Osmium unlocks the infuser, and a reliable power connection lets you start making circuits immediately.
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.title: Osmium
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.text.0: The logistical sorter extracts matching items from an adjacent inventory and routes them into a transporter network. It is useful between a shared chest and a steel line: iron belongs in the first infuser, while coal belongs in the carbon supply.
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.text.1: Place the sorter against the chest, connect its output to a transporter and create one simple item filter. Test a small batch first; add colours and further destinations only when a single route is insufficient.
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.text.2: A diversion transporter controls connections according to redstone signals; it does not replace the sorter’s item filters. If cargo returns or stays in the chest, check destination inventory space, colours and signal state. This prevents machine inputs from filling with unrelated materials.
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.title: Logistical Sorting
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.text.0: Steel requires two passes through an infuser followed by smelting. Prepare iron ingots, coal or charcoal to supply carbon, and furnace fuel. Infusion itself also consumes electricity.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.text.1: First, iron and carbon become enriched iron. Infuse that item with carbon again to obtain steel dust, then smelt the dust into an ingot. The installed recipes require ten units of infusion carbon for each pass.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.text.2: Do not send enriched iron straight to the furnace and skip the second pass. Repeat the entire chain sixteen times for sixteen ingots, supplying carbon for both stages in advance. Later, two dedicated infusers remove the manual transfer and keep machine casings supplied.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.title: Steel
codex.quest.mek_start.steel_line_batch.t: A test batch reveals where the line slows down or waits for a consumable. Separate sixteen iron ingots from the rest of storage, supply carbon to both infusers and clear the output chest. Leave speed upgrades out until this trial is complete.

Feed the iron into the first infuser. Watch enriched iron, steel dust and finished ingots in sequence; a delay at one stage tells you which interface to inspect. The output should collect sixteen steel ingots.

Move the finished ingots into your ordinary inventory so the objective can detect them. This item check does not distinguish manual from automatic production and does not consume the batch. If you made everything manually, the stock remains useful, but verify installation reliability with the next separate test.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel_line_run.tas: Manual: verify separate carbon and material feeds; interrupt and restore an input without mixing intermediate materials.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel_line_run.tex: Now test whether the steel line survives an ordinary supply interruption. Remove valuable unrelated items from the test input and prepare several iron ingots. Watch both infusers and the smelter, not just the final chest.

Stop the main material supply, then restore it. Separately interrupt carbon until the relevant infuser stops, then replenish its reserve. Enriched iron should remain an intermediate product, and steel dust should reach the smelter without manually rerouting anything.

Mark the manual objective only after checking separate inputs, interruption and recovery without mixed materials. Codex does not observe this operation automatically. If an unrelated item enters the wrong slot instead of the line simply pausing, fix the filter or side configuration and repeat the experiment before confirming.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel_line_setup.t: This side branch turns manual steelmaking into a small line with clear stages. The equipment objective needs two infusers and an energized smelter; prepare cables, transporters and chests separately as the layout requires. Leave service access to the interfaces.

The first infuser receives iron and carbon; the second receives enriched iron and carbon. Send its steel dust output to the energized smelter. Configure item sides on every device separately from its energy input.

Start without elaborate sorting: fill the carbon reserves by hand, then test one iron ingot through the entire chain. Possessing the listed machines only confirms equipment. A test batch and interruption checks follow in later objectives, so a stack of crafted machines does not establish a working production line.
codex.quest.missiles.computer.text.0: A guidance computer connects a target to the missile’s actuator fins. The targeting interface handles target selection and can pair with a radar network. Prepare both items, configured fins and an accessible network controller; keep the weapon without explosive payload.
codex.quest.missiles.computer.text.1: Select Actuator Fins with the computer item, then place the computer within the indicated allowed area. Install the targeting interface by interacting with a Create seat and pair it with a Network Controller using its intended action. Check selection and pairing messages.
codex.quest.missiles.computer.text.2: A radar target, seat and computer do not become linked automatically. Confirm that the intended object is selected and commands reach the correct actuator. Recheck links after moving components. Only afterward proceed to mounting and a flight trial without explosive contents.
codex.quest.missiles.computer.title: Guidance Computer
codex.quest.missiles.fins.text.0: Actuator fins give the computer a way to steer a physical missile. The four requested items are a component supply, not a guaranteed aerodynamic layout. Prepare a light body without explosive payload and mark its longitudinal axis.
codex.quest.missiles.fins.text.1: Place fins consistently with the intended travel direction and confirm they belong to the correct physical construct. When configuring the computer, select the relevant actuator by interacting with the fins before placing the computer. Keep each node accessible for correcting linkage.
codex.quest.missiles.fins.text.2: Avoid accidentally opposing control-surface directions. Check control response without starting a fueled motor first, then make a separate short flight. If the vehicle spins, compare orientation, center of mass and selected actuator; adding more fins without understanding the fault may amplify incorrect steering.
codex.quest.missiles.fins.title: Fins
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.text.0: A proximity fuze responds to approach after launch and needs its own sensitivity configuration. It is part of a dangerous in-game device, so craft it and inspect its state on an unloaded training construct first. Do not test detonation on a missile parked at the base.
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.text.1: Mount the fuze in the intended direction and configure detection distance through its available panel. Operation relates to the released vehicle state; owning the block does not make it a permanently safe generic sensor. Check configuration before adding explosive payload.
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.text.2: Choose a separate remote target and clear flight area for an actual test. “Aircraft” does not promise that every wall or friendly structure will be ignored. Observe one launch and record settings. For guidance-only testing, leave the fuze and explosive payload removed until routing is verified.
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.title: Proximity Fuze
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.text.0: A rocket motor produces thrust for a physical construct and uses its own supply of charges. Prepare the motor and a training body after learning the physics assembler. A stationary block on the floor is not yet a flying vehicle.
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.text.1: Open the motor interface and inspect its compatible propellant slots. Install it unfueled first, checking nozzle direction and attachment to the future missile. Mass, thrust position and body composition affect the whole construct’s motion.
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.text.2: Do not assume adding a motor shortens runtime through a simple universal formula; loading and configuration determine behavior. Before fueling, prepare a clear test corridor and secure mounting arrangement. Conduct the first trial without explosive payload and observe orientation and actual burning before building a complete guided vehicle.
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.title: Rocket Motor
A missile mount holds a missile and connects it to launch control. Prepare the mount, a training physical construct and network linkage. Its hint describes a twin hardpoint accepting missiles on corresponding sides, but actual alignment needs checking in the world.

Align the vehicle with the working side and verify attachment without fuel or explosive payload. Install a red Weapon Link against the mount for the weapon network as instructed. Confirm that the chosen targeting interface serves this installation.

Before launching, inspect the clear exit path and actuator linkage. A release command must not unintentionally detach another parked vehicle. Begin with one training body and observe separation. Owning the mount does not verify docking, retention or a safe automatic weapon complex.
codex.quest.missiles.mount_missile.title: Launcher
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.task.0: Use white dye on a raccoon to summon Arky
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.task.1: Equip fursuit items in all four armour slots
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.text.0: Arky appears through a special raccoon interaction: the installed procedure uses white dye and replaces the creature’s form. Prepare an appropriate raccoon and a safe site away from normal pet routes. A decorative white outfit does not summon the character.
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.text.1: Use white dye on the raccoon and verify Arky’s appearance and advancement. The second objective needs a complete equipped fursuit from the supported family: head, chest, legs and feet. It checks worn equipment, so obtaining one piece cannot complete it.
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.text.2: Craft or obtain an available set through its actual branch, then wear all four pieces and await the mark. Leave dangerous environments before changing: a costume should not be assumed equivalent to specialized protective armour. Restore working equipment afterward and verify that pets remain safe.
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.title: Arky
Remain in the participating world until the Blue Moon event ends and its advancement is awarded
Blue Moon is an Eternal Tales event rather than an unusual sky colour or a visit to Terralith’s Moonlight Grove. Prepare protected ground, food and healing before going out at night. Watch the start announcement and remain in the world where the event runs.

Related threats and materials appear during the event. Explore them only with suitable equipment and a retreat route. This objective does not require summoning a separate boss: its advancement relates to Blue Moon ending, not obtaining any blue item.

Await the ending announcement and inspect the book’s mark. Avoid leaving the dimension at the last moment if expecting the current event’s completion to register. Afterward replenish consumables and inspect base approaches before deciding whether another expedition is needed for special loot.
codex.quest.more_et_side.blue_moon.title: Blue Moon
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.task.0: Ignite an atomic bomb with flint and steel or a fire charge at an isolated range, then retreat
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.text.0: The Eternal Tales atomic bomb is a destructive in-game block. Its ordinary recipe surrounds sulfur TNT with eight jester’s bombs. Prepare it only for an isolated range away from buildings, citizens, transport and reserves you intend to preserve.
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.text.1: Establish rapid retreat and a safe observation position beforehand. Place the bomb and activate it using flint and steel or a fire charge. The checked procedure awards the advancement when converting the block into an activated bomb, so remaining beside it until detonation is unnecessary.
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.text.2: Leave the danger area immediately and await the effect from a distance. Receiving an advancement does not cancel world destruction or protect nearby terrain. Inspect before returning to debris; this side objective belongs to a prepared experiment rather than testing an unfamiliar item inside your workshop.
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.title: Royal Boom
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.text.0: These four chests belong to Eternal Tales digging, fishing, growing and sorcery skills. Each objective checks obtaining its corresponding chest in inventory. Ordinary wooden chests renamed at an anvil cannot substitute: distinct mod items are required.
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.text.1: Develop associated activities and preserve reward containers until registration. Digging uses eligible blocks, fishing its fishing system, growing maintained plants and sorcery magical activities. Placing four workstations together does not automatically create rewards.
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.text.2: Obtain containers sequentially and check each advancement before opening if you want their contents. All four need not be held simultaneously because the advancements are independent. For a missing type, return to its skill and reward conditions instead of repeatedly opening a chest belonging to another mastered profession.
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.title: Four Chests
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.task.0: Remain in the participating world until Clown Moon ends and its advancement is awarded
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.text.0: Clown Moon is a separate Eternal Tales event with its own activation and ending. Before participating, prepare a range or protected area away from civilians. Clown equipment in inventory does not prove the event has started.
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.text.1: Follow the unlocked event-activation branch and await its announcement. Control emerging enemies, keep healing accessible and avoid moving combat into cramped colony districts. Do not spend arbitrary trophies as assumed activators: verify an activation item’s purpose beforehand.
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.text.2: For this card, await Clown Moon ending and the advancement mark while in the corresponding world. This checks the event rather than requiring a full clown outfit or killing any similarly themed mob. Afterward safely collect remaining drops and restore the area before ordinary construction resumes.
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.title: Circus
codex.quest.more_et_side.crabs.text.0: Crabsapocalypse is recorded through obtaining its special banner. Although the name describes completing an event, the automatic criterion checks crabsapocalypse_banner in inventory. An ordinary crab trophy or player-renamed banner cannot substitute.
codex.quest.more_et_side.crabs.text.1: Progress through the associated Eternal Tales combat branch with healing, loot capacity and a safe retreat area. Before participation, study the available event-summoning method and encounter conditions in its guide. Do not expect killing any crab to automatically award the final banner.
codex.quest.more_et_side.crabs.text.2: Collect the trophy and await the mark, then preserve it for display. Placing it on a wall before registration is inconvenient because acquisition by the player is required. This card does not measure every combat stage separately; completion signifies the required trophy, while subsequent encounters are independent choices.
codex.quest.more_et_side.crabs.title: Crabsapocalypse
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.task.0: Use the Emblem of Mite at Slaying 2+, die from nettle damage and eat Unahzaal pancakes
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.text.0: The advancement name groups three unusual game flags but should not be read literally as three identically implemented deaths. Installed code checks using the Emblem of Mite, dying from nettle damage and eating Unahzaal pancakes. Prepare a separate trial without valuable luggage.
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.text.1: The emblem requires at least Slaying level two and no active emblem cooldown; using it records its flag. Pancakes record their flag after consumption and apply a dangerous effect. Only the nettle condition is checked by the death procedure with the specific nettle_damage type, not any accidental death beside the plant.
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.text.2: Store possessions, establish a respawn point and preserve access beforehand, accounting for your world’s item-loss rules. After the three distinct conditions, await the overall mark. Random deaths cannot substitute or accelerate checking and only add experience loss and equipment-recovery trips.
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.title: Darwin Award
codex.quest.more_et_side.gravicycle.task: Put 64 acceleration modifiers in gravicycle slot 0 and mount it
codex.quest.more_et_side.gravicycle.text: The Arkemer gravicycle offers another Eternal Tales travel method. Its first advancement checks obtaining the vehicle item, while “maximum acceleration” has a specific equipment condition in this version. Prepare the vehicle, acceleration modifiers and a spacious safe test site.

Place sixty-four Gravicycle Acceleration Modifiers in inventory slot zero and mount the vehicle. The check requires this full stack, a vehicle carrying a passenger and a nearby player; it does not measure record speed. A long dangerous ride without modifiers cannot replace the equipment condition.

Await the mark before learning controls through short movements. Inspect stopping and terrain before carrying valuable luggage. Avoid testing an upgraded vehicle between densely packed colony buildings: first understand its acceleration and return to the starting area without colliding with infrastructure.
Eternal Tales adds small things that make trips more comfortable. The portable chest is carried storage opened straight from your hands: a chest in the centre, two chains at the sides and four pieces of leather in the crafting grid’s corners. It is a separate item with its own contents; an ordinary chest does not count instead.

The glow berry cookie is crafted from two cookies and glow berries, two at once. The berries grow on vines in lush caves, and at home you can grow them by planting on the underside of a block. Both advancements are granted the moment the items appear in the inventory, with no further action.

Assemble the kit before a long expedition: food, torches and blocks in the portable chest, the cookie as a light snack that takes almost no space. Do not hide the portable chest inside a backpack: nested containers are convenient, but after a death they take longer to find.
codex.quest.more_et_side.guide_skills.ta: Reach the first level of the Digging skill
Raise any skill with a skill point on the Notice Board
codex.quest.more_et_side.guide_skills.te: The Notice Board is Eternal Tales’ built-in reference: it is crafted from any planks and a sheet of paper, and inside it shows quests, dimension crystals, boss statistics and skills. Place it at home and open it: the skill and ammunition overlays on screen are toggled there too.

The Digging skill grows by mining ores; the higher the level, the more often an extra ore chunk drops. The first level arrives by itself after ordinary pickaxe work, and the book credits the “Young Miner” advancement. The other skills grow from their own activities: catching, growing, archery, sorcery, archaeology.

Every skill increase grants player level points, and a new player level grants a skill point that can be invested in any skill right on the board. Do this at least once: that is how the second advancement is credited. Do not spend points at random; read the skill description on its board tab first.
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.task.0: Obtain all 9 lamp variants: lava, water, snow, blood, black water, acid, liquid aetherium, soul lava and ender
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.text.0: The collection includes nine lamps: lava, water, snow, blood, black water, acid, liquid aetherium, soul lava and ender. Each has its own acquisition criterion, so “all lava lamps” alone does not explain the set. Prepare storage and a missing-variant checklist.
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.text.1: The first lava lamp can be crafted from cobalt, a honey bottle, glass, a lava bucket, iron and redstone. Further recipes transform lamps using corresponding contents; inspect exact output before spending rare fluids. Register one form before converting it into another.
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.text.2: Track every acquisition and preserve favourite samples separately for room lighting. The advancement requires neither placing every lamp together nor pouring dangerous fluids onto the floor. If incomplete, compare the nine criteria rather than counting similar blocks on a shelf: duplicate colours do not replace missing forms.
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.title: Light of the Night
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.task.0: Obtain all 31 specific discs listed by the Eternal Tales music collection advancement
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.text.0: The installed Eternal Tales music collection contains thirty-one discs. It includes world records and specific biome compositions; a few vanilla discs cannot replace the set. Prepare labelled storage and inspect the advancement’s remaining criteria.
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.text.1: Collect records through sources available in their respective branches, preserving found discs among trophies and studying musical-material uses. Hold every new disc in inventory before inserting it into a jukebox. Listening is not the required trigger: the game records particular item acquisitions.
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.text.2: The entire set need not be held together because separate criteria persist. For display, preserve one sample each and separate duplicates from rarities. When one gap remains, search the exact composition name, including additional records from the same world: one Rayana disc cannot replace all its biome-specific tracks.
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.title: Collector
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.task.0: Tame the required raccoon variants and obtain Alien Martian Raccoon and Peacoon transformations
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.task.1: Interact with a raccoon to pet it
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.text.0: Ordinary raccoons are tamed with cookies, and petting is checked through interacting with a raccoon. Prepare treats and safe pet accommodation. “All types” requires more than one colour: the game remembers tamed variants and additionally checks two special transformations.
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.text.1: Tame encountered variants and record their names or appearances. The installed check includes variants two through seven plus either ordinary or white base form. Alien Martian Raccoon and Peacoon advancements are also required: Comets cabbage and Dreadful Pea interactions relate to those transformations.
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.text.2: Check overall progress after each new type instead of crowding every animal into one pen for an inventory objective. This records player actions rather than item stacks. Avoid experimenting with random dyes and special plants on your only favourite pet without understanding the result: transformations can replace its form.
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.title: Raccoons
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.task.0: Tame green, crimson, cyan and albino tarkos using fermented tarantula eyes
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.text.0: Tarkos are large Rayana reptiles tamed with fermented tarantula eyes. Prepare bait reserves, safe Rayana access and pet accommodation. The advancement needs four varieties—green, crimson, cyan and albino—rather than four identical animals.
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.text.1: Green tarkos are common, crimson ones relate to desert conditions and cyan ones favour snow; albinos are rare. Apply the appropriate treat and verify successful taming because one attempt is not guaranteed. Record counted colours to avoid wasting supplies on repetition.
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.text.2: Inspect completion after the last missing variety. Animals need neither become inventory items nor stand beside you together: the taming history persists. During transport, allow enough clearance for large bodies instead of immediately leading a new pet down a narrow dangerous route that the player alone traverses easily.
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.title: Tarkos
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.text.0: Amberian City belongs to Eternal Tales’ Kingdom of Amber and is checked as the specific amberian_city biome. First unlock travel through its story branch, preparing protection and a return route. An ordinary colony built from yellow stone cannot substitute for the destination.
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.text.1: Record the first portal’s coordinates after entering: important Amber story directions depend on it. Search for the city biome within the Kingdom itself and verify the area name on arrival. This geographical objective does not require completing the labyrinth first or replacing exploration with defeating the king.
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.text.2: Inspect accessible passages, characters and a safe stopping point without starting unnecessary fights in narrow streets. Await the mark, then pursue relevant conversations separately. City reconnaissance helps navigation and later expeditions, but Amber items brought by another player do not prove your own biome visit.
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.title: Amberian City
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.text.0: Terralith’s amethyst canyon combines dramatic terrain with warm vegetation: its data includes bamboo, vines and local tree variants. Prepare descent blocks and a clear way back up. Jumping into an attractive fissure is not mandatory exploration.
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.text.1: Find amethyst_canyon with Nature’s Compass and approach along the rim while inspecting elevation. Descend using steps or another controlled method, checking the biome name at your chosen stop. An ordinary underground amethyst geode cannot substitute for the canyon despite the shared material name.
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.text.2: Mark a safe entrance and inspect views from several levels while preserving the return route. The objective records visiting, not crystal mining. If collecting palette samples, distinguish terrain decoration from normal amethyst-growth rules: the canyon name does not make every encountered block a renewable shard source.
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.title: Amethyst Canyon
