This confirms material output; rotation direction, safety and continuous feeding require separate inspection.
codex.quest.story_forge.wheels.title: Crushing: a batch of iron
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.text.0: A windmill provides continuous rotation without fuel and moves the drive away from the workshop floor. Prepare a windmill bearing and 64 sail frames. Height alone does not determine capacity: the assembled structure and recognised sail elements matter.
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.text.1: Attach the planned rotor to the bearing, add frames and secure connections between its parts. Leave room before assembly so the rotating object does not obstruct walkways. Study the bearing’s startup sequence in Ponder, then take rotation from its stationary side to the workshop shaft.
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.text.2: All 64 frames must appear together in inventory once; after registration, install them without making another set. Owning parts does not measure windmill operation, so check the connected shaft actually rotates. The next stressometer task shows how much available capacity the workshop uses.
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.title: The Way of Wind
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.text.0: Four Big Cannons cast-iron cannon barrels are an order for finished components, not a complete battery. Before casting, prepare a machining area with rotation and water for the cannon drill. Raw castings need further processing, so check exact item names at each stage.
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.text.1: Cast suitable iron blanks through an available pattern, let the process finish and bore them with correct machine feed and cooling. Complete one barrel first to verify movement direction and output. Do not combine parts from different cannon systems merely because their inventory shapes appear similar.
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.text.2: All four finished barrels must be in inventory together at submission and are consumed. Keep a separate set for your own gun with compatible chamber, breech, projectile and charge. Test the empty assembled weapon on the ground before fitting it to an aerial structure.
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.title: Casting
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.text.0: The radar section provides observation before automatic fire is connected. Prepare a plane radar, monitor and two Create Radar data links. These items do not form a working network until link targets and necessary controllers are configured through the addon’s interfaces.
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.text.1: Build an observation post and connect elements sequentially, beginning with a clear display channel. A Data Link first selects an allowed target such as a monitor, cannon mount or network controller before assigning the connection. A missing-target or excessive-distance message indicates configuration trouble rather than absent detectable objects.
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.text.2: Show both data links together before using them; other items can register separately. The book does not check screen contacts. Display a known suitable target and compare its movement with the world before forwarding those data to weapon control or judging airspace safety.
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.title: Eyes
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.text.0: An autocannon differs from a large cannon in construction, feeding and ammunition. Prepare a steel autocannon barrel and 64 Big Cannons flak rounds for delivery. One barrel is not a complete weapon: compatible remaining autocannon parts and a working ammunition feed are also required.
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.text.1: Build it on a ground test range, check the empty mechanism and verify firing direction. Use autocannon rounds rather than large shells or big-cannon powder charges. Before loading, designate a safe air sector free of friendly vessels, buildings and player routes, accounting for explosive ammunition effects.
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.text.2: Install the barrel after registration. All 64 flak rounds must remain in inventory for submission and are consumed; prepare separate test-fire ammunition. Check feeding with short controlled bursts, and resolve lift shortages caused by installed weapon mass before the next flight rather than while firing.
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.title: Anti-Air
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.text.0: The flagship finishes the project by combining lift, navigation and identification on one sound structure. Prepare a navigation table, transponder and four gyroscopic mechanisms for delivery. The table provides directional redstone towards a navigation item’s destination; it is not a ready-made autopilot for every hull.
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.text.1: While moored, check handling and lift after weapons are fitted. Set the transponder’s name and code, then enter the matching code in the air-defence network controller’s identification filter: installing a transponder alone does not promise exclusion from automatic targeting. Pass through the observation area with firing disabled.
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.text.2: Install the table and transponder after registration. Four gyroscopic mechanisms must be together in inventory at submission and are consumed; do not remove parts from a flying vessel for this. Finish by testing return and landing at full operating mass with control reserves available.
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.title: Flagship
The vessel landed on its pad at low speed guided by the instruments

The first balloon climbs by eye, but landing by eye ends with a broken deck. The altitude sensor emits a redstone signal by elevation: by default it grows as you climb, the limits are set in its menu, and the direction can be inverted. The velocity sensor gives a signal by speed along its axis and outputs it away from the motion. The throttle lever is a compact analog signal source: hold and drag to set the level.

Connect the lever to the burner: its output scales with signal strength, so the burner can be throttled rather than switched off. Remember from the Ponder that lift weakens with altitude and the craft settles when lift and weight balance. With engineer's goggles the altitude sensor shows pressure and exact altitude, and a wrench reveals small changes.

Sensors and the lever can be placed right after registration. For the objective, descend while watching the readings, touch the pad at low speed, then make sure the burner holds the vessel in place. Keep in mind that the velocity sensor measures only along the axis it faces.
codex.quest.story_sky.guide_rwr.task.2: The receiver sounded on entering radar range and gave a separate alert on lock-on
codex.quest.story_sky.guide_rwr.text.0: Your radar sees other targets, but the crew of your own vessel will not know a gun has already been trained on them. The radar warning receiver mounts on the hull of a physics contraption and plays one sound when the vessel enters a radar's range and another when it is locked on. The safe zone designator is linked to a monitor and marks, by two points, the area the operator considers safe.
codex.quest.story_sky.guide_rwr.text.1: First link the designator to the monitor from the previous quest, then mark the start and end points above your base: the mod's messages confirm each step. Mount the receiver where the sound can be heard from the control post. Test it on your own radar: fly through its observation area and wait for both signals.
codex.quest.story_sky.guide_rwr.text.2: Both items can be installed right after registration. The objective is two different warnings heard during the pass. The receiver does not cancel a lock-on; it only buys time to leave the zone or hold fire.
codex.quest.story_sky.guide_rwr.title: Radar Warning
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.text.0: The first aerial project begins with understanding lift rather than a heavy deck. Prepare a physics assembler, sixteen white envelopes and sixteen levitite for delivery. Levitite supports buoyancy but cannot gain altitude by itself: rising requires additional forces, such as a properly working hot-air balloon.
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.text.1: Build an airtight balloon volume and provide hot air; internal blocks reduce useful volume, while holes prevent containment. The listed envelope count does not promise sufficient size for any ship. Select connected blocks with glue and assemble the physical structure following assembler Ponder on a safe site.
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.text.2: Use envelopes and the assembler after registration. The sixteen levitite instead must be in inventory at submission and are consumed. Test the assembled structure’s lift separately with low mass and clear space: the material reward is not permission to immediately overload the platform with guns.
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.title: Ascent
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.text.0: The missile section uses dedicated CBCAeronautics Missiles components: two rocket motors, four actuator-fin blocks, a guidance computer and a missile mount. This list is not a completed missile with a warhead. First assemble and inspect an unloaded structure on a site with ample clear space.
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.text.1: To link the guidance computer, first select actuator fins by right-clicking with its item, then place the computer within the permitted range. Messages about another dimension, missing fins or excessive distance identify the failure. Follow the installed addon’s tooltips for subsequent assembly and mount assignment.
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.text.2: All components are non-consumable: show motors and fins in their required batches, then install them. The book neither launches a missile nor verifies guidance from owning a computer. Plan the first launch at a separate range after checking linkage, direction, identification and a clear trajectory, with friendly aircraft outside the sector.
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.title: Missile
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.text.0: Automatic aiming connects observation data to weapon movement. Prepare a cannon mount, yaw and pitch controllers, and a fire controller. The latter emits redstone when its linked mount aligns with a target; it is not an independent friendliness check for the object ahead.
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.text.1: Assemble a compatible gun and assign controllers to its mount through the addon’s linking system. Run the first experiment without propellant or projectile: test horizontal and vertical movement separately against a known target. Ensure movement limits do not point the barrel into the deck, base or neighbouring friendly installations.
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.text.2: Item objectives can register separately before components are installed. They do not automatically assess network configuration. Connect firing permission only after checking identification, a safe sector and behaviour when the target disappears; a barrel smoothly following a radar contact is not yet a ready combat system.
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.title: Aiming
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.animals.text: Animal husbandry here separates feeding, product collection and mob killing. The animal feeder breeds animals with suitable food, the rancher shears sheep and milks cows, and the mob crusher kills entities within its working area. Do not point all three at one breeding pen.

Begin with feeding and ranching in a safely enclosed area, supplying FE and the correct food. Display working boundaries and verify one product cycle. Give the crusher a separate closed area without pets, villagers or passing players.

Remove item drops and essence and inspect crusher mode before enabling it. Owning the three blocks does not prove a working farm or require sacrificing breeding stock. Keep an original animal pair separate so a filter or facing mistake cannot destroy the only way to restore the operation.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.text.0: The plant sower and gatherer perform different field tasks. The sower plants materials from colour-coded slots into matching sections above it. The gatherer harvests in front of its working face and can follow connected tree parts, so begin with a separate small field.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.text.1: Place the machines, display their areas and prepare soil, water, seeds and FE. Start one familiar crop and verify a complete planting-and-harvest cycle. An ordinary gatherer breaks plants when harvesting; do not assume replanting without a working sower or the special conditions of an enhanced process.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.text.2: Remove harvest and sludge and reserve seeds for the next planting. The requested fertilizer has its own use and is not automatically accepted in every slot. If the field becomes empty, inspect seed supply and matching areas instead of focusing solely on harvest speed.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.title: Auto Farm
Industrial Foregoing machine frames have different tiers and belong to specific recipes. The early Pity frame is crafted at a table, while the next step requires an additional production process. Prepare plastic and metals while retaining early frames for the upgrading infrastructure itself.

Craft two Pity frames and prepare a dissolution chamber for a Simple frame. Its recipe combines item ingredients with a required fluid rather than merely surrounding the old frame at a crafting table. Inspect the actual recipe before spending rare materials.

Supply the complete ingredients, fluid and FE, wait for the new frame and collect it. The chamber locks item slots during a valid recipe to prevent accidental mixing. Owning a higher frame does not automatically upgrade placed machines; each device still has its own crafting recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.frames.title: Machine Frames
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.guide_dissol: Manual: run the Simple frame recipe in a dissolution chamber, remove output and verify readiness for another batch.

The dissolution chamber produces materials from item ingredients and one suitable fluid. Choose the familiar Simple frame recipe for a separate trial and set aside exact ingredients. Extra similar plates or another latex-related product cannot replace the required composition.

Supply fluid through the correct input, connect FE and insert the complete item set. Chamber recipes are shapeless: slot arrangement does not matter, but item type and quantity do. Once a recipe is recognised, slots lock to prevent accidentally adding the next batch.

Wait for output, remove it and verify the chamber unlocks for another operation, then mark the objective. If it waits, inspect fluid and energy before rearranging every item. This establishes predictable frame production for more advanced farming and extraction devices.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.guide_log_su: Manual: obtain latex, replace an exhausted log and verify extraction resumes.

The fluid extractor gradually consumes wood in front of it, so latex production needs log replacement. Prepare a dedicated working log and spare logs of the same type. Ensure its working face targets feedstock rather than the workshop’s wooden wall.

Wait for processing while observing latex and the changing log. Once it is exhausted, place another in the same position and verify extraction resumes. Electricity accelerates the extractor but creates no replacement tree and cannot clear a full fluid output.

Mark the manual objective after successful replacement and renewed latex production. Later automation needs supported block placement, but first prove the simple manual cycle. Different logs have different extraction rates; compare the actual recipe before substituting a more available wood type.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.0: The laser drill charges a suitable laser base; the base itself creates mining output. This objective lists a fluid laser base, so do not expect it to fill a chest with ore. Ore production uses a separate ore laser base that must be crafted additionally.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.1: Place the drill so its working area covers the base and supply FE. For a fluid recipe, check biome, configured depth and required catalyst; some recipes also need a particular entity beneath the installation. A coloured lens is not a universal permit for every fluid.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.2: Choose one specific recipe and provide output capacity before adding drills. Black and blue lenses matter only under their corresponding recipe conditions. If a charged base produces nothing, inspect world requirements and catalyst instead of blindly increasing power; energy cannot replace a missing condition.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.title: Laser Drilling
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.0: Industrial Foregoing plastic starts with latex extracted from a log in front of a fluid extractor’s working face. The extractor is not listed among the objectives, so craft it separately. Wood is gradually processed and disappears; one permanently placed log does not provide unlimited latex.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.1: Send latex and water to the processing unit and supply energy. The resulting dry rubber is then smelted into plastic through the available recipe. Check the rubber form carefully: small intermediates and full dry rubber may require an additional crafting step.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.2: First register eight dry rubber in one batch, then process material and collect sixteen plastic. Different item objectives retain progress sequentially. If production stops, check the log, water, latex and output space, then electricity. Separate farm timber from structural walls: the extractor should consume designated material, not part of the base.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.title: Latex
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.ore_meat.tex: Ore meat processing uses special Industrial Foregoing fluids to process ore. Prepare liquid meat supply and a separate ore batch. The washing factory combines ore with meat to produce raw ore meat; ordinary water cannot replace that input.

Transfer the fluid to a fermentation station and set the intended production mode and fill level at which the batch seals. Wait for fermentation, then feed the resulting fluid with sand into the fluid sieving machine. It outputs dust of the original metal.

Power every machine and keep each processing fluid on its own route without mixing metals in unfinished batches. The dust still needs smelting into ingots. If the fermenter waits, check the batch-sealing threshold: a partly filled tank may be normal waiting rather than a broken recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.stonework.te: The material stonework factory combines creation and further processing of ordinary mineral materials. Prepare energy, water and lava in the machine’s designated inputs, then select an operation sequence in its interface. Exposed lava beside the block does not necessarily equal a filled internal tank.

Begin with simple cobblestone output into a separate chest. Once operation is stable, enable desired subsequent processing such as grinding or smelting using the available modes. Several operations change the final product; do not route it into an established warehouse until the chosen chain is verified.

Watch FE and output space. This machine is useful for sand, glass and construction stock but does not replace laser extraction of rare ores. Obtaining the block completes the item objective; actual operation is demonstrated by a product and recovery after a full destination is cleared.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.glowstone.tex: A refined-glowstone tool requires Mekanism’s corresponding ingot, not ordinary glowstone dust substituted for metal. Prepare an osmium compressor, osmium supply and glowstone, then run the refined-material recipe. The compressor also needs electricity.

Craft a pickaxe from the resulting ingots. Check its statistics and supported mining materials before travelling, then test ordinary stone mining. The pickaxe needs no charge even though an electric machine produced its starting metal.

Reserve some glowstone for other recipes and watch tool durability. Do not assume the pickaxe shares every property of other equipment made from the same material; armour features must be checked separately. This step is useful when the compressor already works and you want better ordinary equipment before an expensive Meka-Tool.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.0: The lapis lazuli pickaxe gives lapis a use beyond enchanting and dyes. Prepare its recipe materials and compare statistics with your current pickaxe before spending an enchanting reserve. This is an ordinary Mekanism Tools item, not electric machinery.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.1: Craft the pickaxe and test it on simple stone near the base. Check whether its mining level supports the intended ore: an unsuitable tool may prevent the useful drop. A material name alone does not guarantee access to every ore.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.2: Watch durability and carry a backup underground. Suitable ordinary enchantments and the item’s repair rules can extend its service. This branch is optional for Mekanism machinery and offers a useful early tool without spending osmium on electric equipment.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.title: Lapis Lazuli
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.obsidian.task: Obtain any refined-obsidian armour piece; the helmet meets the criterion.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.obsidian.text: Refined obsidian is a late material for ordinary Mekanism Tools equipment. Production uses obsidian dust treated with diamond infusion material and then processed with osmium. Check the complete Mekanism machine chain; an ordinary obsidian block does not replace the ingot in armour recipes.

Craft the helmet and pickaxe and keep both until detection. The advancement named Better than Netherite checks obtaining any supported refined-obsidian armour piece rather than a full set; the helmet already meets that condition.

Compare protection and durability with your existing equipment and test the pickaxe on a safe material. This armour does not gain radiation shielding merely because it comes from Mekanism. Reactor work still requires suitable protective equipment; strong ordinary armour addresses other game hazards.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.task.1: Obtain a paxel of any supported material; an osmium paxel qualifies.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.0: A paxel combines pickaxe, axe and shovel jobs to free hotbar space. Prepare the tools and other ingredients specified by the osmium variant’s recipe. Avoid expensive enchanted ingredients until you have checked whether the recipe preserves the properties you need.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.1: Craft the osmium paxel and hold it in your inventory for detection. The Paxel advancement triggers on obtaining any supported paxel, so it does not require mining special blocks. The osmium variant requested here qualifies.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.2: Test stone, dirt and wood in a safe area and inspect its secondary-use action. This is an ordinary tool that wears down, so a chargepad will not restore it. Watch durability and keep a spare pickaxe: losing one combined tool removes several working functions at once.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.title: Osmium
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.task.1: Obtain a Mekanism Tools shield; an osmium shield qualifies for the advancement.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.0: The osmium shield is a Mekanism Tools defensive equipment variant. Prepare osmium and the other recipe ingredients, craft the shield and inspect its statistics. This objective requires the osmium item specifically, although the advancement accepts several materials from the mod.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.1: The advancement is awarded for obtaining a supported shield in your inventory. You do not need to block a special attack or provoke a dangerous enemy. After detection, equip it in a convenient hand and practise raising it somewhere safe.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.2: The shield wears down and protects only within its blocking mechanics. It does not replace radiation shielding, oxygen reserves or protection against every electrical device. Watch durability and account for the occupied hand slot while managing tools, food and a bucket during an expedition.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.title: Shields
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.0: A generator coil converts Create rotation into electricity only with magnets around it. Prepare the coil, carbon brushes and four magnetite blocks, plus a separate mechanical source. The coil does not generate rotation itself or start a closed loop without outside energy.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.1: Arrange magnets around the coil as shown in Ponder, supply rotation and fit carbon brushes to collect electricity. Connect a simple consumer or storage. Watch both mechanical stress and electrical output: visible rotation alone does not prove correct magnetic assembly.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.2: Stronger surrounding magnets improve conversion and increase mechanical load. If the network stalls from overstress, reduce demand or strengthen the original drive. Obtaining parts completes the item objective; successful generation is demonstrated by rising energy in the receiving device.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.title: Generator Coil
The energizer processes items with electricity while also using Create rotation. For the first batch, place a basic unit above a depot or belt and provide both connections. A mechanical hand or FE supply without rotation cannot replace the complete requirements.

Place an iron ingot beneath the working head and wait for processing. The installed overcharged-iron recipe needs one thousand energy per ingot. Repeat for eight ingots, checking that a belt does not move material away before the operation finishes.

If the device is idle, compare item position, supplied rotation and stored electricity. Belt movement and processing must agree; a depot is easier to observe for the first trial. Overcharged iron feeds later electrical components, so retain part of the batch until the item objective registers and further machines are planned.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.energiser.title: Energiser
codex.quest.tech2_newage.guide_conversio: Manual: power a separate consumer from the coil and verify generation stops when the original rotation stops.

Test the boundary between rotation and electricity on one small installation. Choose a mechanical drive, magnet-surrounded coil, brushes and a separate electrical consumer. Remove feedback paths so rotation does not depend on the generator being tested and the result stays clear.

Start the drive without electrical load and inspect the mechanical network. Then connect the consumer and confirm actual energy delivery without overstress. Stop the original rotation and observe new generation cease, allowing for charge already stored.

Mark the manual objective after successful supply and controlled source shutdown. Codex does not automatically measure conversion. A consumer running briefly afterwards may be using its internal buffer rather than unlimited energy. This trial helps plan remote motors and assess available mechanical capacity.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.guide_heat_rout: Manual: without nuclear fuel, verify heat delivery to a consumer and cooling after heat input stops.

Test the heat network before attaching a nuclear source. Prepare weak controllable heating, a few pipes and a Stirling engine or another suitable consumer. Keep thermal readings accessible and separate the installation from combustible flooring and player routes.

Supply heat and follow its path to the consumer. Confirm the correct engine face is connected and the expected rotation appears. Stop heating and watch stored heat continue being used without dismantling the still-hot line.

Manually confirm after testing supply, consumption and cooling without nuclear fuel. Do not drive blocks into becoming lava for the experiment. A successful small trial verifies routing but does not prove capacity for a full reactor; a powerful source requires separate sizing and continuous removal.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.0: New Age heat pipes transfer heat between supported devices. A Stirling engine gains rotation from heating below, while a boiler heater supplies heat to Create’s steam system. None is a universal FE cable or gas pipe.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.1: For the first experiment, use a controlled heat source such as a solar heating plate and a short route to the engine. Observe temperature and rotation before attaching a large workshop. Then separately inspect boiler-heater placement under a boiler in Ponder.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.2: Excess heat is dangerous: an overheated thermal block can turn into lava. Provide continuous heat consumption and avoid trapping a hot source in a dead-end line when an engine stops. Pipes, engine and heater in an inventory confirm equipment only; thermal balance must be checked on the actual system.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.title: Heat
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.0: An electric motor turns supplied energy into Create rotation. It is useful for a remote machine without a long mechanical shaft. Prepare a basic motor, its extension and dependable electrical supply; a generator coil driven by that same motor is not a free source.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.1: Set motor speed with a wrench and connect one small machine. Changing speed does not itself increase available SU capacity. The extension allows a stress-capacity multiplier, but energy consumption rises with the chosen capacity.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.2: Check behaviour when the consumer stops and when redstone control changes. A signal can disable the motor by default; the behaviour can be inverted, so test the actual setting. If overstress occurs, reduce mechanical load or configure the extension within your power budget instead of simply setting maximum speed.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.title: Motors
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.0: The New Age reactor releases heat through reactor rods and heat vents. It is a different structure from a Mekanism reactor. Arrange rods, fuel insertion and vents according to Ponder, then fully enclose it with the intended casings or reactor glass before adding fuel.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.1: Run pipes from the vents to continuous consumers capable of using the released heat. Check the complete route and access to stopping fuel supply before startup. Sixteen requested casings are an initial stock, not proof of a complete enclosure for the chosen shape.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.2: Ponder warns about dangerous radiation from an exposed reactor and meltdown without heat consumption. Keep the first trial under observation and do not open the enclosure for repairs while operating. Begin with minimal controlled supply and watch temperatures; crafted parts establish equipment, not a safe thermal operating state.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.title: Nuclear Reactor
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.0: New Age thorium is the starting material for the mod’s own nuclear fuel. Crushing ordinary thorium can produce radioactive thorium with a ten-percent chance in the installed recipe, so eight starting items do not guarantee a successful batch. Prepare extra material and space for crushing byproducts.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.1: Fuel uses Create sequenced assembly: press the radioactive intermediate, apply an iron plate with a deployer and press again. Operation order matters; ordinary furnace smelting is not a substitute. Inspect the current sequenced recipe before starting the line.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.2: Keep eight ordinary thorium and completed fuel until the objectives register. Do not load the fuel into a reactor yet: a complete protective enclosure and heat removal must be ready first. Random production of the radioactive ingredient requires reserves rather than a promised exact yield from every stack.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.title: Thorium
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.0: New Age wires transfer electricity between connectors. Prepare two fittings and copper wire, then choose a short link from a tested generator to a consumer. Mechanical shafts carry rotation separately and do not replace the energizer’s electrical connection.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.1: Place connectors on the intended devices and join them with wire using the mod’s controls. If a block automatically pushes energy, a correct receiving connection is sufficient. For a passive source from another mod, the connector has a wrench-selectable Pull mode.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.2: Check that the destination gains energy under a small load. Ponder specifically warns that Pull is not intended to drain motor or energizer internal storage; do not build reverse network supply around that assumption. If transfer fails, inspect modes and endpoint blocks first, then connection length and continuity.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.title: Wires
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.derrick.task: Manual: form the derrick, finish concrete-and-water drilling, create the wellhead and direct fluid into available storage.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.derrick.text: A derrick creates a wellhead reaching a surveyed fluid reservoir. Build the multiblock from the manual and form it by hammering its single light engineering block. Prepare energy, drilling pipes and supplies for both drilling stages; this process cannot operate correctly below water level.

The first stage reinforces the well above bedrock with liquid concrete; the second uses water to drill through bedrock towards selected targets. Pipes are loaded manually. Check target coordinates and the required fluid without mixing concrete and water in unfinished supply lines.

Once the well opens, reservoir pressure pushes fluid upwards. Ensure free output before drilling completes: a full derrick releases oil outside through its pressure-relief mechanism. Mark the manual objective after creating the wellhead and controlling collected fluid; a stack of parts does not establish a working well.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.guide_desulf: Manual: form the hydrotreater, process sulfurized diesel with water and collect clean diesel together with sulfur dust.

Clean Petroleum diesel requires additional processing of the sulfurized fraction. Prepare the multiblock hydrotreater from the engineer’s manual and form it with the hammer. Its high-pressure name does not imply a PneumaticCraft connection: this is Petroleum’s own fluid-and-FE process.

Supply one thousand units of sulfurized diesel and five hundred water. The installed recipe produces one thousand clean diesel and five sulfur dust, so prepare fluid and item outputs. Power connects to the heating unit and water to its own upper port beside the panel.

Collect both products and mark the manual objective after the actual recipe runs. Do not substitute ordinary IE biodiesel for sulfurized diesel because of a similar name. The sulfur output needs space for processing to continue; keep the useful powder for later chemistry rather than blocking the entire oil line.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.guide_survey: A seismic survey result records fluid-reservoir information needed to plan a well. Prepare the seismic tool and a suitable IE buckshot cartridge. Choose a survey point with practical construction access rather than merely an attractive derrick location.

Perform the survey and obtain its result item. Open it and inspect measurement coordinates and possible reservoir markers. Repeated separated surveys help compare directions and refine the target; an initial unknown marker does not promise a particular fluid.

Keep the map with project supplies and record chosen coordinates. It neither replaces a well nor grants oil automatically. Before drilling, check storage distance and the ability to remove pressurised fluid: a useful site depends on future service access as well as deposit presence.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.products.tex: Distillation bitumen is used for asphalt, while lubricant services suitable heavy machinery. Prepare sixteen asphalt blocks through their recipe and an automatic lubricator. Asphalt is useful for industrial-site roads but does not replace multiblock construction materials.

Hold the lubricator near a supported machine: highlighting shows the correct attachment point. Place it there and supply an accepted lubricant. The manual lists machines such as the pumpjack, excavator and crusher; an arbitrary machine from another mod may not be compatible.

Check fluid consumption and signs of lubrication while the machine operates. Plant oil can also work but is consumed less efficiently than petroleum lubricant. Acceleration does not fix empty inputs or blocked outputs, so restore normal operation before judging the benefit of servicing.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.pumpjack.tas: Manual: form a pumpjack over a completed wellhead after reservoir pressure falls, supply FE and collect fluid through a side output.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.pumpjack.tex: A pumpjack extracts fluid from a wellhead already created by a derrick. It is needed after natural reservoir pressure falls. Do not replace the derrick prematurely: a pressurised well can force fluid through the pump assembly, regardless of spare tank capacity.

Build the structure from the manual, align the headpipe connection with the wellhead and hammer the second-layer heavy engineering block to form it. Supply FE and connect orange side outputs to storage. Confirm that this is the prepared well bore.

Start extraction, observe incoming fluid and mark the manual objective. Power use and rate depend on configuration, while reservoir stock is finite; some deposits replenish slowly. If production ends, check reservoir state and output space rather than assuming moving the pumpjack creates new oil.
Petroleum’s seismic survey tool searches for fluid deposits beneath bedrock. It needs IE buckshot cartridges: load suitable ammunition and operate the tool at a prepared location. The resulting map shows reflected signals, while several separated readings help locate the reservoir.

Compare results and record the proposed well coordinates. Do not assume every marker is oil: several fluid reservoir types exist, and an initial signal may not yet identify the type. Check available survey information before building an expensive derrick.

The IE core sample in the second objective concerns mineral surveying and does not replace a Petroleum seismic result. Obtain it with an ordinary core drill, but possessing a core proves no oil deposit. Later you will need separate fluid storage and a clear construction site for the derrick.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.survey.title: Survey
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.task.3: Manual: form and power a distillation tower, process crude oil and provide reception for every fluid fraction and bitumen.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.0: The distillation tower separates oil into naphtha, kerosene, sulfurized diesel and lubricant, with bitumen as an additional output. Build it from the manual, form it by hammering the redstone engineering block and prepare reception for every product. A blocked unwanted fraction stops useful refining.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.1: Power enters above the heating unit, oil below, fluids leave the orange side hatch and bitumen the front. The four requested buckets of clean diesel also require a hydrotreater: one thousand sulfurized diesel and five hundred water produce one thousand clean diesel and sulfur dust.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.2: A flarestack destroys accepted combustible surplus rather than storing it; its top is hazardous even during servicing. Establish useful receivers before controlled disposal. Mark the manual check after running distillation with clear outputs; obtain and register clean diesel separately after desulfurization.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.title: Distillation Tower
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.0: Pneumatic armour uses stored compressed air and installed upgrades. The requested helmet and chestplate begin the set, while a charging station fills supported items with air. Prepare the station and a safely controlled network before crafting many modules.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.1: Place an armour piece in the station and observe pressure equalising between them. A small station air reserve cannot fully charge a large empty item without compressor support. The station interface also installs compatible upgrades, with options depending on the equipment.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.2: Equip charged pieces and learn controls in a safe area. A complete set and special abilities require the remaining pieces and suitable modules. Do not raise an entire early network to an item’s pressure limit: ordinary tubes withstand less than some charged tools, so the weakest connected block determines safety.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.title: Pneumatic Armor
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.assembly.tex: The pneumatic assembly line performs drilling and laser operations according to a program. The requested controller, platform, drill and laser are not the entire set: two assembly IO units and an appropriate program purchased through Amadron or a mechanic villager are also needed.

Place the platform centrally. Drill and laser must be directly adjacent rather than diagonal; IO arms must reach both the platform and their chests. Configure one for import and the other for export. Supplying air to the connected system’s controller is sufficient.

Insert the program and run one known recipe while watching controller diagnostics. The Drill & Laser program means sequential two-stage processing, not every independent recipe from both tools. If it stops, inspect program choice, platform reach, air and material in the correct chest.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.chamber.text: The pressure chamber is hollow with an external side length of three, four or five blocks. Edges and corners use chamber walls or glass; valves and interfaces occupy faces. The eight requested walls are insufficient for a complete minimum shell.

Build a starter chamber and supply air through at least one valve. Convenient item handling needs two interfaces: an input with I facing outward and an output with O outward. Items enter through an external hopper or transporter rather than by simply opening the casing.

Begin with compressed iron and watch pressure. Interfaces also consume air to move items, so a stalled output may be waiting for pressure recovery. Do not dismantle a pressurised chamber to retrieve products; configure output and compressor instead. For bulk iron, blocks reduce the number of individual transfers.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressed.t: The first compressed iron comes from exposing ordinary iron ingot item entities to an explosion. This PneumaticCraft startup operation is needed before building a pressure chamber. Prepare a small iron batch and a separate site away from the base, animals and useful belongings.

Drop only the intended ingots near a controlled explosion source and move to shelter before it triggers. Afterwards collect surviving compressed iron. The manual warns of roughly twenty-percent material loss, so exactly sixteen iron ingots do not guarantee completion.

Do not answer an unlucky result by placing a huge pile of valuables beside explosives. Once you have sixteen compressed ingots, move on to the compressor and chamber. The chamber later produces compressed iron without the initial explosive losses and becomes the normal controllable supply method.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressor.t: The air compressor burns ordinary solid furnace fuel to produce compressed air. Prepare the compressor, four tubes and a manometer, leaving convenient observation access. It does not accept lava buckets; liquid fuels belong to a different device.

Connect a consumer with a short tube, close unused open faces and load a small amount of fuel. Inspect pressure with the manometer and interface. Hissing and particles at an open end indicate a leak to fix before expanding production.

An ordinary early system has a nominal five-bar limit; the red gauge zone warns of danger rather than marking a safe operating target. Configure compressor shutdown before that limit and test it without consumption. Do not leave a fuelled compressor pumping a closed network without control.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.0: A drone follows its recorded program and consumes compressed air. The programmer builds actions, while a GPS tool helps transfer coordinates. The programmer itself needs no pressure, but the program may require puzzle pieces and the drone needs charging at a station first.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.1: Begin with simple delivery of one item type between two chests. Specify exact input and output areas, write the program into the inserted drone and test near the base. Avoid starting with large-area mining or unrestricted item handling.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.2: Provide an accessible charging station with the required dispenser upgrade and air supply so the drone can recharge. A completely empty drone loses flight and can suffer falling damage. Update coordinates when moving a program elsewhere; correct actions with somebody else’s coordinates still send the assistant to the wrong place.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.title: Drone
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.elevator.tex: The pneumatic elevator moves a platform between building levels. Its base and frames establish the route, but an operating lift also needs air and floor controls. Choose a vertical shaft without protruding machines, wires or places where a player could become trapped.

Build the base and required frames from the manual, then connect a short safe pneumatic line. Configure available heights and controls and make a short unloaded ascent. Check the platform’s entire path rather than only the block directly above the base.

Provide an ordinary alternative exit from each floor in case the compressor stops. If the elevator remains still, compare pressure, requested height and shaft obstructions. Four requested frames do not promise arbitrary travel height; the final device depends on the complete structure and settings, which need testing before daily use.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_assemb: The drill and laser do not automatically take items from any nearby chest. The assembly system needs separate import and export IO arms. Prepare one of each and position chests so every arm reaches both its own inventory and the platform.

Check each block’s colour and mode: input supplies the workpiece and output removes the product. IO arms can reach diagonally, unlike the drill and laser. Every system element must remain correctly connected to the controller.

Load one recipe batch for the selected program and follow its complete path from chest to finished item. An empty platform points to import trouble; a finished item sitting on it points to export trouble. This diagnosis avoids replacing a valid program when the real fault is arm reach.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_interf: Two interfaces let you service a chamber without dismantling its wall and losing air. Prepare the pair, an external input inventory and an output receiver. Before changing the shell, stop and safely depressurise the system; do not break a working chamber wall to add an input.

Place interfaces on faces allowed by the structure rules. The input shows I outward and the output shows O outward. Feed ingredients with a hopper or transporter and configure finished-product removal, keeping unrelated materials out of the test chest.

Verify one recipe and product retrieval without opening the chamber. Each transfer consumes air, so large batches may exit in pauses. Processing iron blocks reduces transfer count; this saves transport air rather than increasing the compression recipe’s yield.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_pressu: A pressure gauge module turns pressure into a control signal, while a safety module adds a separate limiting mechanism. Prepare both and an expansion card. Stop the compressor and follow a safe pneumatic servicing procedure before installation.

Fit the gauge module to a tube. The expansion card opens threshold configuration: choose a value below the weakest connected block’s dangerous range and connect the signal to compressor control. Configure the safety module from its manual page rather than assuming its name provides automatic protection.

Run a small no-load charging test and verify supply stops early. Do not raise pressure to destruction to test protection. Connecting a chamber changes total volume but not weak tubes’ limits; check recovery and control response again after one recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.0: A printed circuit board passes through several separate stages. Make an empty PCB in the pressure chamber, then prepare the blueprint for the UV light box. The Amadron tablet orders required items unavailable through ordinary crafting: bind a separate payment-and-delivery chest and check the price before ordering.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.1: Expose the empty PCB fully, then place it in an etching tank containing etching acid. Partial exposure leaves a failure chance; learn the complete cycle first. A tank is more convenient and safer than an open acid pool containing dropped boards.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.2: Etching produces an unassembled PCB, which still needs transistors and capacitors to become a finished board. Obtain four finished boards without confusing intermediates. An assembly line with a laser program later provides an alternative route, but does not remove the need for the correct electronic components.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.title: Printed Circuit Boards
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.plastic.text: PneumaticCraft plastic is initially produced as a fluid. The refinery separates oil using heat; its controller needs additional output blocks, normally two to four. A single crafted controller is not a working column.

Obtain LPG and feed it with coal into the thermopneumatic processing plant. The manual states that one hundred units of LPG and one coal produce one thousand molten plastic; this recipe needs heat but not pressure. Other recipes in the same machine may require both.

Solidify the melt using a supported method, such as carefully placing it in a prepared area, and collect sixteen sheets. Remove every refinery product: a full heavy-fuel tank stops the desired LPG output too. Before changing recipes, check temperature and residual fluids rather than mixing plastic with fuel storage.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pressure_ser: Produce sixteen compressed iron ingots in the pressure chamber using the prepared safe network. Separate ordinary iron from the initial explosive batch and clear the input and output interfaces. Check the chosen recipe’s minimum pressure in JEI before feeding it.

Process a small batch and watch pressure fall during processing and transfers. Interfaces also consume air, so finishing compression does not guarantee immediate delivery of the whole stack. Let the compressor restore reserves within the configured safe range.

Collect sixteen finished ingots in your inventory; the objective neither consumes them nor automatically identifies their origin. For a meaningful trial, use chamber output rather than old chest stock. The next node separately checks pressure recovery and compressor shutdown with no consumption.
Manual: run a recipe, observe pressure recovery and verify compressor shutdown without consumption, without approaching destruction.

The pressure trial must show two different conditions: an operating consumer and a closed network with no consumption. Prepare one known chamber recipe, read initial pressure and ensure the manometer is visible from safety. Do not remove pressurised blocks to improve observation.

Run the recipe and watch pressure fall and then recover through compressor operation. Once it finishes, stop air consumption and verify that the compressor actually shuts off at the chosen safe level. Do not enter the red zone or cause destruction to prove the limit works.

Mark the objective manually only after both observations. Codex does not measure compressor behaviour automatically. If pumping continues without consumption, stop the trial through available controls and fix shutdown logic; the installation is not ready for unattended operation until the repeated check passes.

Eight tubes let you build a small observable pressure-control section. Use the existing compressor and chamber, adding a manometer and controlled shutdown. The tubes should make routing clear rather than increase volume pointlessly: a larger volume takes longer to fill.

Connect the devices, close unused outputs and check for hissing. Every early section must stay below its gauge’s dangerous red zone. Configure the compressor to stop at a chosen safe level even when no machine consumes air.

Owning the tubes completes equipment preparation only. Before the next batch, test shutdown with a small fuel load without approaching destructive pressure. If readings fall after adding tubes, account for the increased total volume first: pressure equalisation does not always mean a leak.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.0: An ordinary energy cell stores FE locally, cable transfers it between blocks, and an ender cell links storage to a channel in its owner’s wireless network. Prepare all three components and verify a simple generator–cell–machine route before enabling remote access.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.1: Configure the cell’s input and output sides, connect cables and wait for charging. Then open the ender cell, select a channel and give it valid capacity through its supported storage-adding mechanism. Choosing a number does not turn a channel without capacity into a battery.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.2: Match owner and channel at the wireless destination. If a remote machine receives no FE, check channel reserves and port limits at both ends. One ender cell in an inventory confirms crafting, not a working pair or a loaded remote site.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.title: Cells and Cables
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.0: Powah crystals prepare materials for higher generation and transfer tiers. Energizing a blaze rod or four blaze powder makes a Blazing Crystal; a diamond makes a Niotic Crystal. Ordinary smelting does not replace the energizing orb.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.1: Prepare energy reserves and feed one intended combination at a time. Installed recipes require one hundred twenty thousand FE for one Blazing and three hundred thousand for one Niotic. Produce four of the first and two of the second, keeping them until detection.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.2: If processing is slow, inspect rods and energy delivery rather than adding another diamond to an unfinished batch. For sustained production, upgrade rods alongside generation. A crystal is an ingredient for improved equipment; it does not strengthen an old block simply by sitting in a nearby chest.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.title: Crystals
Dielectric paste and casings underpin Powah devices. Prepare current recipe ingredients, especially recurring metals and coal-based materials. Paste is a crafting component, not fluid fuel or a replacement for another mod’s insulated wire.

Craft eight paste and four casings and let both inventory stocks register. Later machines also require capacitors of the appropriate tier; a casing does not become a generator when placed beside fire. Inspect the first chosen device’s recipe before spending the entire batch.

Reserve separate materials for generation and transfer so you can connect the source after crafting it. A small paste stock supports cables and further components. Expand production after choosing a working line, since different Powah tiers use preceding parts and special energized materials.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.dielectric.title: Dielectric
The energizing orb holds recipe ingredients, while nearby rods supply processing energy. The orb itself needs no direct FE cable. Place four starter rods close to it and connect them to cables or suitable energy blocks.

For energized steel, insert one iron ingot and one gold ingot. The installed recipe consumes ten thousand FE and produces two ingots; four operations make the eight requested here. Avoid loading unrelated stacks when testing this specific combination.

Wait for completion and remove output before the next batch. Speed depends on rod count and tier as well as available energy transfer. If the orb does not operate, inspect the complete recipe, rod distance and rod charge; a large battery attached to the orb cannot replace correctly powered rods.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.energizing.title: Energizing Orb
The three starter generators use different sources. A furnator burns solid fuel, a magmator consumes lava as a fluid, and a thermo generator works above a hot block or fluid while requiring coolant such as water. Their similar names do not make these conditions interchangeable.

Test them individually against the same available energy cell. For the thermo generator, inspect the source beneath it and coolant supply; for the magmator, check internal lava; for the furnator, check accepted fuel. Observe actual energy growth.

Choose the main option according to dependable base supplies. If a generator is full of energy and stops burning fuel, first check whether the network can accept output. Generation values depend on tier and configuration, so compare FE interfaces rather than a promised figure from another version’s guide.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.generators.title: Generators
codex.quest.tech2_powah.guide_orb_batche: Manual: process two separate iron-and-gold batches, removing the output before feeding the next pair.

Automatic orb input must preserve a single recipe’s composition. Prepare two separate iron-and-gold pairs and an empty receiver. Do not begin with a chest of every metal: an extra ingredient can change recipe recognition and stall processing.

Feed the first pair, wait for two energized ingots and remove them. Allow the second pair only once the orb is clear. With transport automation, check batch limits and product extraction; a permanently open input stream does not establish that order by itself.

Mark the manual objective after two consecutive successful operations without mixed inputs. When energy accumulates slowly, do not mistake an unfinished batch for spare space for more ingots. The same sequence later works for crystals after adjusting filters and quantities to their actual recipes.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.0: The Powah reactor uses uraninite as its main fuel and is built from thirty-six blocks of one tier. The item objective requests only one starter block, so prepare the complete set for an actual installation. Process raw uraninite into fuel through a supported recipe first.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.1: Clear construction space and begin placement with the full set in hand; supported automatic assembly completes the reactor. Inspect its interface, fuel input, coolant and performance additives using the current manual and tooltips.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.2: Connect accepting storage and observe fuel use alongside FE output. Do not import Mekanism radioactive-waste requirements into this separate system, although it still needs dependable supplies. Keep eight raw and four processed uraninite until detection, and judge operation only after the structure is complete.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.title: Reactor
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.task.0: Earn the advancement for killing the Ender Dragon
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.0: Dragonslayer records your personal advancement for defeating the Ender Dragon. Find a stronghold, activate its portal with Eyes of Ender, and prepare armour, ranged weapons, blocks and fall protection. Nether access unlocks this card but does not prepare the End portal for you.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.1: On the island, first disable the dragon’s healing by destroying tower crystals from a safe distance. Watch for breath on the ground and avoid platform edges. When the dragon lands, choose a position with an escape route instead of becoming trapped beneath it.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.2: After victory, check your own dragon-kill advancement. Merely standing nearby does not guarantee the required personal progress. The book consumes nothing and needs no egg; claim the reward once safe and with inventory space.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.title: Dragonslayer
codex.quest.trials_bosses.guide_guard_ro: Check routes from military buildings to two colony entrances and remove obstacles for guards

Garrison size does not guarantee defenders can reach a threat. After hiring eight soldiers, choose two used colony entrances and inspect routes from military buildings. Narrow passages and height changes matter more than extra decorative wall work at this stage.

Walk the routes in the world and observe guards during normal activity. Remove obstacles, provide clear stairs and check doors on approaches. Do not trigger a real raid for testing: accessible working routes and citizens no longer stuck at one point are sufficient.

Confirm after checking both entrances and fixing discovered obstructions. The book does not automatically evaluate navigation quality. Repeat this inspection after major road or warehouse-district changes: new buildings can block a previously sound route even though the eight-soldier advancement remains recorded.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.guide_trophy_r: Bring an expedition trophy home, register its advancement and display it safely

A trophy room distinguishes completed journeys from discovered coordinates still awaiting a return visit. Prepare three item frames and choose a protected place at home. Use the native placement method for large or placeable trophies; frames serve smaller items and commemorative materials.

Before displaying an important trophy, ensure it passed through your inventory and registered its advancement. This particularly matters for Eternal Tales banners: direct transfer into remote storage may bypass personal acquisition. Frames may be placed immediately after their quantity registers.

Confirm after bringing at least one expedition trophy home and displaying it safely. Keep the collection away from an operating weapons range or exposed lava. This short pause between expeditions also provides time to check supplies before departing again.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.task.0: After the labyrinth stage, complete the Hydra stage through combat or a trophy
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.0: The Hydra belongs to the fiery Twilight Forest region reached after the labyrinth. Its advancement requires labyrinth progress, so bringing a head alone does not guarantee completion. Check local progression, including Meef Stroganoff, before searching for the lair.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.1: Bring fire resistance, food reserves and a weapon that can reliably strike opening heads. Position yourself to see attacks being prepared and leave burning areas. Tight cover immediately beside the Hydra may remove visibility and escape routes instead of providing protection.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.2: After combat, collect the trophy and check both parts of your personal advancement: labyrinth progress and confirmation of the Hydra encounter. The book accepts the mod’s supported combat alternatives without consuming the head. If the checkmark is missing, inspect progression before immediately repeating the fight.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.title: Hydra Head
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.task.0: After the Naga stage, complete the Lich stage through combat, a trophy or scepter
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.0: The Lich follows the Naga: the installed advancement requires Naga progress even if you possess a Lich trophy. Check that milestone before climbing the tower, prepare food and clear an escape route through previously visited floors.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.1: Initially, remove the Lich’s shields by reflecting suitable magical projectiles into the real boss. Copies complicate targeting; do not spend all your equipment attacking invulnerable silhouettes. As its protection changes, deal with summoned enemies and the Lich while preserving room to manoeuvre.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.2: After victory, collect a trophy or scepter and check your personal advancement. The installed version accepts several combat confirmations but retains the Naga requirement. The book consumes nothing; the retained items support your equipment and further Twilight Forest progression.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.title: Lich Dust
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.task.0: Complete the Naga stage through combat, a scale or the trophy
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.0: The Naga is a useful first major encounter in the Twilight Forest and begins its local boss progression. Find a walled Naga courtyard and prepare repaired armour, weapons and food. This card unlocking after Nether access does not remove the dimension’s own restrictions.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.1: Keep room to move around the courtyard and watch the long body’s turns. After landing a hit, avoid blindly chasing the head through obstacles. Collect the dropped scales and trophy, useful both as materials and as evidence of the completed stage.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.2: The installed advancement can count combat, Naga scales or the trophy. A trophy received after a shared victory can therefore provide personal progress without another fight. The book keeps your loot intact; check the Naga advancement before travelling to the protected Lich Tower.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.title: Naga Scales
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.task.0: Obtain the Purgatory Banner after defeating Nyetet
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.0: Nyetet, the Fallen Guardian, belongs to Eternal Tales’ Purgatory. This card records obtaining the Purgatory Banner, which the mod uses to confirm that stage. Visiting the dimension and owning suitable equipment alone do not complete the trophy trial.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.1: Leave food and repair supplies at a safe return point before the encounter. Locate the relevant stage of local progression and prepare a position with an escape route that does not drop into unknown terrain. In multiplayer, agree who collects the trophy so it is not lost among other loot.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.2: After victory, place the Purgatory Banner in your own inventory and check the advancement. A banner displayed at a teammate’s base does not equal your acquisition of it. The book consumes nothing, so keep the registered banner as a trophy and continue towards later worlds.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.title: Fallen Titan
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.task.0: Obtain the Rayana Banner after defeating Pterion
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.0: Pterion is a distinct trophy stage in Eternal Tales’ Rayana. The installed advancement reacts to a Rayana Banner in your inventory, so combat completion does not automatically imply personal registration. Your character must acquire the trophy at least once.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.1: Prepare for an expedition rather than a short duel: bring food, sufficient weapon durability and a safe return method. Locate the encounter through Rayana’s local progression. On unfamiliar terrain, identify edges and passages first; pursuing an enemy should not separate you from the only safe exit.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.2: Collect the Rayana Banner after victory and check the advancement before giving loot to other players. The book does not consume the banner, and once registered you need not carry it again for the reward. If progress is missing, look for an uncollected trophy rather than treating another banner as equivalent.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.title: Winged Terror
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.task.0: Raise the colony army to eight soldiers
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.0: This card counts a MineColonies garrison of eight soldiers rather than a defeated raid. The corrected name supports peaceful planning: organise colony defence in advance without provoking an attack or waiting for a random event.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.1: Build enough military workplaces, assign citizens to the relevant jobs and provide equipment suitable for their levels. Eight buildings do not equal eight assigned soldiers. Inspect workers through the colony interface and resolve missing food, weapons or access to their posts.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.2: Once the army contains eight people, check your personal military advancement. The book requires no sword delivery and does not evaluate patrol routes. After claiming the reward, inspect settlement entrances and guard paths separately: troop numbers help only when soldiers can reach the threat.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.title: Eight Soldiers
Obtain the Comet Banner after defeating Terrible Tree

Terrible Tree belongs to an Eternal Tales expedition through Comets. This trial uses an advancement awarded by the installed mod when a Comet Banner enters your inventory. After victory, collect that trophy rather than only nearby materials.

Prepare a return route from Comets, check equipment durability and reserve an inventory slot for the banner. Follow Eternal Tales’ book and advancements for the local encounter sequence. Do not assume every large tree is the boss or that an ordinary axe automatically solves the fight.

After combat, pick up the Comet Banner and let the advancement update before mounting it on a wall. The book does not take the trophy. If the objective remains empty, inspect your personal inventory and advancement: loot sent directly to someone else’s bag or external storage was not acquired by you.
Defeat Unahzaal and earn the Eternal Tales finale advancement
Unahzaal is the final trial of Eternal Tales’ main story. This objective checks a dedicated victory advancement awarded by the mod’s logic; the dimension block shown as its icon is not a delivery item. Merely visiting Unahzaal’s Multiverse does not complete it.

Finish preceding story stages and prepare complete supplies for repair, recovery and combat. Before entering, check where spare equipment is stored and how you return after a failed attempt. Do not begin the final encounter straight after a demanding expedition with nearly broken weapons and no food.

After victory, let the event finish and check your personal Eternal Tales advancement. This is the ordinary finale; Eternal Darkness mode and its additional conditions are not required here. The book consumes nothing, and rewards are best claimed after the final scene has safely concluded.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.unahzaal.title: Journey's End
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.task.0: Summon the Wither and earn the Withering Heights advancement
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.0: This card checks summoning the Wither, because that is what the selected Minecraft advancement records. It does not automatically verify victory. Prepare three wither skeleton skulls and four soul sand or soul soil blocks, plus equipment for the subsequent fight.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.1: Choose a site far from your base, animals and important buildings. Build a T-shaped soul-block frame and complete it with three skulls on top. The final skull triggers summoning; retreat immediately because the boss appears through a dangerous charging phase and explosion.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.2: The advancement may appear before combat ends. Do not open rewards while the Wither threatens you or the world, and do not treat the checkmark as permission to leave it uncontrolled. The book consumes no trophies; finishing the fight and securing the site remain separate gameplay responsibilities.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.title: Summon the Wither
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.task.0: Obtain the Royal Banner after defeating Xaxxas XIX
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.0: Xaxxas XIX concludes an important part of Eternal Tales’ Kingdom of Amber story. The trial checks the advancement through the Royal Banner. It differs from decorative banners of other worlds; this specific stage trophy is required, not any item with a royal-sounding name.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.1: Prepare equipment and supplies before entering the final part of local progression. Keep a route through explored rooms and avoid leaving progression items in random chests. Follow kingdom events and dialogue: an unlocked trial card does not remove the encounter’s story requirements.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.2: After victory, acquire the Royal Banner in your own inventory and wait for the advancement. You can then display it at home because the book does not take trophies. Before continuing, check health, equipment durability and story loot so the reward does not distract from preparing for the next world.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.title: Fall of the King
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.0: Cobblestone accumulates quickly while digging a mine, but this trial needs a prepared reserve: 192 ordinary blocks, or three full stacks. Cobbled deepslate, smooth stone and decorative variants are excluded.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.1: Choose a safe patch of ordinary stone and mine it with a pickaxe without Silk Touch. Light the work area, close dangerous passages and reserve materials for furnaces and stair repairs first. Digging straight down for the final stack introduces needless risk.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.2: All three stacks must be in your inventory together when submitted and will be consumed. If the count looks wrong, check block names rather than their grey texture. The remaining excavation can become an access passage to a future mining site.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.title: Stonecutter
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.0: This pantry accepts 32 cooked beef. Roast chicken, raw meat and elaborate dishes may feed you well, but do not replace the listed objective. Prepare the delivery separately from food reserved for mining or expeditions.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.1: For a renewable source, keep cows, breed adults with wheat and preserve a breeding pair. Cook surplus raw beef in a furnace or smoker. Check fuel before loading everything: an underfuelled furnace often explains missing portions.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.2: All 32 servings must be in your inventory together at submission, and the book consumes them. This exchanges supplies rather than feeding particular colony citizens. Afterwards, the retained herd produces both more meat and leather for the neighbouring trial.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.title: Pantry
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.0: The glass delivery closes the early chain with a material useful for tanks and windows. It needs 64 ordinary glass blocks; panes, stained glass and tinted glass have different item identities and do not count.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.1: Gather sand without undermining your house or paths, then put it in a fuelled furnace. Splitting the work across furnaces reduces waiting but does not change the total material cost. Reserve some future glass for your own technical recipes.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.2: Collect a sufficient batch into your inventory and submit it together: the book removes 64 blocks. Do not place delivery glass as temporary storage, because recovering it requires a suitable tool. After the exchange, you have a straightforward bulk-smelting process for the next production order.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.title: Glassblower
Charcoal supplies early furnaces without finding another coal vein. This side delivery accepts sixteen pieces specifically of charcoal. Ordinary coal burns similarly but is a different item for this objective.

Grow trees in your plantation, reserve building wood and smelt surplus logs in a furnace. The first run needs separate fuel; afterwards, some charcoal can return to the fuel slot. Do not turn logs into planks before smelting, as that changes the input material.

Select 16 pieces and bring them together in your inventory: the book consumes them upon submission. Keep the remaining charcoal for the next cycle. Fuel self-sufficiency depends on actually reserving fuel rather than submitting the final portion along with the entire output.
codex.quest.trials_early.guide_iron_rese: A successful delivery should not leave you without mining tools or protection. Prepare a bucket, shield and iron pickaxe after the early exchange. These items serve different everyday needs: handling water, combat defence and mining resources accessible to iron tools.

Craft missing pieces from reserved ingots and let the book see each item first. Different objectives can be shown sequentially; an existing serviceable pickaxe replaces crafting another. The bucket must be empty for registration: a water bucket has a different item identity.

There is no turn-in or equipment loss here. After registration, fill the bucket with water, place the shield in a convenient slot and resume ordinary work. This reserve matters when a tempting new order would otherwise use the final ingots and leave no repair stock.
codex.quest.trials_early.guide_replant.t: Plant oaks and wait for at least one tree to grow

After delivering logs, check that you still have a forest for the next order. Collect eight oak saplings from decaying leaves and prepare a lit patch of dirt. This is a small renewable plantation, not a demand to clear another natural forest.

Hold all eight saplings together in your inventory, then plant them: registered items may be used without preparing another batch. Leave clear space above and avoid low roofs. The first grown oak confirms that the site actually supports growth.

Confirm the manual objective only once a tree grows in your plantation. Owning saplings does not verify light or growth conditions. Keep fresh saplings after logging so future wood deliveries no longer depend on travelling farther to untouched woodland.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.reward.0: One and a half ingots per ingot turned in — ore doubling before Create
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.0: The iron delivery is useful after making your own tools, not in their place. Prepare 32 iron ingots; raw iron and iron blocks do not match until processed or unpacked into the required form.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.1: Mine ore with a suitable pickaxe and smelt raw iron with enough fuel. Reserve ingots for a bucket, shield and tool repairs first. Do not assume undocumented reward enchantments: the book shows the actual reward contents before you confirm the exchange.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.2: Collect the entire batch from the furnace into your inventory. Submitting removes 32 ingots, so keep metal earmarked for urgent construction elsewhere. This trial opens the food delivery, while your remaining metal reserve supports continued base development.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.title: First Iron
