codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.0: Leather is needed for books and some travel equipment, so submit only surplus left after your own crafting. The trial accepts 16 pieces of ordinary leather; finished leather armour and materials from other creatures are different items.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.1: Use the herd prepared for the meat delivery: raise calves and obtain leather from adult cows while keeping breeding animals. Drops do not arrive in identical amounts, so plan from chest contents rather than the number of animals already killed.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.2: Move sixteen pieces into your inventory just before submission; they will be consumed. Reserve some for books if enchanting tools is next. This completes the trial without destroying the resource source and leaves supplies for improving your home.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.title: Tanner
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.0: The first delivery turns ordinary logging into supplies for the next stage. It requires exactly 64 oak logs: planks, stripped wood and other species do not replace this item, even when they work in most building recipes.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.1: Find oak trees near your base, bring an axe and reserve some saplings for replanting. Keep the delivery separate from wood needed for a crafting table, chests and charcoal. Remove remaining trunk blocks so leaves can clear space for new trees.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.2: Move the full stack of logs into your inventory before submitting. The book consumes all 64; briefly owning them earlier does not count here. Plant the reserved saplings now so the next building project does not send you farther from home.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.title: Woodcutter
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.0: Atomic alloy completes Mekanism’s alloy-upgrade sequence and supports advanced equipment. This trial accepts 16 finished atomic alloys. Infused and reinforced alloys are earlier stages, so owning them alone does not satisfy the final objective.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.1: Follow the recipe from infused alloy through diamond infusion into reinforced alloy, then apply refined obsidian infusion for atomic alloy. Preparing the infusion material also requires resources and machinery. Inspect the infuser before loading expensive components: another infusion type does not mix with the required one.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.2: Set aside sixteen completed alloys and submit them together from your inventory; the whole batch is lost in exchange for the reward. Reserve some for your own pipes, machines and circuits. The following pellet trial needs separate nuclear infrastructure that atomic alloys alone cannot replace.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.title: Atomic Alloy
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.0: The archive delivery accepts four 64k storage parts, not disks containing your network’s belongings. A part is a disk-crafting component and cannot hold items. This order tests memory production while preserving active storage without relocating thousands of items.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.1: Combine smaller-capacity parts into four 64k components using Refined Storage recipes. One component plus a housing produces one disk of that capacity. Do not remove filled disks from a drive for this objective or assume the book checks whether they are empty before consuming them.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.2: All four components must be in your inventory together and will be consumed. The eight rewarded components can make eight disks when housings are provided, not two. Before installing the expansion, inspect network power and data distribution through the normal storage interface.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.title: Archivist
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.0: The polymer delivery combines two Immersive Engineering chemical products: 32 duroplast plates and four biodiesel buckets. Simple wood smelting does not produce these materials. Working chemical multiblocks and separate intermediate-fluid containers are required.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.1: Plates are cast in a bottling machine using phenolic resin and a plate mold; each costs 250 mB and returns the mold. Biodiesel is made in a refinery from plant oil and ethanol with saltpeter as catalyst. Check power and free fluid output space throughout the chain.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.2: Bring the finished plates and four filled buckets into your inventory together. Submission consumes both batches, including bucket items; empty containers are not guaranteed. Keep resin and fuel reserves at the base: a trial reward does not make the chemical line independent of further supplies.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.title: Polymers
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.0: Electrum is used in electrical components from Create Crafts & Additions. This trial requests 32 ingots and 64 wires specifically from that addon. Similar ingots from other mods may work in recipes, but delivery objectives distinguish exact items.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.1: Prepare the alloy through an available gold-and-silver recipe, then roll part of the output into wire in a rolling mill. Do not process all the metal: the delivery also needs remaining ingots. Check JEI for wire yield per ingot and calculate inputs before starting the batch.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.2: Hold both batches together in your inventory; the book consumes 32 ingots and 64 wires. Installed electrical connections between machines are not this item supply. Separate intermediate-product chests preserve working components while you continue into more expensive alloys.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.title: Conductor
codex.quest.trials_late.guide_archive_re: Add a new empty disk, then insert and retrieve a test batch of 64 cobblestone through the grid

New capacity helps only when the network actually accepts and returns items. After the archive delivery, craft one new disk from a rewarded component and a housing. Test with a cheap batch of 64 cobblestone rather than working tools or rare trophies.

Install the empty disk in a connected drive, check controller power and confirm increased capacity. Insert the test stack through the grid, find it using search and retrieve it. Existing filled disks stay in place: removing them would change the experiment and access to your data.

Confirm the manual objective only after recovering all 64 blocks. If the grid is unavailable, restore power and connectivity before moving filled drives. This short experiment distinguishes usable storage expansion from merely having an attractive new disk in a slot.
codex.quest.trials_late.guide_waste_stop: At a minimal safe operating rate, manually stop the reactor and verify burning stops while cooling and waste handling remain available

Pellets in a chest do not show whether you can stop their source. This optional check concerns an already sound Mekanism fission reactor. Do not start a damaged reactor for a checkmark or deliberately cause radioactive-waste overflow as a test.

At a minimal safe operating rate, use the reactor’s normal shutdown and observe fuel burning stop. Cooling and the waste route must remain available after shutdown because residual heat does not vanish instantly. Compare container levels before and after without dismantling occupied radioactive blocks.

Confirm once the command stops burning and supporting systems continue handling the load. If temperature rises or output is full, address the cause and leave the reactor off. Complete protective equipment and radiation monitoring are necessary during work; claiming a reward does not replace continued observation.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.0: Aeronautics levitite belongs to the lifting systems of aerial constructions. Set aside 64 pieces of ordinary levitite, not the pearlescent variant. The delivery concerns material reserves and does not prove that an assembled vessel can lift its own mass.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.1: First inspect the available recipe and acquisition methods for ordinary levitite in this installed pack. Prepare a separate raw-material batch without removing lifting elements from an operating vessel. Keep flight-test materials on the ground: modifying a structure in flight can disturb its balance and lift.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.2: The entire stack must be in your inventory during submission, after which the book consumes it. If the objective shows less than expected, check the material variant and exclude already installed blocks. Fit rewarded aviation components to a moored structure, then recheck controllability.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.title: Lighter Than Air
codex.quest.trials_late.nethersteel.text: Big Cannons nethersteel is a specialised cannon alloy, not ordinary Minecraft netherite. The exchange requires 16 ingots. Reserve metal for planned breeches and other parts first: this delivery does not verify a completed gun.

The installed mixing recipe combines netherite scrap with steel or cast iron under a superheated burner. Ordinary heat is insufficient. Check the chosen variant in JEI: the recipes require different amounts of base metal, so swapping steel for cast iron without recalculating breaks the basin load.

After a successful test batch, collect sixteen ingots in your inventory and submit them together; they are consumed. Molten metal in a tank and nuggets are different forms. For later cannon construction, separately check casting, boring and material compatibility requirements.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.0: Eight polonium pellets and eight plutonium pellets belong to Mekanism nuclear-waste processing. They prove possession of final items, not safe reactor operation. Begin this delivery only after establishing stable cooling, waste removal and a tested emergency shutdown.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.1: Waste branches into a solar neutron activator for polonium and isotopic centrifuging for plutonium; later reaction-chamber processing produces pellets according to the recipes. Do not dismantle radioactive pipes or containers while occupied: radiation may be released. Use complete protective equipment and monitor exposure during this work.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.2: Set aside the completed pellets: all sixteen are required together at submission and are consumed. Correct missing sunlight or reagents at the affected stage instead of blindly increasing reactor output. The reward cannot compensate for overheating or contamination of your base.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.title: Nuclear Cycle
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.0: Sturdy sheets serve applications beyond ordinary Create plates. This delivery needs 64 completed sheets; obsidian dust and unprocessed blanks are not finished output. Prepare steady lava supply and room for completed products.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.1: Sequenced assembly starts with obsidian dust: a spout supplies 500 mB of lava, followed by two pressing operations. This is one processing sequence, so the first press stroke does not finish the job. Send a single blank through the entire route and check its final name first.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.2: Only then run a stack. All 64 sturdy sheets must be in your inventory at submission and will be consumed. If intermediate items clog the output, repair the second-pressing route; extra lava does not replace a missing mechanical operation.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.title: Heavy Industry
codex.quest.trials_late.truadamantite.te: Eternal Tales truadamantite is a late composite material, not a guaranteed ore from one dimension. The delivery needs 16 ingots. Reserve metal required for your own equipment before trading it; the reward may not match your character’s immediate needs.

The installed ingot recipe combines brimstone fungi, tungsten, netherite, venetium, adamantite and two phantom membranes. Check each ingredient’s availability separately; access to the Kingdom of Amber does not create these resources automatically. Craft one ingot first and verify the resulting item.

Accumulate sixteen ingots together in your inventory: submission consumes the entire batch. Unpack blocks or combine nuggets into ingots using their corresponding recipes beforehand. Finishing this chain demonstrates sustained collection of varied resources rather than one lucky rare chest.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.0: Andesite alloy becomes a consumable for much of early Create engineering. Prepare 128 pieces for this trial while reserving some for shafts and casings. A working mixer is convenient, but the book accepts finished output regardless of the recipe used.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.1: Start with an available alloy recipe using andesite and metal nuggets; mechanical mixing offers a convenient production route. Check ingredients in JEI and make a small test batch before loading the entire reserve. A mixer needs suitable rotation, not merely a basin placed below it.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.2: The exchange consumes two full stacks together from your inventory. If factory construction stops afterwards, operating reserves were submitted with the surplus. Separating stocks lets you move on to iron and copper pressing without that interruption.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.title: Andesite River
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.0: Brass moves Create towards controlled logistics and precision assembly. This delivery requires 64 brass ingots, surplus after providing your first brass components. The ingots alone do not automatically verify heating or mixer operation.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.1: Mix copper and zinc in a basin beneath a mechanical mixer with heat from a fuelled burner. First confirm that the burner is actually heating and the mixer rotates fast enough. Metals left in the basin mean processing has not finished, even when the machinery is moving.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.2: Gather all 64 ingots in your inventory before submitting; the whole batch is consumed. Do not convert delivery ingots into casings beforehand. Precision mechanisms are a useful next project because their production uses the capabilities of the brass machinery you have just learned.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.title: Brass Standard
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.0: The bread tribute accepts 128 ordinary Minecraft loaves. This is food exchanged for a reward, not automatic MineColonies feeding: the book removes inventory items and does not distribute them to restaurants or the colony warehouse.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.1: Make bread from wheat at a crafting table or use an established Create or colony food chain. Preserve seeds for replanting and the citizens’ current meals first. If relying on a baker, check actual requests and production output; the book guarantees no fixed time for two stacks.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.2: Collect both stacks of 64 in your inventory before confirming, as the entire batch is consumed together. A separate delivery chest prevents taking the final loaves from the shared kitchen. Check grain reserves afterwards: a sustainable food supply matters more than a one-off production record.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.title: Bread Tribute
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.0: Eight advanced control circuits require learning Mekanism’s basic electronic upgrades. They are used in higher-tier machines, so reserve components for your own installations first. The trial counts completed circuits, not alloys or unfinished recipe ingredients.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.1: Craft basic control circuits and upgrade them with infused alloys using the recipe shown in JEI. An infuser processing different materials must contain the appropriate infusion type: leftover incompatible material prevents the next process. Separate machines or a planned queue avoid unnecessary clearing.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.2: Gather eight advanced circuits in your inventory and submit them together; they are consumed. Rewards may save assembly work on later components, but do not verify mastery of the entire chemical chain. Before expanding, ensure your normal raw-material supply can reproduce these eight circuits.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.title: Circuitry
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.reward.0: A second coke oven lasts the whole game
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.0: The coke oven produces solid fuel and creosote, so this trial requests both outputs: 128 coal coke and eight creosote buckets. Fluid removal matters for continuous operation; a full internal tank can stop production before coal runs out.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.1: Process coal in an assembled coke oven, collect coke and regularly drain the fluid output into suitable containers or storage. The objective specifically needs filled bucket items. Reserve fuel for your blast furnace separately, or the exchange will interrupt the neighbouring steel order.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.2: Before submitting, hold both coke stacks and eight filled buckets together in your inventory. The book consumes the coke and the bucket items themselves; empty containers are not promised back. Clear enough slots beforehand rather than fetching the final part during the exchange.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.title: Coke Chemistry
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_output_buff: Process one brass batch with automatic chest collection and no drops on the ground

Bulk brass production becomes awkward when output scatters on the floor or remains in an overfilled basin. Prepare two chests, one for input and one for output. Owning them helps organise the area, but only a test run verifies actual transport.

Connect available hoppers or Create transport so finished output reaches its chest. Raw materials and completed ingots should not endlessly return to the same feed. Once the book registers the chests in inventory, place them immediately; no extra copies are needed for the objective.

Run one small batch and follow the complete output route. Confirm the manual check once ingots reach the chest without picking them up from the floor. If output stalls, first check space and funnel direction, then investigate the mixing process itself.
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_resume.task: Let input run out, replenish it and obtain more brass without rebuilding the line
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_resume.text: A production line is convenient when ordinary material shortages do not require dismantling it. Perform a small stop-and-resume experiment on the brass installation you have already tested. Use a small load to avoid wasting rare inputs or draining the main factory reserve.

Wait for one input material to run out and observe where processing stops. Replenish that material through the normal inlet while preserving power, heat and transport direction. Do not remove remaining basin items without reason; they may correctly belong to the next recipe.

Confirm once a new brass batch reaches the output chest by itself without rebuilding the installation. If an intermediate item needed manual rescue, fix the cause and repeat. This diagnosis matters more than extra speed while the chain cannot yet recover from ordinary shortages.
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_seed_reserv: Harvest a wheat plot and fully replant it while retaining food for citizens

A large bread delivery succeeds when the next harvest remains possible afterwards. Prepare thirty-two wheat seeds and inspect the field that actually feeds your kitchen. Store planting stock separately from supplies exposed to accidental processing or animal feeding.

Show the entire seed reserve together in your inventory, then use it to replant after harvesting mature wheat. Confirm that farmland retains suitable growing conditions and remains accessible. In a colony, inspect farmer requests and tools instead of assuming the building operates on its own.

Complete the manual objective after fully replanting the chosen plot while keeping food for citizens. Seeds are not submitted and may already be in the ground when you confirm. The next harvest should grow your reserve rather than repair food production accidentally destroyed by a delivery.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.0: Osmium and steel support Mekanism casings and further machines. The delivery combines 64 osmium ingots and 32 steel ingots from that mod. Despite the familiar steel name, Immersive Engineering output does not automatically replace the required item.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.1: Obtain osmium from mined material through available smelting or processing. For steel, use a metallurgic infuser: carbon treatment turns iron into enriched iron and then steel dust, which must be smelted. Monitor carbon supply and machine power at each step.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.2: All osmium and steel must be in your inventory together at submission; the book consumes both batches. Keep casing materials if you intend to continue into circuitry immediately. This delivery is most useful once mining and carbon processing can replenish the surplus you set aside.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.title: Osmium Reserve
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.0: Sixteen precision mechanisms test finished output rather than the number of incomplete assemblies. These components control more advanced Create machinery. Allow extra raw materials because sequenced assembly can finish with a by-product instead of the desired mechanism.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.1: Start with a golden sheet. Deployers add a small cogwheel, a large cogwheel and an iron nugget in that order; repeat the sequence five times. This is not a recipe involving five mechanical crafters. Arrange a return route for incomplete items and a separate final-output route before feeding a large batch.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.2: Select 16 completed mechanisms and hold them together in your inventory. Submission removes them; incomplete mechanisms cannot make up a shortfall. If production stalls, inspect every deployer’s consumables and the return route rather than increasing speed blindly.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.title: Precision Work
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.0: The Refined Storage improved processor belongs to storage-network electronics, not Mekanism control circuits. This trial needs 16 completed improved processors. Provide your own controller and storage access first so the exchange does not consume materials needed for an urgent expansion.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.1: Open the improved processor recipe and follow the route from unfinished assembly to completed component. Prepare silicon, binding material and the required metals; a raw processor still needs processing according to its recipe. Check the final item name before automatically sending the entire batch to a chest.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.2: All sixteen processors must be in your inventory when submitted and will be removed. You do not need to dismantle disks or withdraw the contents of active storage. Steady processor production later supports memory components when mining output exceeds your first chests.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.title: Silicon Valley
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.0: The pressing trial combines two metals: 64 iron sheets and 32 copper sheets from Create. The batch shows that your press handles different orders, although the book cannot tell whether items arrived on a belt or by hand.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.1: Place the press above a depot or working belt segment, supply rotation and process one ingot of each metal first. Run separate batches after checking the result, making leftover ingots and output chests easier to distinguish. Check the item names of plates from other mods.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.2: Both batches must be present together now; you cannot submit iron and bring copper later. The book consumes all 96 sheets. Keep some for your own casings and transport so the brass order does not stall because its supporting infrastructure was sacrificed.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.title: Rolled Stock
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.0: The steel delivery reinforces operation of an Immersive Engineering blast furnace. It accepts 64 steel ingots specifically from that mod. Recipe compatibility between steels does not make them the same item to the book; inspect the output’s mod label.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.1: Supply iron and suitable blast-furnace fuel, then clear the steel and slag outputs. An ordinary furnace does not turn iron ingots into steel. Watch one full cycle before committing a large batch, confirming that fuel sustains processing and previous materials have not blocked the output.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.2: Move a full stack of finished steel into your inventory: submission consumes all 64 ingots. Keep your own construction reserve, particularly if electrical infrastructure is next. The coke trial then examines the fuel supply supporting this smelting process.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.title: Steelmaker
codex.title: Codex
codex.ui.claim_consume: Turn in items and claim reward
codex.ui.inventory_rules: Ordinary item goals remember the largest inventory quantity seen for each item. Different items can be shown separately; recorded machinery need not be dismantled. For counts above one, gather the required quantity of that item together. Turn-in goals require all listed supplies at claim time and consume them.
codex.ui.jei_hint: Left-click an item for its recipe, right-click for its uses.
codex.ui.legend: Green: done · Gold: available · Dashed: any path · ◇: optional
codex.ui.local_notice: Without the mod on the server, items are neither given nor taken.
codex.ui.navigation: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom at the cursor; Home fits the map. Right-click pins a quest. Search: Enter or F3 jumps to the next match. Quest links lead to prerequisites and next steps.
codex.ui.tip.claim: A reward is waiting — open the quest
codex.welcome.eyebrow: A FIELD GUIDE TO YOUR WORLD
codex.welcome.promise: Choose a branch that interests you. Each quest explains preparation, actions and results. Connections show which knowledge and tools you will need next.
codex.welcome.purpose: Every great discovery begins with a first step. The Codex guides you from your first workshop to complex production lines, distant expeditions and magic, even if these mods are entirely new to you.
codex.welcome.step1.body: Choose a map and open a node. Solid links require previous steps; dashed links offer alternatives. Diamonds mark optional branches. Search finds quest titles or item identifiers.
codex.welcome.step1.title: Find your path
codex.welcome.step2.body: Read the explanation and complete its objectives. Items and advancements are tracked automatically. Tick manual goals after checking the result. Turn-in buttons consume the listed resources and give rewards.
codex.welcome.step2.title: Put knowledge to work
codex.welcome.step3.body: Drag the map, zoom with the wheel and press Home for an overview. Right-click pins a quest. Click an item for JEI recipes; follow links to related steps. The book key and Esc close the screen.
codex.welcome.step3.title: Keep your bearings
codex.welcome.title: Codex Aethernum
